nodes.titleZh: 液滴连接桥(metaball 单 path 融合)
注水指示(液面高度表进度/深度)

color/brand-color-system.reasonZh: 搭配:品牌色管线的收尾一站:四态状态色按同一套「同色相派生 + 整组重跑 AA」纪律从品牌色重建,demo 逐态实时复核。
color/brand-color-system.reasonEn: Pairs with: The last stop of the brand pipeline: the four status states rebuild from the brand hue under the same derive-then-audit discipline, checked live per state.

color/brand-color-system.reasonZh: 搭配:派生出的角色色怎么分配比重:60% 主导铺画布、30% 辅助撑表面、10% 强调做焦点的预算口诀,给品牌色一套占比纪律。
color/brand-color-system.reasonEn: Pairs with: How the derived roles share the canvas: the 60/30/10 budget mantra gives the brand color a proportion discipline.

color/brand-color-system.reasonZh: 反向自「P3 广色域」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同一警示的两处落点:高 C 中高 L 段越 sRGB 域后浏览器直接裁剪、色相肉眼偏移——派生管线的验证行与广色域守卫互为前提。」
color/brand-color-system.reasonEn: Reverse from "P3 Wide Gamut" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "One warning, two landing sites: once high-chroma mid-high-L colors leave sRGB the browser clips and the hue visibly shifts — the derivation pipeline's audit rows and the wide-gamut guards presuppose each other."

color/color-functions.reasonZh: 搭配:相对颜色语法的主题层落点:换肤只换 primitive 变量、语义层用 color-mix 现场重派生——声明式派生的完整管线。
color/color-functions.reasonEn: Pairs with: Where relative color lands in theming: re-skinning swaps one primitive variable while the semantic layer re-derives live with color-mix — declarative derivation end to end.

color/color-functions.reasonZh: 搭配:派生色收敛到哪里:三层引用链让组件只认语义名,硬编码 hex 在语义层就没有位置。
color/color-functions.reasonEn: Pairs with: Where derived colors converge: the three-layer chain makes components reference semantic names only, leaving no room for hard-coded hex.

color/color-functions.reasonZh: 反向自「渐变插值」的精选:搭配关系,原句「中点色 color-mix(in oklab…) 与渐变共用同一套插值空间语法:空间选型指引(感知均匀→oklab、避免变灰→oklch)在 color-functions 成表。」
color/color-functions.reasonEn: Reverse from "Gradient Interpolation Space" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Midpoint color-mix(in oklab…) and gradients share one interpolation-space syntax: the space-selection guide (perceptual→oklab, anti-gray→oklch) is tabulated in color-functions."

color/color-psychology-ui.reasonZh: 先修:情绪叙事不得冒充工程结论:文字色由对比度决定、不由情绪偏好决定——黑/白字比值实时重算的硬约束先在 wcag-contrast 学起。
color/color-psychology-ui.reasonEn: Requires: Mood narrative must not impersonate engineering: text color is decided by contrast, not mood preference — the hard constraint of live black/white ratio recomputation starts in wcag-contrast.

color/color-psychology-ui.reasonZh: 搭配:高饱和「响亮」配色的吸睛策略与可访问性警示(浅色+微妙阴影对低视力用户是噩梦,调研 11§6)——本条目案例引用的风格本体在 neo-brutalism。
color/color-psychology-ui.reasonEn: Pairs with: The loud-high-saturation attention strategy and its accessibility warning (pale colors + subtle shadows are rough for low vision, research 11§6) — the style itself cited in this entry's cases lives in neo-brutalism.

color/color-psychology-ui.reasonZh: 反向自「60-30-10 法则」的精选:搭配关系,原句「强调色的「焦点/行动号召」职责与 Spotify 例证在两条目同源(调研 06§9):这里定预算,那边讲情绪叙事的边界。」
color/color-psychology-ui.reasonEn: Reverse from "60-30-10 Rule" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The accent's 'focus/call-to-action' duty and the Spotify example share one source (research 06§9): the budget here, the mood-narrative boundaries there."

color/dark-mode-patterns.reasonZh: 反向自「语义色三层架构」的精选:搭配关系,原句「「暗色是另一张按角色重挑的表,不是反转」的结构性证明:同一套组件 CSS 换映射表即换主题——GitHub dark/dark-dimmed 两套表是两条目共享的实证。」
color/dark-mode-patterns.reasonEn: Reverse from "Semantic Token Layers" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The structural proof that dark mode is a re-picked role table, not an inversion: one component CSS, swapped mapping tables — GitHub's dark/dark-dimmed pair is the evidence both entries share."

color/dark-mode-patterns.reasonZh: 反向自「M3 色调表面」的精选:搭配关系,原句「深色层级的方向律(提亮=前进、阴影降权重)在本条目与 dark-mode-patterns 之间同源(调研 06§13/14)——五档表面是它的档位落点。」
color/dark-mode-patterns.reasonEn: Reverse from "M3 Tone Surfaces" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The dark-hierarchy direction rule (brighter = forward, shadows demoted) is shared between this entry and dark-mode-patterns (research 06§13/14) — the five surface tiers are where it lands."

color/dark-mode-patterns.reasonZh: 属于路径「色彩系统」第 5 步

color/gradient-interpolation.reasonZh: 搭配:渐变上叠字先对账:插值空间的选择会移动中段最差点,最亮/最暗两端各跑一遍对比度——条目原文明示这条纪律。
color/gradient-interpolation.reasonEn: Pairs with: Text over gradients must reconcile first: the interpolation space moves the worst midpoint, so both brightest and darkest ends run through contrast — the entry states this discipline itself.

color/gradient-interpolation.reasonZh: 搭配:中点色 color-mix(in oklab…) 与渐变共用同一套插值空间语法:空间选型指引(感知均匀→oklab、避免变灰→oklch)在 color-functions 成表。
color/gradient-interpolation.reasonEn: Pairs with: Midpoint color-mix(in oklab…) and gradients share one interpolation-space syntax: the space-selection guide (perceptual→oklab, anti-gray→oklch) is tabulated in color-functions.

color/gradient-interpolation.reasonZh: 反向自「OKLCH 选色工作流」的精选:搭配关系,原句「工作流的渐变章:插值空间显式声明 in oklab 避开 sRGB 长距脏灰带(Tailwind v4 默认即 OKLAB)——完整语法与 hue 策略在 gradient-interpolation。」
color/gradient-interpolation.reasonEn: Reverse from "OKLCH Color Workflow" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The gradient chapter of the workflow: declare the interpolation space (in oklab) to dodge sRGB's long-distance gray band (Tailwind v4's default) — full syntax and hue strategies in gradient-interpolation."

color/hct-tonal-palette.reasonZh: 对比:两套感知均匀刻度易混:HCT 的 tone 是 CIE L*(0–100),oklch 的 L 是 Oklab 亮度(0–1),数值互不相通、换体系整列重算——本条目原文对照。
color/hct-tonal-palette.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two perceptually uniform scales that get confused: HCT tone is CIE L* (0–100), oklch L is Oklab lightness (0–1); the numbers don't transfer — this entry makes the comparison.

color/hct-tonal-palette.reasonZh: 搭配:tone 体系从调色板到界面:这里生成 13 档一列,m3-tone-surfaces 把五档表面角色从同一 HCT 机制上取档。
color/hct-tonal-palette.reasonEn: Pairs with: The tone system from palette to interface: this entry generates 13-step columns; m3-tone-surfaces assigns the five surface roles from the same HCT mechanism.

color/hct-tonal-palette.reasonZh: 路径「色彩系统」的下一站:色板要变成可维护系统必须令牌化:primitive → semantic 分层是 W3C Design Tokens 官方方法学,同一色板改一份映射即换语义。
color/hct-tonal-palette.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Color Systems" path: A palette becomes a maintainable system only when tokenized: the primitive → semantic layering is the official W3C Design Tokens methodology — one mapping edit re-semantics the same palette.

color/light-dark.reasonZh: 先修:换品牌色必须两侧分别复核:亮侧 #6750A4 白字 6.44:1 过 AA、暗侧 #D0BCFF 配 #381E72 达 7.7:1 AAA——四项阈值的用法在 wcag-contrast。
color/light-dark.reasonEn: Requires: Swap the brand color and both sides re-verify separately: light #6750A4 at 6.44:1 with white (AA), dark #D0BCFF with #381E72 at 7.7:1 (AAA) — the four thresholds are applied in wcag-contrast.

color/light-dark.reasonZh: 搭配:light-dark() 管双态取值,theme-transition 管切换的视觉表演:同一篇官方教学(web.dev)把两者叠成「零 CSS 改动的换肤」。
color/light-dark.reasonEn: Pairs with: light-dark() owns the two-state value; theme-transition owns the switching show: the same official lesson (web.dev) stacks them into theme switching with zero CSS changes.

color/light-dark.reasonZh: 反向自「状态色系统」的精选:搭配关系,原句「状态色双主题怎么写:四态三件套各配一对浅/深值,light-dark() 一行声明随系统外观自动切换。」
color/light-dark.reasonEn: Reverse from "Status Color System" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "How status triples go dual-theme: each state's bg/border/text pairs up light/dark values with one light-dark() declaration."

color/m3-dynamic-color.reasonZh: 搭配:动态取色流水线的上一环:source color→五板 13 档由 tonal palette 生成,本条目负责「档→角色」的映射与亮暗取值——两条目是姊妹件。
color/m3-dynamic-color.reasonEn: Pairs with: The upstream stage of dynamic color: source color → five 13-step palettes come from the tonal palette; this entry maps tones to roles and light/dark values — sister entries.

color/m3-dynamic-color.reasonZh: 延伸:角色色生成读完,surface container 五档是消费侧最常见的一族角色——层级靠 tone 档位而非海拔,两条目连读成体系。
color/m3-dynamic-color.reasonEn: Extends: After generating color roles, the surface-container five are the most-consumed role family — hierarchy by tone tier rather than elevation; read together they form the system.

color/m3-dynamic-color.reasonZh: 反向自「品牌色系统」的精选:对比关系,原句「派生管线的平台版对照:自建 tone 阶逐档验证,还是交给 M3 从 source 色相展开五板再映射角色——两条路线二选一。」
color/m3-dynamic-color.reasonEn: Reverse from "Brand Color System" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "The platform twin of your pipeline: hand-build tone steps with audits, or let M3 expand five palettes from a source hue and map roles — pick one route."

color/m3-tone-surfaces.reasonZh: 搭配:深色层级的方向律(提亮=前进、阴影降权重)在本条目与 dark-mode-patterns 之间同源(调研 06§13/14)——五档表面是它的档位落点。
color/m3-tone-surfaces.reasonEn: Pairs with: The dark-hierarchy direction rule (brighter = forward, shadows demoted) is shared between this entry and dark-mode-patterns (research 06§13/14) — the five surface tiers are where it lands.

color/m3-tone-surfaces.reasonZh: 先修:彩色表面(chroma 调高)上线前逐档过闸:正文 4.5:1、状态边 3:1 的判定纪律在 wcag-contrast——本条目参数面板直接引用。
color/m3-tone-surfaces.reasonEn: Requires: Before shipping tinted surfaces (raised chroma), every tier passes the gates: the 4.5:1 body-text and 3:1 border disciplines are defined in wcag-contrast — this entry's panel applies them directly.

color/m3-tone-surfaces.reasonZh: 反向自「HCT 色调调色板」的精选:搭配关系,原句「tone 体系从调色板到界面:这里生成 13 档一列,m3-tone-surfaces 把五档表面角色从同一 HCT 机制上取档。」
color/m3-tone-surfaces.reasonEn: Reverse from "HCT Tonal Palette" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The tone system from palette to interface: this entry generates 13-step columns; m3-tone-surfaces assigns the five surface roles from the same HCT mechanism."

color/multi-theme-tokens.reasonZh: 路径「设计令牌工程」的下一站:主题有了之后才有「切换」:View Transitions 承载换肤过渡,且必须挂 prefers-reduced-motion 闸门降级为直切。
color/multi-theme-tokens.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Design Tokens" path: Switching exists only once themes do: View Transitions carries the crossfade, gated by prefers-reduced-motion downgrading to an instant swap.

color/multi-theme-tokens.reasonZh: 反向自「语义色三层架构」的精选:先修关系,原句「三层纪律读完,multi-theme-tokens 是它的完整管线版:换肤=重挂一张 primitive 表,主题数与组件数解耦(Primer 9 套主题实证)。」
color/multi-theme-tokens.reasonEn: Reverse from "Semantic Token Layers" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After the three-layer discipline, multi-theme-tokens is its full pipeline: re-theming = swapping one primitive table, theme count decoupled from components (Primer's 9 themes as proof)."

color/multi-theme-tokens.reasonZh: 反向自「色盲安全配色」的精选:先修关系,原句「核查通过后把安全色沉淀成语义主题:GitHub Primer 的色盲专用主题正是「换一张映射表即生成色盲模式」的工程化完整版。」
color/multi-theme-tokens.reasonEn: Reverse from "Colorblind-Safe Palette" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After the check passes, bank the safe colors as semantic themes: GitHub Primer's colorblind-specific themes are the full engineering form of 'swap one mapping table, get a CVD mode'."

color/oklch-conversion.reasonZh: 延伸:矩阵推导读完,看这组数字在设计里怎么用:固定 L 只调 C/H 的选色工作流,把感知均匀变成可预测的对比度。
color/oklch-conversion.reasonEn: Extends: After the matrix math, see how the numbers get used: the fixed-L picking workflow turns perceptual uniformity into predictable contrast.

color/oklch-conversion.reasonZh: 搭配:同一段数学的两次出场:γ 解码既是 sRGB→OKLab 管线的第一步,也是 WCAG 相对亮度的第一步——两页互为对账。
color/oklch-conversion.reasonEn: Pairs with: One piece of math, two appearances: gamma decode opens both the sRGB-to-OKLab pipeline and WCAG relative luminance — the two pages audit each other.

color/oklch-conversion.reasonZh: 反向自「OKLCH 色彩空间」的精选:延伸关系,原句「L/C/H 三个数字从哪来:γ 解码→LMS→立方根→OKLab 的五段转换在 oklch-conversion 逐步可核——懂来历才敢用分量。」
color/oklch-conversion.reasonEn: Reverse from "OKLCH Color Space" curated: Extends relation, quoting "Where L/C/H come from: the five-stage γ-decode→LMS→cube-root→OKLab conversion, checkable step by step in oklch-conversion — know the origin before trusting the components."

color/oklch-space.reasonZh: 搭配:姊妹条目分工明确:本条讲空间本身(L/C/H 分量语义与踩坑),固定 L 只调 C/H 的选色工作流与对比度工程在 oklch-workflow。
color/oklch-space.reasonEn: Pairs with: Sister entries with a clean split: the space itself (L/C/H semantics and pitfalls) here; the fixed-L picking workflow and contrast engineering in oklch-workflow.

color/oklch-space.reasonZh: 先修:L/C/H 三个数字从哪来:γ 解码→LMS→立方根→OKLab 的五段转换在 oklch-conversion 逐步可核——懂来历才敢用分量。
color/oklch-space.reasonEn: Requires: Where L/C/H come from: the five-stage γ-decode→LMS→cube-root→OKLab conversion, checkable step by step in oklch-conversion — know the origin before trusting the components.

color/oklch-space.reasonZh: 路径「色彩系统」的下一站:学会个人操作后看平台方案:Google 的 HCT tonal palette 与 OKLCH 互证,roles 表是官方「色板→角色」映射。
color/oklch-space.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Color Systems" path: After personal operations, study the platform scheme: Google's HCT tonal palette cross-checks OKLCH, and the roles table is the official palette-to-role mapping.

color/oklch-workflow.reasonZh: 先修:固定 L 选色的全部承诺(AA 4.5:1 / AAA 7:1、4.499 不四舍五入)都是 WCAG 阈值语言——先懂四道闸,再谈「L≥87% 恒达标」。
color/oklch-workflow.reasonEn: Requires: Every promise of fixed-L picking (AA 4.5:1 / AAA 7:1, 4.499 doesn't round) is WCAG threshold language — learn the four gates before 'L≥87% always passes'.

color/oklch-workflow.reasonZh: 搭配:同一套取色工作流的宽色域延伸:sRGB 兜底 + @supports + @media (color-gamut: p3) 三件套在本条目引出,p3 条目给完整守卫与色域体积数据。
color/oklch-workflow.reasonEn: Pairs with: The wide-gamut extension of the same picking workflow: the sRGB fallback + @supports + @media (color-gamut: p3) trio introduced here is fully specified with gamut-volume data in the P3 entry.

color/oklch-workflow.reasonZh: 路径「色彩系统」的下一站:语法之上补「为什么」:CSS Color 4 在规范层定义 OKLab/OKLCH,会用之后再说清 L/C/H 各轴含义与取值范围。
color/oklch-workflow.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Color Systems" path: Add the "why" above the syntax: CSS Color 4 defines OKLab/OKLCH at spec level — after using it, say precisely what each of L/C/H means and spans.

color/p3-wide-gamut.reasonZh: 搭配:同一个 C 上限的两面:oklch 条目讲「C≈0.37 溢出 sRGB,建议手写 P3 覆盖」,本条目给完整三件套守卫与降 chroma 钳制演示。
color/p3-wide-gamut.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two faces of the same chroma ceiling: oklch-space explains C≈0.37 overflowing sRGB and suggests manual P3 overrides; this entry supplies the full three-guard pattern and a chroma-clamping demo.

color/p3-wide-gamut.reasonZh: 搭配:同一警示的两处落点:高 C 中高 L 段越 sRGB 域后浏览器直接裁剪、色相肉眼偏移——派生管线的验证行与广色域守卫互为前提。
color/p3-wide-gamut.reasonEn: Pairs with: One warning, two landing sites: once high-chroma mid-high-L colors leave sRGB the browser clips and the hue visibly shifts — the derivation pipeline's audit rows and the wide-gamut guards presuppose each other.

color/p3-wide-gamut.reasonZh: 反向自「OKLCH 选色工作流」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同一套取色工作流的宽色域延伸:sRGB 兜底 + @supports + @media (color-gamut: p3) 三件套在本条目引出,p3 条目给完整守卫与色域体积数据。」
color/p3-wide-gamut.reasonEn: Reverse from "OKLCH Color Workflow" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The wide-gamut extension of the same picking workflow: the sRGB fallback + @supports + @media (color-gamut: p3) trio introduced here is fully specified with gamut-volume data in the P3 entry."

color/radix-color-scale.reasonZh: 对比:步位体系与 tone 体系常被混为一谈:Radix 12 步是语义槽位(每步一个用途),Material tone 是连续标尺(角色从标尺取值)——本条目并排讲清差别。
color/radix-color-scale.reasonEn: Contrasts: Step scales and tone scales get conflated: Radix's 12 steps are semantic slots (one use each), Material tones are a continuous ruler roles draw from — this entry lays the difference side by side.

color/radix-color-scale.reasonZh: 搭配:步 11/12 的对比保证是 APCA Lc60/90 而非 WCAG 比值——两套指标的分工与不可互冒充,wcag-contrast 条目专段讲。
color/radix-color-scale.reasonEn: Pairs with: Steps 11/12 guarantee APCA Lc60/90, not WCAG ratios — the division of labor between the two metrics (and why they can't impersonate each other) has its own section in wcag-contrast.

color/radix-color-scale.reasonZh: 反向自「状态色系统」的精选:搭配关系,原句「四态三件套的结构原型:底/边/字各占独立步位,正是 12 步色阶「底 1–3、边 6–8、字 11–12」的分档思路。」
color/radix-color-scale.reasonEn: Reverse from "Status Color System" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The structural prototype of the state triple: bg/border/text on separate steps mirrors the 12-step scale's tiering."

color/rule-60-30-10.reasonZh: 搭配:强调色的「焦点/行动号召」职责与 Spotify 例证在两条目同源(调研 06§9):这里定预算,那边讲情绪叙事的边界。
color/rule-60-30-10.reasonEn: Pairs with: The accent's 'focus/call-to-action' duty and the Spotify example share one source (research 06§9): the budget here, the mood-narrative boundaries there.

color/rule-60-30-10.reasonZh: 搭配:三个角色落进主题层的姿势:组件只引用角色变量、占比与色值集中在映射表——正是三层 token 架构的角色层实践。
color/rule-60-30-10.reasonEn: Pairs with: How the three roles land in theming: components reference role variables only, ratios and values live in the mapping table — role-layer practice of the three-layer token architecture.

color/rule-60-30-10.reasonZh: 反向自「品牌色系统」的精选:搭配关系,原句「派生出的角色色怎么分配比重:60% 主导铺画布、30% 辅助撑表面、10% 强调做焦点的预算口诀,给品牌色一套占比纪律。」
color/rule-60-30-10.reasonEn: Reverse from "Brand Color System" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "How the derived roles share the canvas: the 60/30/10 budget mantra gives the brand color a proportion discipline."

color/semantic-token-layers.reasonZh: 延伸:三层纪律读完,multi-theme-tokens 是它的完整管线版:换肤=重挂一张 primitive 表,主题数与组件数解耦(Primer 9 套主题实证)。
color/semantic-token-layers.reasonEn: Extends: After the three-layer discipline, multi-theme-tokens is its full pipeline: re-theming = swapping one primitive table, theme count decoupled from components (Primer's 9 themes as proof).

color/semantic-token-layers.reasonZh: 搭配:「暗色是另一张按角色重挑的表,不是反转」的结构性证明:同一套组件 CSS 换映射表即换主题——GitHub dark/dark-dimmed 两套表是两条目共享的实证。
color/semantic-token-layers.reasonEn: Pairs with: The structural proof that dark mode is a re-picked role table, not an inversion: one component CSS, swapped mapping tables — GitHub's dark/dark-dimmed pair is the evidence both entries share.

color/semantic-token-layers.reasonZh: 反向自「动态取色」的精选:搭配关系,原句「「语义 token 而非具体值」的移动端同构:Android 官方表述与 Primer 三层架构在两条目互证——组件永远只引用角色名。」
color/semantic-token-layers.reasonEn: Reverse from "M3 Dynamic Color" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The mobile twin of 'semantic tokens, not values': Android's official wording and Primer's three-layer architecture corroborate each other across the two entries — components reference role names only."

color/status-color-system.reasonZh: 搭配:四态三件套的结构原型:底/边/字各占独立步位,正是 12 步色阶「底 1–3、边 6–8、字 11–12」的分档思路。
color/status-color-system.reasonEn: Pairs with: The structural prototype of the state triple: bg/border/text on separate steps mirrors the 12-step scale's tiering.

color/status-color-system.reasonZh: 搭配:状态色双主题怎么写:四态三件套各配一对浅/深值,light-dark() 一行声明随系统外观自动切换。
color/status-color-system.reasonEn: Pairs with: How status triples go dual-theme: each state's bg/border/text pairs up light/dark values with one light-dark() declaration.

color/status-color-system.reasonZh: 反向自「品牌色系统」的精选:搭配关系,原句「品牌色管线的收尾一站:四态状态色按同一套「同色相派生 + 整组重跑 AA」纪律从品牌色重建,demo 逐态实时复核。」
color/status-color-system.reasonEn: Reverse from "Brand Color System" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The last stop of the brand pipeline: the four status states rebuild from the brand hue under the same derive-then-audit discipline, checked live per state."

color/theme-transition.reasonZh: 搭配:圆形扩散是官方成文配方里唯一成形的揭示形状;液态族从这里补强:同一快照骨架,揭示形状从圆换成逐帧波浪 path。
color/theme-transition.reasonEn: Pairs with: The circle reveal is the only fully-formed reveal shape the official recipe documents; the liquid family strengthens from here: the same snapshot skeleton with the reveal shape swapped from a circle to a per-frame wave path.

color/theme-transition.reasonZh: 搭配:同一快照层的非圆形答案:不是圆形扩散、不是渐变淡入,而是从按钮流出、逐帧重算联合轮廓的液体揭示——机制互补成对读。
color/theme-transition.reasonEn: Pairs with: The snapshot layer's non-circular answer: not a circle reveal, not a crossfade, but a liquid reveal pouring from the button with a per-frame joint contour — read the two as complementary mechanics.

color/theme-transition.reasonZh: 路径「设计令牌工程」的下一站:从「静态映射」升级到「响应式 token 值」:clamp 让字号随视口流动,M3 type-scale tokens 提供档位参照。
color/theme-transition.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Design Tokens" path: Upgrade from static mappings to responsive token values: clamp lets type scale flow with the viewport, with M3 type-scale tokens as the tier reference.

color/wcag-contrast.reasonZh: 先修:检查器的每一步(γ 解码→加权求和→比值)都有独立推导条目:先懂公式来历,四道阈值才判得明白。
color/wcag-contrast.reasonEn: Requires: Every step of the checker (γ decode → weighted sum → ratio) has its own derivation entry: understand the formula's origin and the four thresholds judge clearly.

color/wcag-contrast.reasonZh: 搭配:tone 档位与对比度的换算桥:tone 即 CIE L*,tone 80 对 tone 20 ≈7.7:1(AAA)——库内 ratioOfTones 正按相对亮度实现。
color/wcag-contrast.reasonEn: Pairs with: The conversion bridge between tone tiers and contrast: tone is CIE L*, tone 80 vs tone 20 ≈7.7:1 (AAA) — the library's ratioOfTones is implemented exactly on relative luminance.

color/wcag-contrast.reasonZh: 反向自「OKLCH 选色工作流」的精选:延伸关系,原句「固定 L 选色的全部承诺(AA 4.5:1 / AAA 7:1、4.499 不四舍五入)都是 WCAG 阈值语言——先懂四道闸,再谈「L≥87% 恒达标」。」
color/wcag-contrast.reasonEn: Reverse from "OKLCH Color Workflow" curated: Extends relation, quoting "Every promise of fixed-L picking (AA 4.5:1 / AAA 7:1, 4.499 doesn't round) is WCAG threshold language — learn the four gates before 'L≥87% always passes'."

components/ai-answer-states.reasonZh: 路径「AI 界面工程」的下一站:六态里「空」最常被敷衍:empty 条目把空态从「没有数据」升级为引导下一轮的邀请——状态机收官后的最后一块收口练习。
components/ai-answer-states.reasonEn: Next stop on the "AI Interface Patterns" path: Among the six states, empty is the one most often faked: the empty entry upgrades a blank from "no data" to an invitation steering the next turn — the final closing exercise after the state machine.

components/ai-answer-states.reasonZh: 反向自「AI 流式响应」的精选:先修关系,原句「流式管道读完后接安全终局:refusal/error 卡就是流被打断时的落点——拒答按普通消息位渲染、重试出口必在,是管道的收官一课。」
components/ai-answer-states.reasonEn: Reverse from "AI Streaming Response" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After the streaming pipeline, its safe terminations: refusal/error cards are where an interrupted stream lands — refusal renders as a normal message slot with a retry exit, the pipeline's closing lesson."

components/ai-answer-states.reasonZh: 属于路径「AI 界面工程」第 6 步
components/ai-answer-states.reasonEn: Step 6 of the "AI Interface Patterns" path

components/ai-generative-ui.reasonZh: 搭配:工具卡与思考步骤卡是同一套语法的两块面板:完成 1s 自动收起(AUTO_CLOSE_DELAY)与「仅收起一次」直接同源,流中自动展开也共享。
components/ai-generative-ui.reasonEn: Pairs with: Tool cards and thinking step cards are two panels of one grammar: the 1s auto-collapse (AUTO_CLOSE_DELAY) and collapse-once rule share a source, and so does auto-open during streaming.

components/ai-generative-ui.reasonZh: 路径「AI 界面工程」的下一站:生成式 UI 之后攻最难形态:结构化数据的逐行流——本站自定义条目,无任何厂商专页(官方依据为 MDN Streams + M3 组件组合锚点,如实标注未证实)。
components/ai-generative-ui.reasonEn: Next stop on the "AI Interface Patterns" path: After generative UI comes the hardest shape, row-by-row streaming of structured data — a site-original entry with no vendor page of its own (official basis is the combined MDN Streams + M3 components anchor, honestly marked unverified).

components/ai-generative-ui.reasonZh: 反向自「Tesler 定律」的精选:搭配关系,原句「工具调用是复杂度守恒的当代样本:模型代跑 get_weather、宿主只渲染结果卡——复杂度没有消失,只是转移到系统侧,渲染权仍在白名单手里。」
components/ai-generative-ui.reasonEn: Reverse from "Tesler's Law" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Tool calls are today's sample of complexity conservation: the model runs get_weather for you and the host only renders the result card — complexity didn't vanish, it moved to the system side, rendering rights still in the allowlist."

components/ai-streaming-response.reasonZh: 延伸:流式管道读完后接安全终局:refusal/error 卡就是流被打断时的落点——拒答按普通消息位渲染、重试出口必在,是管道的收官一课。
components/ai-streaming-response.reasonEn: Extends: After the streaming pipeline, its safe terminations: refusal/error cards are where an interrupted stream lands — refusal renders as a normal message slot with a retry exit, the pipeline's closing lesson.

components/ai-streaming-response.reasonZh: 路径「AI 界面工程」的下一站:流式引入的第一个 UI 问题=「未完成态」:首分片到达前要有思考指示,官方载体是 progress indicators。
components/ai-streaming-response.reasonEn: Next stop on the "AI Interface Patterns" path: Streaming's first UI problem is the "not-done-yet" state: a thinking indicator must appear before the first chunk arrives, and progress indicators are the official carrier.

components/ai-streaming-response.reasonZh: 反向自「AI 流式表格」的精选:搭配关系,原句「表格块与正文块在流式管线上分工作业:正文按闭合态渲染、块级 memo 稳定已完成段——表格行的生长接的是同一台文本到达状态机。」
components/ai-streaming-response.reasonEn: Reverse from "AI Streaming Table" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Table blocks and prose blocks split the streaming pipeline: prose renders by closed-state with block memo keeping finished paragraphs stable — table rows grow on the same text-arrival state machine."

components/ai-streaming-table.reasonZh: 搭配:表格块与正文块在流式管线上分工作业:正文按闭合态渲染、块级 memo 稳定已完成段——表格行的生长接的是同一台文本到达状态机。
components/ai-streaming-table.reasonEn: Pairs with: Table blocks and prose blocks split the streaming pipeline: prose renders by closed-state with block memo keeping finished paragraphs stable — table rows grow on the same text-arrival state machine.

components/ai-streaming-table.reasonZh: 路径「AI 界面工程」的下一站:答案完整后学「引导下一轮」:建议 chips 是官方建议组件,充当「回答」与「追问」两幕之间的桥。
components/ai-streaming-table.reasonEn: Next stop on the "AI Interface Patterns" path: Once answers complete, learn to steer the next turn: suggestion chips are the official suggestion component, the bridge between the answer act and the follow-up act.

components/ai-streaming-table.reasonZh: 属于路径「AI 界面工程」第 4 步
components/ai-streaming-table.reasonEn: Step 4 of the "AI Interface Patterns" path

components/ai-suggestion-chips.reasonZh: 搭配:chips 是流结束后的路标层:光标只在 streaming 态挂在最后一条消息上,流一结束就该整组换牌——换牌纪律以流式侧的状态为锚。
components/ai-suggestion-chips.reasonEn: Pairs with: Chips are the post-stream signpost layer: the caret hangs only on the last message while streaming, and once it ends the whole set should swap — the swap discipline anchors on the stream side's state.

components/ai-suggestion-chips.reasonZh: 路径「AI 界面工程」的下一站:收官永远是状态完备性:loading/部分/错误/空/无来源/重试 六态状态机全部可达,是 AI 界面的终验。
components/ai-suggestion-chips.reasonEn: Next stop on the "AI Interface Patterns" path: The finale is always state completeness: a six-state machine of loading/partial/error/empty/no-source/retry, all reachable — the final acceptance of an AI interface.

components/ai-suggestion-chips.reasonZh: 属于路径「AI 界面工程」第 5 步
components/ai-suggestion-chips.reasonEn: Step 5 of the "AI Interface Patterns" path

components/ai-thinking-indicator.reasonZh: 搭配:思考指示器的形态升降级就按 NN/g 三限画档(0.1/1/10s),而 1s 恰是 Doherty 阈值的邻居——两条时间线在等待分层上互补成套。
components/ai-thinking-indicator.reasonEn: Pairs with: The thinking indicator's form tiers follow NN/g's three limits (0.1/1/10s), and 1s sits right at Doherty's doorstep — the two timelines complement each other as one wait-layering kit.

components/ai-thinking-indicator.reasonZh: 路径「AI 界面工程」的下一站:从「文本流」升维到「组件流」:由 JSON Schema 流式渲染可交互卡,是意图范式的官方实现路径(AI SDK 生成式 UI / Ant Design X)。
components/ai-thinking-indicator.reasonEn: Next stop on the "AI Interface Patterns" path: Upgrade from text streams to component streams: rendering an interactive card from streamed JSON Schema is the official implementation path of the intent paradigm (AI SDK generative UI / Ant Design X).

components/ai-thinking-indicator.reasonZh: 属于路径「AI 界面工程」第 2 步
components/ai-thinking-indicator.reasonEn: Step 2 of the "AI Interface Patterns" path

components/alert.reasonZh: 对比:反馈三分职责的两极:警告是文档流内的驻留警示块、默认不自动消失,toast 是浮层堆栈、到期即撤——MUI 的 Snackbar/Alert/Dialog 三分在两页各讲一半。
components/alert.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two poles of the feedback trio: the alert is an in-flow resident warning that never auto-dismisses, the toast is a floating stack that expires — MUI's Snackbar/Alert/Dialog split is told across both pages.

components/alert.reasonZh: 对比:常驻小件二选一:警告块是必须被读完的驻留警示,标签是常挂的状态标注——tag 条目明诫「别把标签当提醒用」,反馈请走 alert/toast。
components/alert.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two resident minis: the alert block is a warning that must be read, the tag is a standing status label — the tag entry explicitly warns 'don't use tags as reminders'.

components/alert.reasonZh: 反向自「图标」的精选:搭配关系,原句「警告块的「颜色+图标」双通道兜底就是图标的 currentColor 机制:一处变色、文字与图标同步——icon 条目给机制,alert 条目给用法。」
components/alert.reasonEn: Reverse from "Icon" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The alert's color+icon dual channel is currentColor at work: one color change moves text and icon together — the mechanism in the icon entry, the usage in the alert entry."

components/avatar.reasonZh: 搭配:小尺寸头像认不出全名——悬停浮出姓名气泡正是 tooltip 条目里的 GitHub 协作者头像组案例,轻量标识放大器。
components/avatar.reasonEn: Pairs with: Small avatars can't show full names — hover name bubbles are exactly the GitHub collaborator case in the tooltip entry, the lightweight identity amplifier.

components/avatar.reasonZh: 搭配:头像组的溢出折叠成 +N 徽标:重叠栈管展示、徽标管计数——badge 条目开篇就写明徽标必须寄生在头像这类宿主上。
components/avatar.reasonEn: Pairs with: An avatar group folds its overflow into a +N badge: the overlap stack shows, the badge counts — the badge entry opens by stating badges must parasitize hosts like avatars.

components/avatar.reasonZh: 反向自「逻辑属性」的精选:搭配关系,原句「组件层已在消费逻辑属性:头像组的负重叠间距用 margin-inline-start 写——dir 翻转时重叠方向自动镜像,组件代码零改动。」
components/avatar.reasonEn: Reverse from "Logical Properties" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Components already consume logical syntax: the avatar group's negative overlap margin is margin-inline-start — a dir flip mirrors the overlap automatically with zero component changes."

components/badge.reasonZh: 搭配:GitHub 仓库页的一级分区就是「标签轴 + 计数徽标」:徽标把未读/打开数常驻在入口上,tabs 条目实录了这条带计数徽标的标签轴。
components/badge.reasonEn: Pairs with: GitHub's repo header is 'tab axis + count badges': badges pin unread/open counts onto entries — the tabs entry documents that count-bearing tab axis.

components/badge.reasonZh: 对比:徽标必寄生宿主、只报计数信号,标签是独立的行内小容器、常驻标注状态与属性——计数用 badge,标注用 tag,别混用。
components/badge.reasonEn: Contrasts: Badges must parasitize a host and only report counts; tags are independent inline mini-containers labeling state and attributes — counts to badge, labels to tag.

components/badge.reasonZh: 反向自「头像」的精选:搭配关系,原句「头像组的溢出折叠成 +N 徽标:重叠栈管展示、徽标管计数——badge 条目开篇就写明徽标必须寄生在头像这类宿主上。」
components/badge.reasonEn: Reverse from "Avatar" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "An avatar group folds its overflow into a +N badge: the overlap stack shows, the badge counts — the badge entry opens by stating badges must parasitize hosts like avatars."

components/breadcrumb.reasonZh: 对比:同是定位件而方向相反:导航条分组归类全站信息、负责「换区」,面包屑只沿层级路径「上楼」——两者并用不互替,先分清再上页面。
components/breadcrumb.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both locate you, in opposite directions: the nav bar groups site-wide info and handles 'changing areas', breadcrumbs only climb the hierarchy — complementary, never substitutes.

components/breadcrumb.reasonZh: 对比:页内导航的两种心智:标签轴在同级分区横切(GitHub 仓库页头部),面包屑沿父子层级纵向回退——序列与层级二选一。
components/breadcrumb.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two in-page navigation minds: the tab axis cuts across sibling sections (GitHub's repo header), breadcrumbs climb the parent-child hierarchy — sequence vs hierarchy.

components/breadcrumb.reasonZh: 反向自「下拉菜单」的精选:搭配关系,原句「资源管理器地址栏的「面包屑 + 下拉」混合形态:段间箭头展开同层兄弟目录——动作菜单语义嫁接到层级路径上。」
components/breadcrumb.reasonEn: Reverse from "Dropdown" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Explorer's address bar is the 'breadcrumb + dropdown' hybrid: per-segment arrows unfold same-level siblings — action-menu semantics grafted onto a hierarchy path."

components/button.reasonZh: 搭配:对话框是按钮纪律的考场:可见关闭钮、Esc 等价路径、确认主按钮的层级都在 modal 条目落位——按钮先读懂,弹层里的按钮组才不翻车。
components/button.reasonEn: Pairs with: Dialogs are the exam room for button discipline: visible close, Esc equivalence and confirm-button hierarchy all land in the modal entry.

components/button.reasonZh: 搭配:图标按钮是两者的交界:icon-only 必须补 aria-label、热区按 Fitts 配 32px+——icon 条目把触控目标的账算好了。
components/button.reasonEn: Pairs with: Icon buttons are where the two meet: icon-only needs an aria-label and a 32px+ Fitts-sized hit area — the icon entry does that math.

components/button.reasonZh: 反向自「卡片」的精选:搭配关系,原句「卡片是容器不是控件:操作区按钮守「每屏只保留一个 primary」,整卡可点靠卡内真链接——容器与按钮的分工在两页对齐。」
components/button.reasonEn: Reverse from "Card" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The card is a container, not a control: action buttons keep 'one primary per screen' and whole-card clicks ride a real link — the division is aligned across both entries."

components/card.reasonZh: 搭配:卡片是容器不是控件:操作区按钮守「每屏只保留一个 primary」,整卡可点靠卡内真链接——容器与按钮的分工在两页对齐。
components/card.reasonEn: Pairs with: The card is a container, not a control: action buttons keep 'one primary per screen' and whole-card clicks ride a real link — the division is aligned across both entries.

components/card.reasonZh: 搭配:GitHub About 卡的 topics 就是卡内标签组:属性标注交给 tag,同一界面彩色标签 ≤3 种颜色的节制也写在 tag 条目。
components/card.reasonEn: Pairs with: The GitHub About card's topics are in-card tags: attribute labeling goes to tag, with the ≤3 colors per interface restraint written in the tag entry.

components/card.reasonZh: 反向自「水印」的精选:搭配关系,原句「水印 demo 的宿主就是一张内容卡:卡片是四段式容器、水印层 aria-hidden 平铺其上——正文卡与装饰层的分工。」
components/card.reasonEn: Reverse from "Watermark" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The watermark demo's host is a content card: the card is a four-part container and the watermark layer, aria-hidden, tiles above it — content card vs decoration layer."

components/cascader.reasonZh: 对比:选择器家族二选一:扁平枚举用 Select,树形层级用 Cascader——Select 条目自己把级联列为「典型复合用法」,边界写在明处。
components/cascader.reasonEn: Contrasts: A family choice: flat enums go to Select, tree hierarchies go to Cascader — the Select entry itself lists cascade as its typical composite use.

components/cascader.reasonZh: 搭配:级联的 multiple 模式把勾选标记搬进浮层、已选项以标签回显——组语义、勾选播报的底座在 checkbox 条目。
components/cascader.reasonEn: Pairs with: Cascade's multiple mode moves check marks into the popup and echoes picks as tags — the base semantics of groups and check announcements live in the checkbox entry.

components/cascader.reasonZh: 反向自「日期选择器」的精选:对比关系,原句「同为「触发器 + 浮层」选择器:月历是 7 列 grid 单层,级联是逐级多列重建——浮层结构的两种形态对照。」
components/cascader.reasonEn: Reverse from "Date Picker" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both trigger-plus-popup pickers: the month calendar is a single 7-column grid, the cascade rebuilds column by column — two popup structures side by side."

components/checkbox.reasonZh: 对比:表单二值控件二选一:多选组报「选了哪几项」,开关报「这一项开没开」——开关的可访问名称恒定铁律在 switch 条目。
components/checkbox.reasonEn: Contrasts: A binary-control choice: the checkbox group reports 'which ones', the switch reports 'is this one on' — the constant-accessible-name iron law lives in the switch entry.

components/checkbox.reasonZh: 搭配:同一张表单里的邻居:多选组的组播报与输入框的状态文案播报共用一套 aria 管线——字段级无障碍在 input 条目逐条展开。
components/checkbox.reasonEn: Pairs with: Neighbors on the same form: the group's announcements and the field's status messages share one aria pipeline — field-level accessibility unfolds in the input entry.

components/checkbox.reasonZh: 反向自「级联选择」的精选:搭配关系,原句「级联的 multiple 模式把勾选标记搬进浮层、已选项以标签回显——组语义、勾选播报的底座在 checkbox 条目。」
components/checkbox.reasonEn: Reverse from "Cascader" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Cascade's multiple mode moves check marks into the popup and echoes picks as tags — the base semantics of groups and check announcements live in the checkbox entry."

components/collapse-panel.reasonZh: 对比:同管「内容可见性」二选一:标签页预载全部面板、切换只改显示;折叠面板默认全收、按需展开——平铺与收纳两种信息策略。
components/collapse-panel.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two ways to own content visibility: tabs preload all panels and switching only changes display; accordions collapse by default and expand on demand.

components/collapse-panel.reasonZh: 对比:都把「更多」收进触发器,收的东西不同:折叠面板就地展开内容,下拉浮层展开的是动作命令——APG 对 menu button 的定义划出边界。
components/collapse-panel.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both tuck 'more' behind a trigger, but what unfolds differs: accordions reveal content in place, dropdowns reveal a list of action commands — APG's menu-button definition draws the line.

components/collapse-panel.reasonZh: 反向自「抽屉」的精选:对比关系,原句「都做就地展开,重轻有别:折叠面板收放「标题行+内容区」的正文段落,抽屉承载留在主任务上下文的重子任务——同一根轴的两档。」
components/collapse-panel.reasonEn: Reverse from "Drawer" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both expand in place, at different weights: accordions fold body sections under a title row, drawers carry heavy subtasks that stay in the main context — two tiers of one axis."

components/command-palette.reasonZh: 对比:同是「触发器呼出列表」:下拉是定点动作菜单、方向键漫游,命令面板是可搜索的 combobox + listbox——规模与召回不同,选型对照读。
components/command-palette.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both are trigger-summoned lists: the dropdown is a pinned action menu with roving arrows, the palette a searchable combobox+listbox — different scale, read as a selection guide.

components/command-palette.reasonZh: 先修:命令面板的语义骨架就是一个输入框:先懂 label 关联、清空、占位这些 textbox 基本语义,combobox 弹层才读得动。
components/command-palette.reasonEn: Requires: The palette's semantic skeleton is an input: understand label binding, clearing and placeholder textbox basics first, or the combobox popup won't parse.

components/command-palette.reasonZh: 反向自「选择器」的精选:对比关系,原句「同一 APG「Combobox with Listbox Popup」模式的两种规模:select 选定枚举值,命令面板子序列搜全站命令——选项多到要搜索时升级。」
components/command-palette.reasonEn: Reverse from "Select" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two scales of one APG 'Combobox with Listbox Popup' pattern: select fixes an enum value, the palette subsequence-searches site-wide commands — escalate when options need search."

components/date-picker.reasonZh: 对比:同为「触发器 + 浮层」选择器:月历是 7 列 grid 单层,级联是逐级多列重建——浮层结构的两种形态对照。
components/date-picker.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both trigger-plus-popup pickers: the month calendar is a single 7-column grid, the cascade rebuilds column by column — two popup structures side by side.

components/date-picker.reasonZh: 搭配:同族选择器共享一套规格:浮层阴影两页逐字同取 antd 浮层主阴影 token,触发器同走 24/32/40px 三档——家族 token 在 select 条目对表。
components/date-picker.reasonEn: Pairs with: The picker family shares specs: both popups take antd's family boxShadow token verbatim and triggers share the 24/32/40px tiers — tokens tabulated in the select entry.

components/date-picker.reasonZh: 反向自「输入框」的精选:搭配关系,原句「日期选择器的触发器就是一枚受控输入框:选中即回填字段、Esc 还焦点——字段规范在 input,回填行为在 date-picker。」
components/date-picker.reasonEn: Reverse from "Input" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The date picker's trigger is a controlled input: picking fills the field, Esc returns focus — field rules in input, the fill behavior in date-picker."

components/drawer.reasonZh: 对比:都做就地展开,重轻有别:折叠面板收放「标题行+内容区」的正文段落,抽屉承载留在主任务上下文的重子任务——同一根轴的两档。
components/drawer.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both expand in place, at different weights: accordions fold body sections under a title row, drawers carry heavy subtasks that stay in the main context — two tiers of one axis.

components/drawer.reasonZh: 对比:浮层面板二选一:模态盖住页面、外部内容 inert;抽屉贴边滑入、mask=off 时页面仍可交互——打断强度在这条边界上定。
components/drawer.reasonEn: Contrasts: A floating-panel choice: modals cover the page with outside content inert; drawers slide in from an edge and with mask off the page stays interactive.

components/drawer.reasonZh: 反向自「安全区 Safe Area」的精选:搭配关系,原句「safe-area 留边的典型受让对象:drawer 的 bottom sheet 从视口底缘长出、自带底部「确定/重置」操作行——env(safe-area-inset-bottom) 要让开的正是这一段。」
components/drawer.reasonEn: Reverse from "Safe Area Insets" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "A typical recipient of safe-area insets: the drawer's bottom sheet grows from the viewport's bottom edge with its own confirm/reset row — exactly what env(safe-area-inset-bottom) must clear."

components/dropdown.reasonZh: 搭配:资源管理器地址栏的「面包屑 + 下拉」混合形态:段间箭头展开同层兄弟目录——动作菜单语义嫁接到层级路径上。
components/dropdown.reasonEn: Pairs with: Explorer's address bar is the 'breadcrumb + dropdown' hybrid: per-segment arrows unfold same-level siblings — action-menu semantics grafted onto a hierarchy path.

components/dropdown.reasonZh: 搭配:导航菜单的二级项就聚合在下拉菜单里,头像用户菜单挂同一套 menu 语义——dropdown 的触发器+浮层骨架是导航的直接零件。
components/dropdown.reasonEn: Pairs with: A nav's second level aggregates inside dropdown menus, and the avatar user menu mounts the same menu semantics — the dropdown's trigger+popup skeleton is the nav's direct part.

components/dropdown.reasonZh: 反向自「折叠面板」的精选:对比关系,原句「都把「更多」收进触发器,收的东西不同:折叠面板就地展开内容,下拉浮层展开的是动作命令——APG 对 menu button 的定义划出边界。」
components/dropdown.reasonEn: Reverse from "Collapse" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both tuck 'more' behind a trigger, but what unfolds differs: accordions reveal content in place, dropdowns reveal a list of action commands — APG's menu-button definition draws the line."

components/empty.reasonZh: 搭配:容器嵌空态的标准现场:表格无数据时整表被空态卡替换、读屏不必先听完表结构——empty 的「替换者」原则在 table 条目落地。
components/empty.reasonEn: Pairs with: The standard container-embeds-empty scene: with zero rows the whole table is replaced by the empty card, so screen readers skip the table structure — the 'replacer' principle lands in the table entry.

components/empty.reasonZh: 搭配:空态卡的标题/说明/次级文案就是一套小排印:标题 16px、说明 13–14px、caption 只用于时间戳与备注——档位表在 typography 条目。
components/empty.reasonEn: Pairs with: The empty card's title/description/secondary text is a small type system: 16px title, 13–14px description, caption only for timestamps and notes — the tier table lives in the typography entry.

components/empty.reasonZh: 属于路径「AI 界面工程」第 7 步
components/empty.reasonEn: Step 7 of the "AI Interface Patterns" path

components/icon.reasonZh: 搭配:警告块的「颜色+图标」双通道兜底就是图标的 currentColor 机制:一处变色、文字与图标同步——icon 条目给机制,alert 条目给用法。
components/icon.reasonEn: Pairs with: The alert's color+icon dual channel is currentColor at work: one color change moves text and icon together — the mechanism in the icon entry, the usage in the alert entry.

components/icon.reasonZh: 搭配:图标按钮挂小红点是最常见的宿主组合:dot 形态去掉数字、缩成圆点,只报「有新内容」——icon 与 badge 的寄生关系。
components/icon.reasonEn: Pairs with: An icon button with a red dot is the most common host pairing: the dot form drops the number into a circle, signaling only 'something new'.

components/icon.reasonZh: 反向自「按钮」的精选:搭配关系,原句「图标按钮是两者的交界:icon-only 必须补 aria-label、热区按 Fitts 配 32px+——icon 条目把触控目标的账算好了。」
components/icon.reasonEn: Reverse from "Button" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Icon buttons are where the two meet: icon-only needs an aria-label and a 32px+ Fitts-sized hit area — the icon entry does that math."

components/input.reasonZh: 搭配:可清空、状态边框、占位色——这些字段语义在 Select 家族整体复用;combobox 的「探索不丢选择」键盘契约也从输入侧延伸。
components/input.reasonEn: Pairs with: Clearable, status borders, placeholder color — field semantics reused wholesale by the Select family; the combobox 'explore without losing your pick' keyboard contract extends from the input side.

components/input.reasonZh: 搭配:日期选择器的触发器就是一枚受控输入框:选中即回填字段、Esc 还焦点——字段规范在 input,回填行为在 date-picker。
components/input.reasonEn: Pairs with: The date picker's trigger is a controlled input: picking fills the field, Esc returns focus — field rules in input, the fill behavior in date-picker.

components/input.reasonZh: 路径「无障碍必修」的下一站:收官用最难的媒体类型(图表)综合运用前四步:复杂图像要有文本替代与数据表,色彩不单独承载含义。
components/input.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Accessibility Essentials" path: Close with the hardest medium, charts, to exercise all four previous steps: complex images need text alternatives and data tables, and color never carries meaning alone.

components/modal.reasonZh: 搭配:弹层之上有水印吗:antd inherit=true 时水印传导到 Modal/Drawer 之上——模态条目讲遮罩层,水印条目讲它压在谁上面。
components/modal.reasonEn: Pairs with: Should watermarking sit above overlays: with antd inherit=true the watermark propagates above Modal/Drawer — the modal entry owns the mask layer, the watermark entry owns what covers it.

components/modal.reasonZh: 对比:反馈打断阶梯的两档:模态拦下一切直到你选择,toast 不夺焦点、到期自动消失——需要打断就升级 alertdialog,这条阶梯两页各占一段。
components/modal.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two rungs of the interruption ladder: the modal blocks everything until you choose, the toast never steals focus and expires — escalate to alertdialog when you must interrupt.

components/modal.reasonZh: 反向自「按钮」的精选:搭配关系,原句「对话框是按钮纪律的考场:可见关闭钮、Esc 等价路径、确认主按钮的层级都在 modal 条目落位——按钮先读懂,弹层里的按钮组才不翻车。」
components/modal.reasonEn: Reverse from "Button" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Dialogs are the exam room for button discipline: visible close, Esc equivalence and confirm-button hierarchy all land in the modal entry."

components/nav-menu.reasonZh: 对比:导航与标签轴常被混用:导航跳页换区,标签轴在页面内换面板(浏览器「每个标签一个页面」是隐喻源头)——层级不同,别互相顶替。
components/nav-menu.reasonEn: Contrasts: Nav and tab axes get conflated: navigation jumps pages, tab axes swap panels inside one page (the browser tab is the metaphor's source) — different levels, don't substitute.

components/nav-menu.reasonZh: 搭配:导航条右端的头像按钮挂着用户菜单:头像本身不做导航、只作为菜单锚点——导航条与头像菜单的组合范式。
components/nav-menu.reasonEn: Pairs with: The avatar button at the nav's end hosts the user menu: the avatar doesn't navigate, it only anchors the menu — the nav-plus-avatar-menu pattern.

components/nav-menu.reasonZh: 反向自「面包屑」的精选:对比关系,原句「同是定位件而方向相反:导航条分组归类全站信息、负责「换区」,面包屑只沿层级路径「上楼」——两者并用不互替,先分清再上页面。」
components/nav-menu.reasonEn: Reverse from "Breadcrumb" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both locate you, in opposite directions: the nav bar groups site-wide info and handles 'changing areas', breadcrumbs only climb the hierarchy — complementary, never substitutes."

components/rate-score.reasonZh: 搭配:星级档位含义可走 tooltip 承载,但底线写明:任何「不看提示就做不对」的信息都不该只住在 tooltip 里——评分的文字回显是硬要求。
components/rate-score.reasonEn: Pairs with: Star-tier meanings may ride tooltips, with the floor stated: nothing that 'can't be done right without the tip' should live only in a tooltip — textual echo of the score is mandatory.

components/rate-score.reasonZh: 搭配:星形就是图标字形:灰底星描边档、金填充星着色档——SF Symbols 的「颜色由 tint 驱动」与评分的激活色是同一套机制。
components/rate-score.reasonEn: Pairs with: Stars are icon glyphs: gray base stars stroked, gold fill stars tinted — SF Symbols' tint-driven color and the rating's active color are one mechanism.

components/rate-score.reasonZh: 反向自「开关」的精选:对比关系,原句「「一击即改」输入的二选一:开关只有二态、即改即生效;评分带档位与撤销(「再点一次撤销」)——值域不同,反馈语义也不同。」
components/rate-score.reasonEn: Reverse from "Switch" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "A one-tap-input choice: the switch is binary and applies instantly; the rating has tiers plus undo ('click again to clear') — different value ranges, different feedback."

components/select.reasonZh: 对比:同一「触发按钮 + 浮层」骨架的两种语义:选择器选「值」并回填,下拉发「动作」即执行——选值与命令二选一。
components/select.reasonEn: Contrasts: One trigger-plus-popup skeleton, two semantics: the select picks a value and fills it back, the dropdown fires an action — value vs command.

components/select.reasonZh: 对比:同一 APG「Combobox with Listbox Popup」模式的两种规模:select 选定枚举值,命令面板子序列搜全站命令——选项多到要搜索时升级。
components/select.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two scales of one APG 'Combobox with Listbox Popup' pattern: select fixes an enum value, the palette subsequence-searches site-wide commands — escalate when options need search.

components/select.reasonZh: 反向自「级联选择」的精选:对比关系,原句「选择器家族二选一:扁平枚举用 Select,树形层级用 Cascader——Select 条目自己把级联列为「典型复合用法」,边界写在明处。」
components/select.reasonEn: Reverse from "Cascader" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "A family choice: flat enums go to Select, tree hierarchies go to Cascader — the Select entry itself lists cascade as its typical composite use."

components/stepper.reasonZh: 先修:步骤头就是一枚枚原生按钮:aria-label 带状态、Enter/Space 激活——先懂按钮的免费键盘语义,步骤条的可点性才立得住。
components/stepper.reasonEn: Requires: Step heads are native buttons: aria-labels carry state, Enter/Space activate — understand the button's free keyboard semantics before step-bar interactivity makes sense.

components/stepper.reasonZh: 对比:都按序叙事而方向相反:步骤条是前瞻的「承诺清单」,时间线是回溯的事件记录(正序符合流程叙事、适合步骤复盘)。
components/stepper.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both narrate in order, opposite directions: the stepper is a forward-looking promise list, the timeline a retrospective event log (forward order suits step retrospectives).

components/stepper.reasonZh: 反向自「标签页」的精选:对比关系,原句「都把内容分成命名区块:标签轴面板平级、随时横跳;步骤条只在线性主线上、有先后与回退规则(回退必须保留已填数据)。」
components/stepper.reasonEn: Reverse from "Tabs" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both split content into named blocks: tab panels are peers you can jump between freely; steppers walk one linear main line with order and return rules (returns must keep entered data)."

components/switch.reasonZh: 先修:拨杆本体就是原生 button 加 role="switch":全部交互语义由按钮承担、Space 免费给——不另写键盘代码。
components/switch.reasonEn: Requires: The switch's lever is a native button with role="switch": button semantics carry all interaction and Space comes free — no extra keyboard code.

components/switch.reasonZh: 对比:「一击即改」输入的二选一:开关只有二态、即改即生效;评分带档位与撤销(「再点一次撤销」)——值域不同,反馈语义也不同。
components/switch.reasonEn: Contrasts: A one-tap-input choice: the switch is binary and applies instantly; the rating has tiers plus undo ('click again to clear') — different value ranges, different feedback.

components/switch.reasonZh: 反向自「多选框」的精选:对比关系,原句「表单二值控件二选一:多选组报「选了哪几项」,开关报「这一项开没开」——开关的可访问名称恒定铁律在 switch 条目。」
components/switch.reasonEn: Reverse from "Checkbox" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "A binary-control choice: the checkbox group reports 'which ones', the switch reports 'is this one on' — the constant-accessible-name iron law lives in the switch entry."

components/table.reasonZh: 搭配:表格行内的类别/状态标注就是 tag 的行内用法:GitHub 用固定颜色区分 issue 类别——彩色小标签让扫读行不串义。
components/table.reasonEn: Pairs with: In-row category/status labels are tags at row scale: GitHub tells issue categories apart with fixed colors — small color labels keep row scanning honest.

components/table.reasonZh: 搭配:单元格的超长文本靠省略三件套压行、title 补全文——typography 条目把「长列表单元格不用省略会撑破栅格」写成对照。
components/table.reasonEn: Pairs with: Overlong cell text compresses via the ellipsis trio with title carrying the full text — the typography entry tables 'long list cells burst the grid without ellipsis'.

components/table.reasonZh: 反向自「空状态」的精选:搭配关系,原句「容器嵌空态的标准现场:表格无数据时整表被空态卡替换、读屏不必先听完表结构——empty 的「替换者」原则在 table 条目落地。」
components/table.reasonEn: Reverse from "Empty" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The standard container-embeds-empty scene: with zero rows the whole table is replaced by the empty card, so screen readers skip the table structure — the 'replacer' principle lands in the table entry."

components/tabs.reasonZh: 对比:都把内容分成命名区块:标签轴面板平级、随时横跳;步骤条只在线性主线上、有先后与回退规则(回退必须保留已填数据)。
components/tabs.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both split content into named blocks: tab panels are peers you can jump between freely; steppers walk one linear main line with order and return rules (returns must keep entered data).

components/tabs.reasonZh: 反向自「徽标数」的精选:搭配关系,原句「GitHub 仓库页的一级分区就是「标签轴 + 计数徽标」:徽标把未读/打开数常驻在入口上,tabs 条目实录了这条带计数徽标的标签轴。」
components/tabs.reasonEn: Reverse from "Badge" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "GitHub's repo header is 'tab axis + count badges': badges pin unread/open counts onto entries — the tabs entry documents that count-bearing tab axis."

components/tabs.reasonZh: 反向自「面包屑」的精选:对比关系,原句「页内导航的两种心智:标签轴在同级分区横切(GitHub 仓库页头部),面包屑沿父子层级纵向回退——序列与层级二选一。」
components/tabs.reasonEn: Reverse from "Breadcrumb" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two in-page navigation minds: the tab axis cuts across sibling sections (GitHub's repo header), breadcrumbs climb the parent-child hierarchy — sequence vs hierarchy."

components/tag.reasonZh: 对比:标注件与提醒件分域:标签常驻标注状态,自动消失的反馈属于 toast——且「关键信息永远不走 toast,走持久 banner」。
components/tag.reasonEn: Contrasts: Labels and reminders live in different domains: tags annotate standing state, auto-dismissing feedback belongs to toast — and critical info never rides a toast.

components/tag.reasonZh: 反向自「警告提示」的精选:对比关系,原句「常驻小件二选一:警告块是必须被读完的驻留警示,标签是常挂的状态标注——tag 条目明诫「别把标签当提醒用」,反馈请走 alert/toast。」
components/tag.reasonEn: Reverse from "Alert" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two resident minis: the alert block is a warning that must be read, the tag is a standing status label — the tag entry explicitly warns 'don't use tags as reminders'."

components/tag.reasonZh: 反向自「徽标数」的精选:对比关系,原句「徽标必寄生宿主、只报计数信号,标签是独立的行内小容器、常驻标注状态与属性——计数用 badge,标注用 tag,别混用。」
components/tag.reasonEn: Reverse from "Badge" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Badges must parasitize a host and only report counts; tags are independent inline mini-containers labeling state and attributes — counts to badge, labels to tag."

components/timeline.reasonZh: 搭配:时间线的加载点是「加载中图标旋转」的现成例外:静态字形纪律之外唯一常见动效——旋转停了,状态改由文字承载。
components/timeline.reasonEn: Pairs with: The timeline's loading dot is the canonical exception to 'icons are static glyphs': the one common animation — and when spin stops, text carries the state.

components/timeline.reasonZh: 搭配:「时间/标题/描述」三层小字就是聊天列表式三层文字:字号与颜色深浅直接编码优先级——排印档位在 typography 条目。
components/timeline.reasonEn: Pairs with: Time/title/description is a chat-list-style three-layer text stack: size and color depth encode priority directly — the tiers live in the typography entry.

components/timeline.reasonZh: 反向自「步骤条」的精选:对比关系,原句「都按序叙事而方向相反:步骤条是前瞻的「承诺清单」,时间线是回溯的事件记录(正序符合流程叙事、适合步骤复盘)。」
components/timeline.reasonEn: Reverse from "Steps" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both narrate in order, opposite directions: the stepper is a forward-looking promise list, the timeline a retrospective event log (forward order suits step retrospectives)."

components/toast.reasonZh: 对比:同为不打断的浮层而职责相反:tooltip 是悬停说明、纯文本短句不夺焦点;toast 报告操作结果、到期消失——说明与结果二选一。
components/toast.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both non-blocking floaters with opposite jobs: tooltips hover-explain as plain text that never takes focus, toasts report outcomes and expire — explanation vs result.

components/toast.reasonZh: 搭配:上传的非阻断反馈就是 toast 语义:上限提示「短提示后自动消失,不阻断已上传文件」——失败重试另有行内通路。
components/toast.reasonEn: Pairs with: Upload's non-blocking feedback is toast semantics: the limit notice 'auto-dismisses shortly without blocking uploaded files' — failures retry inline instead.

components/toast.reasonZh: 反向自「警告提示」的精选:对比关系,原句「反馈三分职责的两极:警告是文档流内的驻留警示块、默认不自动消失,toast 是浮层堆栈、到期即撤——MUI 的 Snackbar/Alert/Dialog 三分在两页各讲一半。」
components/toast.reasonEn: Reverse from "Alert" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two poles of the feedback trio: the alert is an in-flow resident warning that never auto-dismisses, the toast is a floating stack that expires — MUI's Snackbar/Alert/Dialog split is told across both pages."

components/tooltip.reasonZh: 对比:一句话分清:tooltip 承载只读说明、Esc 即藏;dropdown 承载可点操作、Esc 关闭并把焦点还给触发钮——说明与动作二选一。
components/tooltip.reasonEn: Contrasts: One sentence apart: tooltips hold read-only text and hide on Esc; dropdowns hold clickable actions, and Esc closes while returning focus to the trigger.

components/tooltip.reasonZh: 搭配:被省略文本的全文出口就是 tooltip:typography 的省略惯例写明「截断处补 title(或 ellipsis 的 tooltip)承载全文」。
components/tooltip.reasonEn: Pairs with: The full text of truncated copy exits through a tooltip: the typography entry's ellipsis convention says 'patch a title (or ellipsis tooltip) at the cut to carry the full text'.

components/tooltip.reasonZh: 反向自「锚点定位 Anchor Positioning」的精选:搭配关系,原句「tooltip 的「触发元素+气泡」在原生 CSS 有了专用引擎:anchor-name/position-area 把绝对定位量测换成声明式九宫格选位与溢出翻面。」
components/tooltip.reasonEn: Reverse from "CSS Anchor Positioning" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The tooltip's trigger-plus-bubble gets a native CSS engine: anchor-name and position-area replace measured absolute positioning with declarative placement and overflow flip."

components/typography.reasonZh: 搭配:文字旁的图标以 1em 与文字天然等高(antd width/height=1em)——字阶与图标尺寸共享一套底数,混排不破基线。
components/typography.reasonEn: Pairs with: Icons beside text ride 1em to sit naturally equal in height (antd width/height=1em) — type scale and icon size share one base so baselines survive mixing.

components/typography.reasonZh: 反向自「空状态」的精选:搭配关系,原句「空态卡的标题/说明/次级文案就是一套小排印:标题 16px、说明 13–14px、caption 只用于时间戳与备注——档位表在 typography 条目。」
components/typography.reasonEn: Reverse from "Empty" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The empty card's title/description/secondary text is a small type system: 16px title, 13–14px description, caption only for timestamps and notes — the tier table lives in the typography entry."

components/typography.reasonZh: 反向自「表格」的精选:搭配关系,原句「单元格的超长文本靠省略三件套压行、title 补全文——typography 条目把「长列表单元格不用省略会撑破栅格」写成对照。」
components/typography.reasonEn: Reverse from "Table" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Overlong cell text compresses via the ellipsis trio with title carrying the full text — the typography entry tables 'long list cells burst the grid without ellipsis'."

components/upload-states.reasonZh: 对比:长任务别关进模态:Carbon 明诫模态框里别放多文件上传——与「内容超过两屏改用抽屉或页面」是同一条边界。
components/upload-states.reasonEn: Contrasts: Don't cage long tasks in a modal: Carbon explicitly warns against multi-file upload inside one — the same line as 'past two screens, move to a drawer or page'.

components/upload-states.reasonZh: 搭配:上传入口是一枚真按钮:Space/Enter 打开选择框,对话框关闭后焦点回触发元素——按钮条目的「关闭则回触发按钮」是键盘底线。
components/upload-states.reasonEn: Pairs with: The upload entry is a real button: Space/Enter opens the picker and focus returns to the trigger on close — the button entry's 'on close, return to the trigger button' is the keyboard floor.

components/upload-states.reasonZh: 反向自「全局提示」的精选:搭配关系,原句「上传的非阻断反馈就是 toast 语义:上限提示「短提示后自动消失,不阻断已上传文件」——失败重试另有行内通路。」
components/upload-states.reasonEn: Reverse from "Toast" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Upload's non-blocking feedback is toast semantics: the limit notice 'auto-dismisses shortly without blocking uploaded files' — failures retry inline instead."

components/watermark.reasonZh: 搭配:水印 demo 的宿主就是一张内容卡:卡片是四段式容器、水印层 aria-hidden 平铺其上——正文卡与装饰层的分工。
components/watermark.reasonEn: Pairs with: The watermark demo's host is a content card: the card is a four-part container and the watermark layer, aria-hidden, tiles above it — content card vs decoration layer.

components/watermark.reasonZh: 搭配:水印层与装饰图标同守一条纪律:aria-hidden、不承载必读信息、读屏跳过——装饰层一律不进语义树。
components/watermark.reasonEn: Pairs with: The watermark layer and decorative icons share one discipline: aria-hidden, carrying no must-read info, skipped by screen readers — decoration never enters the semantic tree.

components/watermark.reasonZh: 反向自「对话框」的精选:搭配关系,原句「弹层之上有水印吗:antd inherit=true 时水印传导到 Modal/Drawer 之上——模态条目讲遮罩层,水印条目讲它压在谁上面。」
components/watermark.reasonEn: Reverse from "Modal" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Should watermarking sit above overlays: with antd inherit=true the watermark propagates above Modal/Drawer — the modal entry owns the mask layer, the watermark entry owns what covers it."

dataviz/chart-accessibility.reasonZh: 搭配:交互 tooltip 要补齐 WCAG 1.4.13 三件套(Esc 可关/可悬停/常驻)——本条目只点到为止,验收清单与实现都在图例与提示条目。
dataviz/chart-accessibility.reasonEn: Pairs with: Interactive tooltips must complete the WCAG 1.4.13 trio (Esc dismissible / hoverable / persistent) — this entry only gestures at it; the audit checklist and implementation live in the tooltip-legend entry.

dataviz/chart-accessibility.reasonZh: 搭配:贴花与直标是色相之外的第二通道,而 ECharts 的 decal 默认关、必须显式开启——模拟核查与冗余编码的完整动线在色盲安全条目。
dataviz/chart-accessibility.reasonEn: Pairs with: Decals and direct labels are the second channel beyond hue, and ECharts ships decal off by default — the full simulation-and-redundancy workflow lives in the colorblind-safe entry.

dataviz/chart-accessibility.reasonZh: 属于路径「无障碍必修」第 5 步

dataviz/chart-animation.reasonZh: 搭配:分层定律的另一半在轴条目:参考层(轴/网格)为何全程静止——「刻度在动会被误读为数据在动」的原文解释在坐标轴与网格。
dataviz/chart-animation.reasonEn: Pairs with: The other half of the layering law lives in the axes entry: why the reference layer (axes/grid) never animates — the 'moving ticks read as moving data' explanation, in its own words.

dataviz/chart-animation.reasonZh: 对比:入场三式里扫描讲「进程」,而时间点之间的精确对比是另一形态的领地——两条目把动画与小倍数定为分工而非替代。
dataviz/chart-animation.reasonEn: Contrasts: Of the three entrances, sweep tells 'progress'; precise between-time-point comparison belongs to the other form — both entries cast animation and small multiples as a division of labor.

dataviz/chart-animation.reasonZh: 反向自「图例与提示」的精选:搭配关系,原句「tooltip 的显隐与位移是图表动效预算的一部分:0.4s 过渡与入场 1000ms/hover 400ms 同表对档——动效条目把交互层浮动纳入同一纪律。」
dataviz/chart-animation.reasonEn: Reverse from "Tooltip & Legend" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Tooltip show/hide and drift belong to the chart's motion budget: the 0.4s transition is tiered in the same table as the 1000ms entrance and 400ms hover — the animation entry folds interactive floats into one discipline."

dataviz/dataviz-categorical-palette.reasonZh: 对比:姊妹条目一问之差,最易混:色板回答「有哪些颜色」,色序回答「第 i 个系列拿哪个颜色、谁是主角」——两页对读才分得清。
dataviz/dataviz-categorical-palette.reasonEn: Contrasts: Sister entries one question apart, and easily confused: the palette answers 'which colors exist', the ordering answers 'which color series i takes, who is the lead' — read both to tell them apart.

dataviz/dataviz-categorical-palette.reasonZh: 搭配:按官方顺序选好色板只是半套方案:拿不准就先过三种色觉模拟——色盲安全条目明言「只换安全色板不做冗余,是半套方案」。
dataviz/dataviz-categorical-palette.reasonEn: Pairs with: A palette picked in official order is half the plan: when unsure, run the three CVD simulations — the colorblind-safe entry says outright that a safe palette without redundancy is half a solution.

dataviz/dataviz-categorical-palette.reasonZh: 反向自「图表选型」的精选:搭配关系,原句「「数据映射变化不做渐变演出」是两页共享的准则:选型条目即时重绘的理由与分类色板条目同一句——重映射不伪装成颜色过渡。」
dataviz/dataviz-categorical-palette.reasonEn: Reverse from "Chart Selection" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "'Data remapping is not staged as a gradient' is a rule both pages share: the selection entry's instant-redraw rationale is the categorical-palette entry's own sentence — remaps never pose as color transitions."

dataviz/dataviz-chart-axes.reasonZh: 搭配:轴把标度值摆上画布:tickCount/gridOpacity 的每一档背后是一次 normalize∘interpolate——标度条目结尾把本条目列为「标度的可视呈现」。
dataviz/dataviz-chart-axes.reasonEn: Pairs with: Axes put scale outputs onto the canvas: behind every tickCount/gridOpacity tier sits a normalize∘interpolate — the scales entry lists this entry as 'the visual presentation of scales'.

dataviz/dataviz-chart-axes.reasonZh: 搭配:小面板只留基线+上限刻度+直标、不搬整排网格——小倍数条目把参考层纪律明确指回坐标轴与网格条目,两页是一条纪律的两端。
dataviz/dataviz-chart-axes.reasonEn: Pairs with: Small panels keep only baseline + top tick + direct label, not a full grid — the small-multiples entry points its reference-layer discipline back to the axes entry; two ends of one rule.

dataviz/dataviz-chart-axes.reasonZh: 反向自「图表动效」的精选:搭配关系,原句「分层定律的另一半在轴条目:参考层(轴/网格)为何全程静止——「刻度在动会被误读为数据在动」的原文解释在坐标轴与网格。」
dataviz/dataviz-chart-axes.reasonEn: Reverse from "Chart Animation" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The other half of the layering law lives in the axes entry: why the reference layer (axes/grid) never animates — the 'moving ticks read as moving data' explanation, in its own words."

dataviz/dataviz-chart-selection.reasonZh: 搭配:选型定了图形,轴域纪律接手:柱/面积零基线、折线可例外——同一 FT 判据在轴条目成文,「截断失真可算」的几何两页对照读。
dataviz/dataviz-chart-selection.reasonEn: Pairs with: Selection picks the form, then axis-domain discipline takes over: bars/areas zero-baseline, lines exempt — the same FT criterion is written up in the axes entry; read the truncation geometry across both.

dataviz/dataviz-chart-selection.reasonZh: 搭配:「数据映射变化不做渐变演出」是两页共享的准则:选型条目即时重绘的理由与分类色板条目同一句——重映射不伪装成颜色过渡。
dataviz/dataviz-chart-selection.reasonEn: Pairs with: 'Data remapping is not staged as a gradient' is a rule both pages share: the selection entry's instant-redraw rationale is the categorical-palette entry's own sentence — remaps never pose as color transitions.

dataviz/dataviz-chart-selection.reasonZh: 反向自「图例与提示」的精选:搭配关系,原句「直标还是图例,先回到选型:labels 参数给 direct/legend 两档、段高不足自动降级——jfly 原文「图上直标优于远处对色图例」是共同出处。」
dataviz/dataviz-chart-selection.reasonEn: Reverse from "Tooltip & Legend" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Direct label or legend goes back to selection: the labels parameter offers direct/legend tiers and auto-degrades on tight segments — jfly's 'label on the graph' quote is the shared source."

dataviz/dataviz-color-ordering.reasonZh: 搭配:乱序与跳色的代价要拿模拟说话:色序条目的经验法则直接指向三种色觉模拟——「模拟全过+冗余默认开」才算色盲安全。
dataviz/dataviz-color-ordering.reasonEn: Pairs with: The cost of shuffled or skipped order is settled by simulation: the ordering entry's rule of thumb points straight at the three-model check — 'all simulations pass + redundancy on' is the bar.

dataviz/dataviz-color-ordering.reasonZh: 搭配:色序的下游是读值通道:单焦点直标、多系列等权回退图例——图例缺省档 none 不是删图例,是切到直标原则,规范在图例与提示条目。
dataviz/dataviz-color-ordering.reasonEn: Pairs with: The ordering's downstream is the reading channel: direct-label a single focus, fall back to the legend for equal-weight series — the legend's none tier isn't deletion but a switch to direct labels, specified in the tooltip-legend entry.

dataviz/dataviz-color-ordering.reasonZh: 反向自「分类色板」的精选:对比关系,原句「姊妹条目一问之差,最易混:色板回答「有哪些颜色」,色序回答「第 i 个系列拿哪个颜色、谁是主角」——两页对读才分得清。」
dataviz/dataviz-color-ordering.reasonEn: Reverse from "Categorical Palette" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Sister entries one question apart, and easily confused: the palette answers 'which colors exist', the ordering answers 'which color series i takes, who is the lead' — read both to tell them apart."

dataviz/dataviz-colorblind-safe.reasonZh: 搭配:模拟核查过了关,选阶再进一步:单色亮度阶只动亮度、色盲灰度天然安全——序数色阶条目把 Blues 列为默认档。
dataviz/dataviz-colorblind-safe.reasonEn: Pairs with: Once simulation passes, go one further when picking a ramp: a monochrome luminance scale moves lightness only and is natively CVD/grayscale safe — the ordinal-scale entry makes Blues its default.

dataviz/dataviz-colorblind-safe.reasonZh: 延伸:核查通过后把安全色沉淀成语义主题:GitHub Primer 的色盲专用主题正是「换一张映射表即生成色盲模式」的工程化完整版。
dataviz/dataviz-colorblind-safe.reasonEn: Extends: After the check passes, bank the safe colors as semantic themes: GitHub Primer's colorblind-specific themes are the full engineering form of 'swap one mapping table, get a CVD mode'.

dataviz/dataviz-colorblind-safe.reasonZh: 反向自「图表无障碍」的精选:搭配关系,原句「贴花与直标是色相之外的第二通道,而 ECharts 的 decal 默认关、必须显式开启——模拟核查与冗余编码的完整动线在色盲安全条目。」
dataviz/dataviz-colorblind-safe.reasonEn: Reverse from "Chart Accessibility" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Decals and direct labels are the second channel beyond hue, and ECharts ships decal off by default — the full simulation-and-redundancy workflow lives in the colorblind-safe entry."

dataviz/dataviz-dashboard-density.reasonZh: 搭配:同一批 Grafana 源码常量(24 列/30px 行高/8px 间距)的两处落点:密度条目管仪表盘网格,小倍数条目把面板阵列讲成并排对比语义。
dataviz/dataviz-dashboard-density.reasonEn: Pairs with: The same Grafana source constants (24 cols / 30px rows / 8px gap) land in two places: density owns the dashboard grid, small-multiples reads the panel array as side-by-side comparison.

dataviz/dataviz-dashboard-density.reasonZh: 反向自「便当盒布局」的精选:搭配关系,原句「配方里的两套网格各司其职:bento 管容器构图,面板内密度交给 BI 网格口径(Grafana 8px 间距/30px 行高)。」
dataviz/dataviz-dashboard-density.reasonEn: Reverse from "Bento Grid" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Two grids with two jobs in the recipe: bento owns the container composition, in-panel density follows the BI-grid canon (Grafana 8px gap / 30px rows)."

dataviz/dataviz-dashboard-density.reasonZh: 用于配方「仪表盘数据卡」的组合条目

dataviz/dataviz-ordinal-scale.reasonZh: 搭配:色阶是映射管线的末段:t 从标度层出来后按档取色——标度条目结尾把本条目列为姊妹条目(t→色带那段)。
dataviz/dataviz-ordinal-scale.reasonEn: Pairs with: The color ramp is the last stage of the mapping pipeline: t arrives from the scale layer and picks the bin color — the scales entry lists this entry as its sister (the t→color-band stage).

dataviz/dataviz-ordinal-scale.reasonZh: 对比:都叫「色板」易混:分类色板只解决「哪个系列用哪个颜色」、整表按官方顺序取用;有序值域的分档上色是序数色阶的领地——两页对读才分得清。
dataviz/dataviz-ordinal-scale.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both are called palettes, easily confused: the categorical board only settles 'which series takes which color', drawn as one officially-ordered table; binned color for ordered value domains is the ordinal scale's territory — read both to tell them apart.

dataviz/dataviz-ordinal-scale.reasonZh: 反向自「色盲安全配色」的精选:搭配关系,原句「模拟核查过了关,选阶再进一步:单色亮度阶只动亮度、色盲灰度天然安全——序数色阶条目把 Blues 列为默认档。」
dataviz/dataviz-ordinal-scale.reasonEn: Reverse from "Colorblind-Safe Palette" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Once simulation passes, go one further when picking a ramp: a monochrome luminance scale moves lightness only and is natively CVD/grayscale safe — the ordinal-scale entry makes Blues its default."

dataviz/dataviz-tooltip-legend.reasonZh: 搭配:tooltip 的显隐与位移是图表动效预算的一部分:0.4s 过渡与入场 1000ms/hover 400ms 同表对档——动效条目把交互层浮动纳入同一纪律。
dataviz/dataviz-tooltip-legend.reasonEn: Pairs with: Tooltip show/hide and drift belong to the chart's motion budget: the 0.4s transition is tiered in the same table as the 1000ms entrance and 400ms hover — the animation entry folds interactive floats into one discipline.

dataviz/dataviz-tooltip-legend.reasonZh: 搭配:直标还是图例,先回到选型:labels 参数给 direct/legend 两档、段高不足自动降级——jfly 原文「图上直标优于远处对色图例」是共同出处。
dataviz/dataviz-tooltip-legend.reasonEn: Pairs with: Direct label or legend goes back to selection: the labels parameter offers direct/legend tiers and auto-degrades on tight segments — jfly's 'label on the graph' quote is the shared source.

dataviz/dataviz-tooltip-legend.reasonZh: 反向自「图表无障碍」的精选:搭配关系,原句「交互 tooltip 要补齐 WCAG 1.4.13 三件套(Esc 可关/可悬停/常驻)——本条目只点到为止,验收清单与实现都在图例与提示条目。」
dataviz/dataviz-tooltip-legend.reasonEn: Reverse from "Chart Accessibility" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Interactive tooltips must complete the WCAG 1.4.13 trio (Esc dismissible / hoverable / persistent) — this entry only gestures at it; the audit checklist and implementation live in the tooltip-legend entry."

dataviz/scale-functions.reasonZh: 搭配:viewProgress 归一化公式的 CSS 原生形态:scroll() 时间轴把同一套「先归一化再映射」交给浏览器——进度条 0→100% 是官方教科书用例。
dataviz/scale-functions.reasonEn: Pairs with: The CSS-native form of the viewProgress normalization: the scroll() timeline hands 'normalize first, then map' to the browser — a 0→100% progress bar is the official textbook case.

dataviz/scale-functions.reasonZh: 搭配:同构旁证的第三站:字阶的 fluidClamp 也是「先归一化再映射」——一行 clamp 就是一段线性回归,斜率与截距的推导在字阶数学条目。
dataviz/scale-functions.reasonEn: Pairs with: The third isomorphic stop: the type scale's fluidClamp is the same 'normalize then map' — one clamp line is one linear regression, with slope and intercept derived in the modular-scale entry.

dataviz/scale-functions.reasonZh: 反向自「坐标轴与网格」的精选:搭配关系,原句「轴把标度值摆上画布:tickCount/gridOpacity 的每一档背后是一次 normalize∘interpolate——标度条目结尾把本条目列为「标度的可视呈现」。」
dataviz/scale-functions.reasonEn: Reverse from "Chart Axes & Grid" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Axes put scale outputs onto the canvas: behind every tickCount/gridOpacity tier sits a normalize∘interpolate — the scales entry lists this entry as 'the visual presentation of scales'."

dataviz/small-multiples.reasonZh: 搭配:小面板没有图例的生存空间:面板标题直标系列名+最新值——「嵌入式小图 none + 直标」是图例与提示条目的经验档。
dataviz/small-multiples.reasonEn: Pairs with: Small panels have no room for a legend: the panel title direct-labels series name + latest value — 'embedded small chart: none + direct label' is the tooltip-legend entry's own rule of thumb.

dataviz/small-multiples.reasonZh: 搭配:每面板一主角 = 色序强调策略的并排版:灰底彩突出/一图一主角在单图内执行,小倍数把同一叙事按面板拆开执行。
dataviz/small-multiples.reasonEn: Pairs with: One lead per panel is the side-by-side version of the ordering's emphasis strategy: gray-context accenting runs inside one chart, small multiples split the same story across panels.

dataviz/small-multiples.reasonZh: 反向自「图表动效」的精选:对比关系,原句「入场三式里扫描讲「进程」,而时间点之间的精确对比是另一形态的领地——两条目把动画与小倍数定为分工而非替代。」
dataviz/small-multiples.reasonEn: Reverse from "Chart Animation" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Of the three entrances, sweep tells 'progress'; precise between-time-point comparison belongs to the other form — both entries cast animation and small multiples as a division of labor."

icons/favicon-stack.reasonZh: 对比:两种「换色」别混:favicon 换色是文件内嵌 @media 的静态分支(只属于 SVG 档),界面图标换色是宿主 color 一处声明全链继承。
icons/favicon-stack.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two kinds of 'recoloring' not to conflate: favicon recoloring is an in-file @media branch (SVG tier only), UI icon recoloring is one host color declaration inherited down the chain.

icons/favicon-stack.reasonZh: 搭配:favicon 清单把 icon.svg 放现代浏览器首选位——font-vs-svg 条目的结论(内嵌 SVG 没有外部失败态)正是这一档存在的理由。
icons/favicon-stack.reasonEn: Pairs with: The favicon checklist puts icon.svg first for modern browsers — the font-vs-svg verdict (inline SVG has no external failure states) is the reason that tier exists.

icons/favicon-stack.reasonZh: 反向自「图标系统设计」的精选:搭配关系,原句「图标系统定稿后的站点级出口:favicon 五件套是另一套「极小集」清单——根目录 ico、20px 内边距、409 安全圆各有硬约束。」
icons/favicon-stack.reasonEn: Reverse from "Icon System Design" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The site-level exit after an icon system ships: the favicon five-plus-one list is another minimal set — root-directory ico, 20px padding and the 409 safe circle each carry hard constraints."

icons/icon-aria-accessible.reasonZh: 搭配:摘树纪律在雪碧图上的落点:模板 svg 与引用实例同样 aria-hidden,symbol 的「结构化定义促进无障碍」由自带 viewBox 承载。
icons/icon-aria-accessible.reasonEn: Pairs with: Where tree-removal discipline lands in sprites: the template svg and its use instances are aria-hidden alike, and the symbol's structured-definition accessibility rides on its own viewBox.

icons/icon-aria-accessible.reasonZh: 搭配:规则页读完看工程化现场:名在按钮层、装饰化、48dp 热区——按钮条目把摘树红线与命名铁律做成可审计实验。
icons/icon-aria-accessible.reasonEn: Pairs with: After the rules page, the engineering floor: name on the button layer, decorative icon, 48dp target — the button entry turns the tree-removal red line and naming rules into an auditable experiment.

icons/icon-aria-accessible.reasonZh: 反向自「图标色彩与状态」的精选:搭配关系,原句「「换色不改语义」的前提是摘树纪律:装饰图标 aria-hidden、可聚焦元素红线——无障碍条目是这条注释的出处页。」
icons/icon-aria-accessible.reasonEn: Reverse from "Icon Color & States" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "'Recolor without touching semantics' presupposes tree-removal discipline: decorative icons aria-hidden, the focusable red line — the accessibility entry is the source page for that footnote."

icons/icon-button.reasonZh: 搭配:按钮有了名与热区,还要有状态对比:3:1 是状态色的硬底线——「任何状态保住 3:1,2.999:1 算失败」在状态色条目做成核算面板。
icons/icon-button.reasonEn: Pairs with: A button with a name and a target still needs state contrast: 3:1 is the hard floor — 'any state holds 3:1, 2.999:1 fails' is a live calculator in the color-states entry.

icons/icon-button.reasonZh: 搭配:按钮里的字形默认 24px,出处正是 Material 展示区——网格条目给 24/20 档与键程,按钮条目给热区(24 法定/48 舒适)。
icons/icon-button.reasonEn: Pairs with: The glyph inside a button defaults to 24px, straight from Material's display area — the grid entry supplies the 24/20 tiers and keylines, the button entry the targets (24 legal / 48 comfortable).

icons/icon-button.reasonZh: 反向自「图标语义与无障碍」的精选:搭配关系,原句「规则页读完看工程化现场:名在按钮层、装饰化、48dp 热区——按钮条目把摘树红线与命名铁律做成可审计实验。」
icons/icon-button.reasonEn: Reverse from "Icon Semantics & Accessibility" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "After the rules page, the engineering floor: name on the button layer, decorative icon, 48dp target — the button entry turns the tree-removal red line and naming rules into an auditable experiment."

icons/icon-color-states.reasonZh: 搭配:状态反馈的时间维度:换色过渡走 M3 钦定区间 150–200ms + standard 缓动——动效条目是这组 token 的出处条目。
icons/icon-color-states.reasonEn: Pairs with: The time dimension of state feedback: color transitions ride M3's mandated 150–200ms + standard easing — the motion entry is where those tokens are sourced.

icons/icon-color-states.reasonZh: 搭配:currentColor 染色契约「五套源文件均预配置」——这套契约背后的网格/线宽/许可对照矩阵在选型条目成表。
icons/icon-color-states.reasonEn: Pairs with: The currentColor contract is 'preconfigured across all five sets' — the grid/stroke-width/license comparison matrix behind that claim is tabulated in the set-selection entry.

icons/icon-color-states.reasonZh: 反向自「Favicon 体系」的精选:对比关系,原句「两种「换色」别混:favicon 换色是文件内嵌 @media 的静态分支(只属于 SVG 档),界面图标换色是宿主 color 一处声明全链继承。」
icons/icon-color-states.reasonEn: Reverse from "Favicon Stack" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two kinds of 'recoloring' not to conflate: favicon recoloring is an in-file @media branch (SVG tier only), UI icon recoloring is one host color declaration inherited down the chain."

icons/icon-font-vs-svg.reasonZh: 搭配:SVG 路线的批量交付形态:Feather 官方雪碧图外链用法是各套对照里唯一写进 README 的——symbol/use 机制在雪碧条目全量拆解。
icons/icon-font-vs-svg.reasonEn: Pairs with: The SVG route's bulk delivery form: Feather's official external sprite is the only README-documented usage across the surveyed sets — the symbol/use mechanics unfold in the sprite entry.

icons/icon-font-vs-svg.reasonZh: 搭配:「现代项目默认 inline SVG」的选型结论在六套对照里成完整矩阵:先定网格(24 还是 256),再定线宽哲学,最后核许可与维护活跃度。
icons/icon-font-vs-svg.reasonEn: Pairs with: The 'modern projects default to inline SVG' verdict becomes a full matrix in the six-set comparison: settle the grid (24 or 256) first, then the stroke-width philosophy, then license and maintenance.

icons/icon-font-vs-svg.reasonZh: 反向自「Favicon 体系」的精选:搭配关系,原句「favicon 清单把 icon.svg 放现代浏览器首选位——font-vs-svg 条目的结论(内嵌 SVG 没有外部失败态)正是这一档存在的理由。」
icons/icon-font-vs-svg.reasonEn: Reverse from "Favicon Stack" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The favicon checklist puts icon.svg first for modern browsers — the font-vs-svg verdict (inline SVG has no external failure states) is the reason that tier exists."

icons/icon-grid-24.reasonZh: 延伸:单网格读完把契约扩成系统:键程/整数坐标/安全区在审计台上机器可判——系统条目的 overlay 三档全部由这些调研值驱动。
icons/icon-grid-24.reasonEn: Extends: From one grid to a system-wide contract: keylines, integer coordinates and safe areas become machine-checkable on the audit bench — the system entry's three overlays are driven by exactly these values.

icons/icon-grid-24.reasonZh: 延伸:键程数值读完看理由:「圆比方大 2dp」是写进官方规范的光学补偿——为什么圆是 Ø20、偏心 ≤0.5、模糊法终审,光学条目展开。
icons/icon-grid-24.reasonEn: Extends: After the keyline numbers, the reasons: 'circle 2dp larger than square' is an official optical compensation — why the circle is Ø20, the ≤0.5 offset, the blur-test final audit, all in the optical entry.

icons/icon-grid-24.reasonZh: 反向自「图标按钮」的精选:搭配关系,原句「按钮里的字形默认 24px,出处正是 Material 展示区——网格条目给 24/20 档与键程,按钮条目给热区(24 法定/48 舒适)。」
icons/icon-grid-24.reasonEn: Reverse from "Icon Button" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The glyph inside a button defaults to 24px, straight from Material's display area — the grid entry supplies the 24/20 tiers and keylines, the button entry the targets (24 legal / 48 comfortable)."

icons/icon-lucide-set.reasonZh: 搭配:选型读完接交付形态:Feather 官方雪碧图是各套中唯一的外链用法——雪碧条目给 symbol/use 全套机制与同源约束。
icons/icon-lucide-set.reasonEn: Pairs with: From set selection to delivery form: Feather's official sprite is the only external-link usage among the sets — the sprite entry lays out the full symbol/use mechanics and same-origin constraint.

icons/icon-lucide-set.reasonZh: 搭配:线宽哲学的落点在描边条目:2px 定值、1.5px 例外、变轴三条路线的 SVG 属性形态与四件套源码定值逐项可查。
icons/icon-lucide-set.reasonEn: Pairs with: The stroke-width philosophy lands in the stroke-fill entry: the SVG attribute forms of the 2px standard, 1.5px exception and variable-axis routes, each default verifiable in source.

icons/icon-lucide-set.reasonZh: 反向自「图标色彩与状态」的精选:搭配关系,原句「currentColor 染色契约「五套源文件均预配置」——这套契约背后的网格/线宽/许可对照矩阵在选型条目成表。」
icons/icon-lucide-set.reasonEn: Reverse from "Icon Color & States" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The currentColor contract is 'preconfigured across all five sets' — the grid/stroke-width/license comparison matrix behind that claim is tabulated in the set-selection entry."

icons/icon-motion.reasonZh: 搭配:描边绘制与填充点亮都发生在裸路径上:dash 默认态必须全绘、fill 用 fill-opacity——这些属性的继承语义在描边填充条目。
icons/icon-motion.reasonEn: Pairs with: Stroke drawing and fill lighting both act on bare paths: dash must rest fully drawn, fill animates fill-opacity — the inheritance semantics of these attributes live in the stroke-fill entry.

icons/icon-motion.reasonZh: 搭配:变量轴动画走的是字体路线:渲染链(码位→字体文件→字形)的每一环都是失败点——「先子集化再动画」的完整失败面在对照条目。
icons/icon-motion.reasonEn: Pairs with: Variable-axis animation rides the font route: every link in the rendering chain (codepoint → font file → glyph) can fail — the full failure surface behind 'subset before you animate' lives in the comparison entry.

icons/icon-motion.reasonZh: 反向自「图标色彩与状态」的精选:搭配关系,原句「状态反馈的时间维度:换色过渡走 M3 钦定区间 150–200ms + standard 缓动——动效条目是这组 token 的出处条目。」
icons/icon-motion.reasonEn: Reverse from "Icon Color & States" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The time dimension of state feedback: color transitions ride M3's mandated 150–200ms + standard easing — the motion entry is where those tokens are sourced."

icons/icon-optical-sizing.reasonZh: 对比:同一个光学问题,两条交付路线:SVG 手绘补偿(Ø20/偏心)vs 可变字体 opsz/GRAD 四轴插值——font-vs-svg 条目给完整对照。
icons/icon-optical-sizing.reasonEn: Contrasts: One optical question, two delivery routes: hand compensation in SVG (Ø20, offset) vs variable-font opsz/GRAD axis interpolation — the font-vs-svg entry carries the full comparison.

icons/icon-optical-sizing.reasonZh: 搭配:偏心补偿与模糊法不是手感玄学:系统条目把它们写进贡献检查单、在 overlay/audit 台上机器可判——光学条目是判据出处。
