icons/icon-optical-sizing.reasonEn: Pairs with: Optical offset and the blur test are not vibes: the system entry writes them into the contribution checklist and makes them machine-checkable on the overlay/audit bench — the optical entry is where the criteria come from.

icons/icon-optical-sizing.reasonZh: 反向自「24px 图标栅格」的精选:先修关系,原句「键程数值读完看理由:「圆比方大 2dp」是写进官方规范的光学补偿——为什么圆是 Ø20、偏心 ≤0.5、模糊法终审,光学条目展开。」
icons/icon-optical-sizing.reasonEn: Reverse from "24px Icon Grid" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After the keyline numbers, the reasons: 'circle 2dp larger than square' is an official optical compensation — why the circle is Ø20, the ≤0.5 offset, the blur-test final audit, all in the optical entry."

icons/icon-sprite-symbols.reasonZh: 搭配:「引用时已定义属性被忽略」的另一半在描边条目:path 裸写、四件套设在根——雪碧染色链不断,靠的是属性放对位置。
icons/icon-sprite-symbols.reasonEn: Pairs with: The other half of 'defined attributes are ignored on use' lives in the stroke entry: bare paths, the four-piece default set on the root — the sprite color chain stays intact by placing attributes correctly.

icons/icon-sprite-symbols.reasonZh: 搭配:雪碧染色链的终点是宿主一处 color:状态切换的 3:1 核算与擦线色警告在状态色条目——继承链写错,断点即刻现形。
icons/icon-sprite-symbols.reasonEn: Pairs with: The sprite color chain terminates at one host color: the 3:1 state accounting and borderline-color warnings live in the color-states entry — get the inheritance chain wrong and the break shows immediately.

icons/icon-sprite-symbols.reasonZh: 反向自「图标语义与无障碍」的精选:搭配关系,原句「摘树纪律在雪碧图上的落点:模板 svg 与引用实例同样 aria-hidden,symbol 的「结构化定义促进无障碍」由自带 viewBox 承载。」
icons/icon-sprite-symbols.reasonEn: Reverse from "Icon Semantics & Accessibility" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Where tree-removal discipline lands in sprites: the template svg and its use instances are aria-hidden alike, and the symbol's structured-definition accessibility rides on its own viewBox."

icons/icon-stroke-fill.reasonZh: 搭配:四件套长在 24 网格上:线宽 2 与键程/活动区同出自 Material 体系——先懂画布(修剪区/活动区)再谈上墨。
icons/icon-stroke-fill.reasonEn: Pairs with: The four-piece default set sits on the 24 grid: stroke 2 and the keylines/live area come from the same Material system — understand the canvas (trim/live areas) before inking.

icons/icon-stroke-fill.reasonZh: 搭配:填充点亮后视觉重量会变:并排模糊核对灰度是否失衡——Lucide 的验收技法在光学缩放条目展开成工具。
icons/icon-stroke-fill.reasonEn: Pairs with: Filling a path shifts its visual weight: blur the pair and check the gray balance — Lucide's acceptance technique becomes a tool in the optical-sizing entry.

icons/icon-stroke-fill.reasonZh: 反向自「开源图标集」的精选:搭配关系,原句「线宽哲学的落点在描边条目:2px 定值、1.5px 例外、变轴三条路线的 SVG 属性形态与四件套源码定值逐项可查。」
icons/icon-stroke-fill.reasonEn: Reverse from "Open Source Icon Sets" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The stroke-width philosophy lands in the stroke-fill entry: the SVG attribute forms of the 2px standard, 1.5px exception and variable-axis routes, each default verifiable in source."

icons/icon-system-design.reasonZh: 搭配:图标系统定稿后的站点级出口:favicon 五件套是另一套「极小集」清单——根目录 ico、20px 内边距、409 安全圆各有硬约束。
icons/icon-system-design.reasonEn: Pairs with: The site-level exit after an icon system ships: the favicon five-plus-one list is another minimal set — root-directory ico, 20px padding and the 409 safe circle each carry hard constraints.

icons/icon-system-design.reasonZh: 搭配:系统契约的线宽层落在描边条目:一套一个数、1.5px 例外不可混入、细线 1.4.11 负债——逐项有源码定值。
icons/icon-system-design.reasonEn: Pairs with: The system contract's stroke-width layer lands in the stroke entry: one number per set, the 1.5px exception stays separate, thin-line WCAG 1.4.11 debt — each item has a source-verified value.

icons/icon-system-design.reasonZh: 反向自「24px 图标栅格」的精选:先修关系,原句「单网格读完把契约扩成系统:键程/整数坐标/安全区在审计台上机器可判——系统条目的 overlay 三档全部由这些调研值驱动。」
icons/icon-system-design.reasonEn: Reverse from "24px Icon Grid" curated: Requires relation, quoting "From one grid to a system-wide contract: keylines, integer coordinates and safe areas become machine-checkable on the audit bench — the system entry's three overlays are driven by exactly these values."

layout/anchor-positioning.reasonZh: 搭配:tooltip 的「触发元素+气泡」在原生 CSS 有了专用引擎:anchor-name/position-area 把绝对定位量测换成声明式九宫格选位与溢出翻面。
layout/anchor-positioning.reasonEn: Pairs with: The tooltip's trigger-plus-bubble gets a native CSS engine: anchor-name and position-area replace measured absolute positioning with declarative placement and overflow flip.

layout/anchor-positioning.reasonZh: 搭配:锚点定位只管「在哪」:浮层「怎么出现」归入场编排——transform-origin 按锚点方向、aria-expanded 焦点交接在 overlay-entrance。
layout/anchor-positioning.reasonEn: Pairs with: Anchor positioning only decides 'where': how the layer appears belongs to entrance choreography — transform-origin per anchor side and aria-expanded focus hand-off live in overlay-entrance.

layout/anchor-positioning.reasonZh: 反向自「粘性布局 Sticky」的精选:对比关系,原句「两种「定住」易混:sticky 在滚动流内触阈值吸附,anchor 把浮层系在页面锚点、滚出视口自动隐藏——参照物与语义都不同。」
layout/anchor-positioning.reasonEn: Reverse from "position: sticky" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two ways to 'stay put' are easy to blur: sticky docks inside the scroll flow at a threshold; anchor tethers floating layers to a page anchor and hides when it scrolls out."

layout/aspect-ratio.reasonZh: 搭配:骨架块要在内容到达前占住正确几何:比例锁给出图片卡的真实高度,占位/内容同尺寸零位移是两条目共享的验收线。
layout/aspect-ratio.reasonEn: Pairs with: Skeleton blocks must hold the real geometry before content arrives: the ratio lock supplies the true height — same-size placeholder with zero shift is the shared acceptance bar.

layout/aspect-ratio.reasonZh: 搭配:比例盒也能被查询:@container 的可查询特征清单含 aspect-ratio——比例锁定与容器分支在同一套机制里衔接。
layout/aspect-ratio.reasonEn: Pairs with: Ratio boxes are queryable too: aspect-ratio sits in @container's queryable feature list — ratio locking and container branching join in one mechanism.

layout/aspect-ratio.reasonZh: 反向自「响应式图片」的精选:搭配关系,原句「响应式图片的零位移占位几何:width/height 属性给内在比例,比例盒 + object-fit 决定裁切——CLS 防线在 aspect-ratio 展开。」
layout/aspect-ratio.reasonEn: Reverse from "Responsive Images" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The zero-shift placeholder geometry of responsive images: intrinsic ratio from width/height attributes, cropping from ratio box + object-fit — the CLS defense unfolds in aspect-ratio."

layout/auto-fit-minmax.reasonZh: 延伸:读完行为读代数:轨道数公式 ⌊(C+gap)/(min+gap)⌋、实宽推导与槽宽边界,在本条目的姊妹篇 grid-math 逐步展开。
layout/auto-fit-minmax.reasonEn: Extends: After the behavior, the algebra: the track-count formula, real-width derivation and gutter bounds unfold step by step in the sister entry grid-math.

layout/auto-fit-minmax.reasonZh: 对比:无断点自适应的两种路线易混:网格层按容器宽重排列数,@container 让组件内部按宿主宽分支——分层使用,不是竞品。
layout/auto-fit-minmax.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two breakpoint-free routes are easy to blur: the grid re-resolves column count per container width, @container branches the component per host width — layered use, not rivals.

layout/auto-fit-minmax.reasonZh: 反向自「Grid Lanes 瀑布流」的精选:搭配关系,原句「泳道的轨道列就是一行 auto-fill/minmax:列数解析、gap 参与计算的公式与空轨道回收,先在 auto-fit-minmax 看熟再读泳道堆叠。」
layout/auto-fit-minmax.reasonEn: Reverse from "CSS Grid Lanes" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The lane's track columns are one line of auto-fill/minmax: master the count formula, gap arithmetic and empty-track recycling in auto-fit-minmax before lane stacking."

layout/container-queries.reasonZh: 搭配:分栏与容器查询是条目明载的联动:右栏声明 container-type,拖窄栏宽时栏内卡片自动翻排——组件断点跟着栏走,不跟视口走。
layout/container-queries.reasonEn: Pairs with: Split panes and container queries are a documented pair: container-type on the right pane re-flows the cards as you drag — component breakpoints follow the pane, not the viewport.

layout/container-queries.reasonZh: 反向自「auto-fit 流式网格」的精选:对比关系,原句「无断点自适应的两种路线易混:网格层按容器宽重排列数,@container 让组件内部按宿主宽分支——分层使用,不是竞品。」
layout/container-queries.reasonEn: Reverse from "auto-fit / auto-fill + minmax" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two breakpoint-free routes are easy to blur: the grid re-resolves column count per container width, @container branches the component per host width — layered use, not rivals."

layout/container-queries.reasonZh: 反向自「宽高比」的精选:搭配关系,原句「比例盒也能被查询:@container 的可查询特征清单含 aspect-ratio——比例锁定与容器分支在同一套机制里衔接。」
layout/container-queries.reasonEn: Reverse from "Aspect Ratio" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Ratio boxes are queryable too: aspect-ratio sits in @container's queryable feature list — ratio locking and container branching join in one mechanism."

layout/custom-scrollbar.reasonZh: 搭配:同一只滚动容器的两件治理:scrollbar-width/color 管滚动条形态与槽位,overscroll-behavior 管滚动链与回弹——thin + contain 是同一份惯例。
layout/custom-scrollbar.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two governances of one scroll container: scrollbar-width/color own the bar's form and gutter, overscroll-behavior owns the scroll chain — thin + contain is one convention.

layout/custom-scrollbar.reasonZh: 搭配:滚动容器治理读完看内容驻留:position-sticky 触阈值吸附、不脱离文档流,祖先链 overflow 会劫持粘滞——同一只容器的另一半工程。
layout/custom-scrollbar.reasonEn: Pairs with: After governing the scroll container, read content residency: position-sticky docks at a threshold, stays in flow, and any overflow ancestor hijacks it — the other half of the same container.

layout/custom-scrollbar.reasonZh: 反向自「分栏视图」的精选:搭配关系,原句「分栏内容区就是密集滚动现场:IDE 式双栏普遍给代码/列表面板 thin 细滚动条——省空间不抢注意力,根继承即全站生效。」
layout/custom-scrollbar.reasonEn: Reverse from "Split View" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Split panes are dense-scrolling scenes: IDE-style panes give code and list panels thin scrollbars — space-saving, unobtrusive, inherited site-wide from the root."

layout/grid-lanes.reasonZh: 搭配:泳道的轨道列就是一行 auto-fill/minmax:列数解析、gap 参与计算的公式与空轨道回收,先在 auto-fit-minmax 看熟再读泳道堆叠。
layout/grid-lanes.reasonEn: Pairs with: The lane's track columns are one line of auto-fill/minmax: master the count formula, gap arithmetic and empty-track recycling in auto-fit-minmax before lane stacking.

layout/grid-lanes.reasonZh: 对比:瀑布流今昔二选一:columns 全平台可用但顺序按列,grid-lanes 保行序却仍是实验性语法——顺序敏感内容两者都别用,双写做渐进增强。
layout/grid-lanes.reasonEn: Contrasts: Masonry, old and new: columns works everywhere but reads column-first; grid-lanes keeps row order yet is still experimental — neither for order-sensitive content, double-declare for enhancement.

layout/grid-lanes.reasonZh: 反向自「响应式图片」的精选:搭配关系,原句「Pinterest 式图片墙是泳道的规范点名场景:图高不一先带好宽高属性,泳道按「剩余空间最多的列」放置才量得准。」
layout/grid-lanes.reasonEn: Reverse from "Responsive Images" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Pinterest-style image walls are the spec's named scene for lanes: ship width/height attributes first so largest-space placement measures true."

layout/grid-math.reasonZh: 搭配:栅格代数的 ③ 式现场:列宽公式与 auto-fit 推导之外,subgrid 把父网格行轨道借给卡片做跨卡对齐——姊妹条目互为工程闭环。
layout/grid-math.reasonEn: Pairs with: Stage three of the grid algebra: beyond the column formula and auto-fit derivation, subgrid lends parent row tracks to cards for cross-card alignment — a closing engineering loop.

layout/grid-math.reasonZh: 搭配:骨架与代数配套:holy-grail 用 grid-template-areas 拼出 header/side/main/footer 整页骨架,列定义与槽宽正好吃上本条目的公式。
layout/grid-math.reasonEn: Pairs with: Skeleton and algebra pair up: holy-grail assembles the header/side/main/footer page skeleton via grid-template-areas — its column definitions consume this entry's formulas.

layout/grid-math.reasonZh: 反向自「auto-fit 流式网格」的精选:先修关系,原句「读完行为读代数:轨道数公式 ⌊(C+gap)/(min+gap)⌋、实宽推导与槽宽边界,在本条目的姊妹篇 grid-math 逐步展开。」
layout/grid-math.reasonEn: Reverse from "auto-fit / auto-fill + minmax" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After the behavior, the algebra: the track-count formula, real-width derivation and gutter bounds unfold step by step in the sister entry grid-math."

layout/holy-grail.reasonZh: 对比:同为两栏页面,谁说了算是分界:圣杯是设计定的语义骨架(命名区域拼串重排),split-view 是用户拖出来的运行时分栏。
layout/holy-grail.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two-pane pages with two masters: the holy grail is a designer-fixed semantic skeleton (template-area strings), split-view is a user-dragged runtime split.

layout/holy-grail.reasonZh: 搭配:骨架就位后的常配工程:页头/侧栏吸顶驻留——粘滞范围以父容器为界,与命名区域各管各的,DOM 顺序恒定保读屏稳定。
layout/holy-grail.reasonEn: Pairs with: The fitting that follows the skeleton: sticky headers and sidebars — stickiness is bounded by the parent container and coexists with named areas under a stable DOM order.

layout/holy-grail.reasonZh: 反向自「网格数学」的精选:搭配关系,原句「骨架与代数配套:holy-grail 用 grid-template-areas 拼出 header/side/main/footer 整页骨架,列定义与槽宽正好吃上本条目的公式。」
layout/holy-grail.reasonEn: Reverse from "Grid Math" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Skeleton and algebra pair up: holy-grail assembles the header/side/main/footer page skeleton via grid-template-areas — its column definitions consume this entry's formulas."

layout/logical-properties.reasonZh: 搭配:逻辑属性的轴随书写模式转动:padding-block 在 vertical-rl 下自动变左右——物理写法永远做不到,两条目官方互指天然联动。
layout/logical-properties.reasonEn: Pairs with: Logical axes rotate with the writing mode: padding-block turns horizontal under vertical-rl — impossible for physical syntax; the two entries name each other as natural companions.

layout/logical-properties.reasonZh: 搭配:组件层已在消费逻辑属性:头像组的负重叠间距用 margin-inline-start 写——dir 翻转时重叠方向自动镜像,组件代码零改动。
layout/logical-properties.reasonEn: Pairs with: Components already consume logical syntax: the avatar group's negative overlap margin is margin-inline-start — a dir flip mirrors the overlap automatically with zero component changes.

layout/logical-properties.reasonZh: 反向自「流式间距」的精选:搭配关系,原句「流式间距令牌遇上多语言:令牌按 block/inline 主次轴命名,dir 翻转时留白语义不漂移——阿语与英语用户读同一套 token。」
layout/logical-properties.reasonEn: Reverse from "Fluid Spacing" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Fluid spacing tokens meet multilingual UI: name tokens by the block/inline axes so whitespace semantics don't drift on dir flip — Arabic and English readers get the same tokens."

layout/masonry-columns.reasonZh: 对比:零依赖卡片墙的两条路线二选一:columns 让内容沿列流动、顺序按列,auto-fit 网格保行序整齐——按内容是否顺序敏感选。
layout/masonry-columns.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two zero-dependency card walls, pick one: columns flows content down each column (column order), the auto-fit grid keeps row order — choose by whether order matters.

layout/masonry-columns.reasonZh: 搭配:图片墙的供图侧:瀑布流槽位宽窄不定,sizes 断点跟着布局槽位走,width/height 属性先把每张图的占位锁住。
layout/masonry-columns.reasonEn: Pairs with: The supply side of image walls: masonry slots vary in width, so sizes follows layout slots and the width/height attributes lock each image's placeholder first.

layout/masonry-columns.reasonZh: 反向自「Grid Lanes 瀑布流」的精选:对比关系,原句「瀑布流今昔二选一:columns 全平台可用但顺序按列,grid-lanes 保行序却仍是实验性语法——顺序敏感内容两者都别用,双写做渐进增强。」
layout/masonry-columns.reasonEn: Reverse from "CSS Grid Lanes" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Masonry, old and new: columns works everywhere but reads column-first; grid-lanes keeps row order yet is still experimental — neither for order-sensitive content, double-declare for enhancement."

layout/position-sticky.reasonZh: 搭配:吸顶页头在全面屏上还有第二道阈值:top 偏移要叠加 env(safe-area-inset-top),四向留边都要写、旋转时 left/right 交接。
layout/position-sticky.reasonEn: Pairs with: Sticky headers carry a second threshold on notch screens: the top offset stacks with env(safe-area-inset-top), all four insets written, left/right taking over in landscape.

layout/position-sticky.reasonZh: 对比:两种「定住」易混:sticky 在滚动流内触阈值吸附,anchor 把浮层系在页面锚点、滚出视口自动隐藏——参照物与语义都不同。
layout/position-sticky.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two ways to 'stay put' are easy to blur: sticky docks inside the scroll flow at a threshold; anchor tethers floating layers to a page anchor and hides when it scrolls out.

layout/position-sticky.reasonZh: 反向自「滚动吸附」的精选:搭配关系,原句「吸顶导航与吸附滚动的配合件:scroll-padding 给 sticky 头部留位,否则停靠内容被遮——两条目在锚点定位场景互为搭子。」
layout/position-sticky.reasonEn: Reverse from "Scroll Snap" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Sticky headers and snap scrolling are fittings for each other: scroll-padding reserves room for the sticky header, or docked content hides behind it — the anchor scene both entries serve."

layout/responsive-images.reasonZh: 搭配:响应式图片的零位移占位几何:width/height 属性给内在比例,比例盒 + object-fit 决定裁切——CLS 防线在 aspect-ratio 展开。
layout/responsive-images.reasonEn: Pairs with: The zero-shift placeholder geometry of responsive images: intrinsic ratio from width/height attributes, cropping from ratio box + object-fit — the CLS defense unfolds in aspect-ratio.

layout/responsive-images.reasonZh: 搭配:Pinterest 式图片墙是泳道的规范点名场景:图高不一先带好宽高属性,泳道按「剩余空间最多的列」放置才量得准。
layout/responsive-images.reasonEn: Pairs with: Pinterest-style image walls are the spec's named scene for lanes: ship width/height attributes first so largest-space placement measures true.

layout/responsive-images.reasonZh: 反向自「多列瀑布流 Columns」的精选:搭配关系,原句「图片墙的供图侧:瀑布流槽位宽窄不定,sizes 断点跟着布局槽位走,width/height 属性先把每张图的占位锁住。」
layout/responsive-images.reasonEn: Reverse from "CSS Multi-column Masonry" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The supply side of image walls: masonry slots vary in width, so sizes follows layout slots and the width/height attributes lock each image's placeholder first."

layout/safe-area.reasonZh: 搭配:同一条渐进增强纪律的两处应用:安全区「16px 在前、calc(env()) 在后」,容器查询「64px 在前、18cqw 在后」——不支持时各落回固定值。
layout/safe-area.reasonEn: Pairs with: One progressive-enhancement discipline applied twice: safe-area puts 16px before calc(env()), container queries put 64px before 18cqw — both fall back to fixed values.

layout/safe-area.reasonZh: 搭配:safe-area 留边的典型受让对象:drawer 的 bottom sheet 从视口底缘长出、自带底部「确定/重置」操作行——env(safe-area-inset-bottom) 要让开的正是这一段。
layout/safe-area.reasonEn: Pairs with: A typical recipient of safe-area insets: the drawer's bottom sheet grows from the viewport's bottom edge with its own confirm/reset row — exactly what env(safe-area-inset-bottom) must clear.

layout/safe-area.reasonZh: 反向自「粘性布局 Sticky」的精选:搭配关系,原句「吸顶页头在全面屏上还有第二道阈值:top 偏移要叠加 env(safe-area-inset-top),四向留边都要写、旋转时 left/right 交接。」
layout/safe-area.reasonEn: Reverse from "position: sticky" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Sticky headers carry a second threshold on notch screens: the top offset stacks with env(safe-area-inset-top), all four insets written, left/right taking over in landscape."

layout/split-view.reasonZh: 搭配:分栏内容区就是密集滚动现场:IDE 式双栏普遍给代码/列表面板 thin 细滚动条——省空间不抢注意力,根继承即全站生效。
layout/split-view.reasonEn: Pairs with: Split panes are dense-scrolling scenes: IDE-style panes give code and list panels thin scrollbars — space-saving, unobtrusive, inherited site-wide from the root.

layout/split-view.reasonZh: 反向自「圣杯布局」的精选:对比关系,原句「同为两栏页面,谁说了算是分界:圣杯是设计定的语义骨架(命名区域拼串重排),split-view 是用户拖出来的运行时分栏。」
layout/split-view.reasonEn: Reverse from "Holy Grail Layout" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two-pane pages with two masters: the holy grail is a designer-fixed semantic skeleton (template-area strings), split-view is a user-dragged runtime split."

layout/split-view.reasonZh: 反向自「容器查询」的精选:搭配关系,原句「分栏与容器查询是条目明载的联动:右栏声明 container-type,拖窄栏宽时栏内卡片自动翻排——组件断点跟着栏走,不跟视口走。」
layout/split-view.reasonEn: Reverse from "Container Queries" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Split panes and container queries are a documented pair: container-type on the right pane re-flows the cards as you drag — component breakpoints follow the pane, not the viewport."

layout/subgrid.reasonZh: 搭配:跨卡对齐的最终判据回到基线:subgrid 共享行轨道后,标题/页脚行盒是否落格,用基线网格的步长判据与可视化叠加验收。
layout/subgrid.reasonEn: Pairs with: Cross-card alignment settles on the baseline: once subgrid shares row tracks, whether title/footer line boxes land on the grid is judged by the baseline grid's step rule and overlay.

layout/subgrid.reasonZh: 搭配:设计系统的两半接力:整页骨架交给 grid-template-areas 命名区域,组件内部对齐交给 subgrid——组件轨道即页面轨道。
layout/subgrid.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two halves of a design system in relay: the page skeleton goes to named template areas, in-component alignment to subgrid — the component's tracks are the page's tracks.

layout/subgrid.reasonZh: 反向自「网格数学」的精选:搭配关系,原句「栅格代数的 ③ 式现场:列宽公式与 auto-fit 推导之外,subgrid 把父网格行轨道借给卡片做跨卡对齐——姊妹条目互为工程闭环。」
layout/subgrid.reasonEn: Reverse from "Grid Math" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Stage three of the grid algebra: beyond the column formula and auto-fit derivation, subgrid lends parent row tracks to cards for cross-card alignment — a closing engineering loop."

layout/writing-modes.reasonZh: 搭配:竖排诗笺读完回到横排正字:中西文间距、标点挤压、段首缩进的 CLREQ 条款在任何排式下都适用——系统展开在 cjk-typography。
layout/writing-modes.reasonEn: Pairs with: After the vertical poem, back to horizontal orthography: the CLREQ rules for CJK-Latin spacing, punctuation squeezing and paragraph indent hold in any style — unfolded in cjk-typography.

layout/writing-modes.reasonZh: 反向自「逻辑属性」的精选:搭配关系,原句「逻辑属性的轴随书写模式转动:padding-block 在 vertical-rl 下自动变左右——物理写法永远做不到,两条目官方互指天然联动。」
layout/writing-modes.reasonEn: Reverse from "Logical Properties" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Logical axes rotate with the writing mode: padding-block turns horizontal under vertical-rl — impossible for physical syntax; the two entries name each other as natural companions."

layout/writing-modes.reasonZh: 反向自「表格数字」的精选:对比关系,原句「数字的两种特殊排法易混:tnum 让横排数字列等宽对齐,text-combine-upright 把多位数压进竖排的一个字格——场景不同别互串。」
layout/writing-modes.reasonEn: Reverse from "Tabular Numbers" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two special digit treatments easy to blur: tnum equalizes horizontal numeric columns, text-combine-upright squeezes multi-digit years into one vertical cell — different scenes, no swapping."

materials/aurora-gradient.reasonZh: 搭配:大面积多层光斑渐变是色带(banding)高发区——颗粒噪点层的消带作用正是配套解法。
materials/aurora-gradient.reasonEn: Pairs with: Large multi-blob gradients are banding-prone — the grain layer's de-banding effect is the matching fix.

materials/aurora-gradient.reasonZh: 搭配:媒体英雄区配方把两者拼在一起:极光垫氛围底,视差用滚动速率差推内容深度。
materials/aurora-gradient.reasonEn: Pairs with: The media-hero recipe puts them together: aurora lays the ambient bed, parallax pushes content depth with scroll-rate differences.

materials/aurora-gradient.reasonZh: 反向自「赛博朋克」的精选:搭配关系,原句「电光青/品红/酸黄只在近黑底上成立——极光渐变正是暗底氛围光的成熟配方:多层低亮度光斑缓慢平移。」
materials/aurora-gradient.reasonEn: Reverse from "Cyberpunk" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Electric cyan, magenta and acid yellow only hold on a near-black base — the aurora gradient is the mature recipe for dark-scene ambience: low-luminance blobs drifting slowly."

materials/backdrop-filter.reasonZh: 对比:同一套函数两种作用域:filter 改元素自身渲染(链序即处理序),backdrop-filter 改『身后』——分界线是两页互查的第一课。
materials/backdrop-filter.reasonEn: Contrasts: One function set, two scopes: filter alters the element's own render (chain order is processing order), backdrop-filter alters what's behind — the dividing line is lesson one of both pages.

materials/backdrop-filter.reasonZh: 对比:系统玻璃复刻题的反例:Mica 窗口背景明确不用 backdrop-filter——静态取样烘焙 vs 实时透视的分野。
materials/backdrop-filter.reasonEn: Contrasts: The counter-case of system-glass replication: Mica explicitly avoids backdrop-filter for the window background — baked single-sample vs live translucency.

materials/backdrop-filter.reasonZh: 路径「从零到一块玻璃卡」的下一站:玻璃卡需要海拔语义:投影参数如何随主题token化、「小而锐=近、大而柔=远」,hover 只在层级真变化时换档。
materials/backdrop-filter.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Zero to Glass" path: A glass card needs elevation semantics: how shadow params tokenize per theme, "small and sharp = near, large and soft = far", and switching levels only when hierarchy truly changes.

materials/blend-modes.reasonZh: 搭配:多层彩色渐变叠层是混合模式的主舞台:极光渐变把同一套多层结构做成大面积动态版。
materials/blend-modes.reasonEn: Pairs with: Multi-layer color-gradient stacks are blend modes' main stage: the aurora turns the same stacked structure into a large animated version.

materials/blend-modes.reasonZh: 搭配:色散边的通道分离叠层以 mix-blend-mode: screen 合成——混合模式的光学应用现场。
materials/blend-modes.reasonEn: Pairs with: The chromatic edge's channel-split layers composite with mix-blend-mode: screen — blend modes at optical work.

materials/blend-modes.reasonZh: 反向自「滤镜函数族」的精选:对比关系,原句「元素调色的两条路易混:filter 改像素本身,blend 改元素与背景/层间的关系——同一颗噪点的两种精修路。」
materials/blend-modes.reasonEn: Reverse from "Filter Functions" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two color-treating routes are easy to confuse: filter changes pixels themselves, blend changes relations between element and backdrop or layers — two refinements of the same noise."

materials/breathing-glow.reasonZh: 搭配:呼吸辉光要挂在哪种设计语言里:柔光设计以「光」而非色块组织层级,每个发光元素都有单一方向光源。
materials/breathing-glow.reasonEn: Pairs with: Which design language breathing glow belongs to: soft-glow organizes hierarchy with light, not blocks, and every glowing element has one directional source.

materials/breathing-glow.reasonZh: 搭配:通知点的两种发光常同框:呼吸管时间维度,光环描边管空间轮廓——1–2px 的 conic 环外溢成光晕。
materials/breathing-glow.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two glows of a notification dot often combine: breathing owns time, the halo border owns contour — a 1–2px conic ring bleeding into a halo.

materials/breathing-glow.reasonZh: 反向自「内发光面板」的精选:对比关系,原句「发光方向二选一:内泛光把光关在面板内部当「静音版」,呼吸辉光让光斑以 2–6s 周期向外往复——一静一动。」
materials/breathing-glow.reasonEn: Reverse from "Inner-Glow Panel" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Pick a glow direction: inner glow locks light inside the panel (the muted take), breathing glow pulses outward on a 2–6s cycle — still vs alive."

materials/chromatic-edge.reasonZh: 搭配:色散边是赛博朋克「故障即氛围」的材质级实现:扫描线与 RGB 通道错位之外,真实光学也提供红蓝错位。
materials/chromatic-edge.reasonEn: Pairs with: The chromatic edge is cyberpunk's material-level glitch: beyond scanlines and RGB shifts, real optics supply the red-blue misalignment.

materials/chromatic-edge.reasonZh: 延伸:容器级的色散边读完,接文字级:同一套 SVG 位移/双层副本路线缩到字形,红蓝错位出现在笔画边缘上。
materials/chromatic-edge.reasonEn: Extends: After container-level fringing, go character-level: the same SVG-displacement and double-copy routes shrink onto glyphs.

materials/chromatic-edge.reasonZh: 反向自「混合模式」的精选:搭配关系,原句「色散边的通道分离叠层以 mix-blend-mode: screen 合成——混合模式的光学应用现场。」
materials/chromatic-edge.reasonEn: Reverse from "Blend Modes" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The chromatic edge's channel-split layers composite with mix-blend-mode: screen — blend modes at optical work."

materials/clear-frost.reasonZh: 对比:磨砂密度轴的两端易混:超薄磨砂让背景尽量原样透过,高雾度只留色温不留信息——选型先定这一档。
materials/clear-frost.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two ends of the frost-density axis: ultra-thin frost passes the backdrop through nearly intact, high haze keeps only the color temperature.

materials/clear-frost.reasonZh: 搭配:超薄档的官方对应物:ultraThinMaterial 与 Liquid Glass clear 变体的参数语义,六档磨砂表里查得到。
materials/clear-frost.reasonEn: Pairs with: The official counterpart of the ultra-thin tier: ultraThinMaterial and Liquid Glass clear semantics, findable in the six-frost table.

materials/clear-frost.reasonZh: 反向自「糖果果冻风」的精选:搭配关系,原句「糖果场景的玻璃用超薄档:糖果色已给足色彩,雾度反而要低——clear-frost 的参数域正是配套。」
materials/clear-frost.reasonEn: Reverse from "Gel-Candy Design" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Candy scenes use the ultra-thin frost: candy color already supplies saturation, so haze must stay low — clear-frost's parameter range is the matching piece."

materials/contact-shadows.reasonZh: 对比:同是把 3D/摄影语汇搬进 UI,深度线索不同:接触阴影用环境光遮蔽做「贴地」,景深用 blur 分层做「焦外」。
materials/contact-shadows.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both port 3D and photography vocabulary into UI with different depth cues: contact shadow uses ambient occlusion for grounded, depth of field uses blur layering for out-of-focus.

materials/contact-shadows.reasonZh: 搭配:两者共享「单一光源」纪律:同一盏灯照亮整套 UI,阴影色相与辉光同源才有物理可信度。
materials/contact-shadows.reasonEn: Pairs with: They share the single-light-source discipline: one lamp lights the whole UI, and shadow hue and glow from the same source read as physically true.

materials/contact-shadows.reasonZh: 反向自「Fluent 主题阴影」的精选:对比关系,原句「高度语言的两档:「贴地」是紧贴椭圆接触阴影,「悬浮」是偏移大、更弥散的投影——先分清高度叙事再选阴影。」
materials/contact-shadows.reasonEn: Reverse from "ThemeShadow (Fluent)" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two tiers of height language: 'grounded' is the tight elliptical contact shadow, 'floating' the larger, softer offset — settle the height story before picking shadows."

materials/depth-of-field.reasonZh: 搭配:景深分层的引擎件:远景的 blur + saturate 调制走的是元素自身滤镜链,函数语义与链序在滤镜函数族条目。
materials/depth-of-field.reasonEn: Pairs with: The engine of depth layering: the far layers' blur + saturate ride the element's own filter chain — semantics and order live in filter-functions.

materials/depth-of-field.reasonZh: 搭配:深度线索的另一条路:景深用清晰度差分层,视差用滚动速率差分层——两种「伪 3D」常叠着用。
materials/depth-of-field.reasonEn: Pairs with: The other depth cue: depth of field layers by sharpness, parallax by scroll-rate difference — the two pseudo-3D tricks stack well.

materials/depth-of-field.reasonZh: 反向自「接触阴影」的精选:对比关系,原句「同是把 3D/摄影语汇搬进 UI,深度线索不同:接触阴影用环境光遮蔽做「贴地」,景深用 blur 分层做「焦外」。」
materials/depth-of-field.reasonEn: Reverse from "Contact Shadows" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both port 3D and photography vocabulary into UI with different depth cues: contact shadow uses ambient occlusion for grounded, depth of field uses blur layering for out-of-focus."

materials/dimming-layer.reasonZh: 搭配:同一张弹层的两道隔离:遮罩管视觉,overscroll-behavior 管滚动链——弹层打开时的背景锁在专门条目。
materials/dimming-layer.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two isolations of one dialog: the veil owns vision, overscroll-behavior owns the scroll chain — the background lock has its own entry.

materials/dimming-layer.reasonZh: 搭配:遮罩与面板同台演出:压暗层淡入的同时,浮层按 scale 0.95 + opacity 0 的初态弹入——一套时序两个角色。
materials/dimming-layer.reasonEn: Pairs with: The veil and the panel share one timeline: while the dimmer fades in, the overlay springs from scale 0.95 + opacity 0.

materials/dimming-layer.reasonZh: 反向自「液态玻璃」的精选:搭配关系,原句「clear 变体的 35% 深色压暗层是 HIG 给死的数值——压暗遮罩的通用分档在专门条目展开。」
materials/dimming-layer.reasonEn: Reverse from "Liquid Glass" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The clear variant's 35% dark dimming layer is a HIG-locked number — the general tiering of dimming veils unfolds in the dedicated entry."

materials/filter-functions.reasonZh: 搭配:极光渐变的整层氛围正是 filter 链的一次成片应用:blur+saturate 在层上调「密度与色彩回填」。
materials/filter-functions.reasonEn: Pairs with: The aurora's whole-layer ambience is a filter chain applied in one pass: blur and saturate tune density and color return on the layer.

materials/filter-functions.reasonZh: 对比:元素调色的两条路易混:filter 改像素本身,blend 改元素与背景/层间的关系——同一颗噪点的两种精修路。
materials/filter-functions.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two color-treating routes are easy to confuse: filter changes pixels themselves, blend changes relations between element and backdrop or layers — two refinements of the same noise.

materials/filter-functions.reasonZh: 反向自「背景滤镜」的精选:对比关系,原句「同一套函数两种作用域:filter 改元素自身渲染(链序即处理序),backdrop-filter 改『身后』——分界线是两页互查的第一课。」
materials/filter-functions.reasonEn: Reverse from "Backdrop Filter" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "One function set, two scopes: filter alters the element's own render (chain order is processing order), backdrop-filter alters what's behind — the dividing line is lesson one of both pages."

materials/fluent-acrylic.reasonZh: 搭配:亚克力 Web 复刻的引擎件:blur(24px) saturate(1.25) 与 @supports 实底回退都在 backdrop-filter 条目。
materials/fluent-acrylic.reasonEn: Pairs with: The engine of the acrylic web replica: blur(24px) saturate(1.25) and the @supports solid fallback both live in the backdrop-filter entry.

materials/fluent-acrylic.reasonZh: 搭配:官方配方的第四层就是噪点:feTurbulence 噪点层的参数与用法在专门条目展开。
materials/fluent-acrylic.reasonEn: Pairs with: The official recipe's fourth layer is noise: the feTurbulence noise layer's parameters and usage unfold in the dedicated entry.

materials/fluent-acrylic.reasonZh: 反向自「Fluent 云母」的精选:对比关系,原句「一句分清:「要透视选 Acrylic,要稳定选 Mica」——逐元素实时透出 vs 单次采样烘焙,浮层与窗口底各归其位。」
materials/fluent-acrylic.reasonEn: Reverse from "Fluent Mica" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "One sentence separates them: translucency choose Acrylic, stability choose Mica — per-element live translucency vs baked single-sample, overlays and window base each in place."

materials/fluent-mica.reasonZh: 对比:一句分清:「要透视选 Acrylic,要稳定选 Mica」——逐元素实时透出 vs 单次采样烘焙,浮层与窗口底各归其位。
materials/fluent-mica.reasonEn: Contrasts: One sentence separates them: translucency choose Acrylic, stability choose Mica — per-element live translucency vs baked single-sample, overlays and window base each in place.

materials/fluent-mica.reasonZh: 对比:平台材质清单的两种性格:SwiftUI 六档半透明磨砂逐元素透底,Mica 不透明单次采样只做长驻窗口底。
materials/fluent-mica.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two temperaments in platform material menus: SwiftUI's six translucent frost tiers pass the backdrop through per element, Mica is opaque single-sample for the resident window base.

materials/fluent-mica.reasonZh: 反向自「背景滤镜」的精选:对比关系,原句「系统玻璃复刻题的反例:Mica 窗口背景明确不用 backdrop-filter——静态取样烘焙 vs 实时透视的分野。」
materials/fluent-mica.reasonEn: Reverse from "Backdrop Filter" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "The counter-case of system-glass replication: Mica explicitly avoids backdrop-filter for the window background — baked single-sample vs live translucency."

materials/gel-material.reasonZh: 搭配:同为「充气」体积暗示:黏土用粉彩底与双内阴影浮出页面,凝胶用半透明糖色与高光内衬——哑光与透光两条路线。
materials/gel-material.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two inflatable volume cues: clay floats on pastel fills with double inset shadows, gel on translucent candy with a glossy lining — matte vs translucent.

materials/gel-material.reasonZh: 搭配:果冻按压回弹的手感账:overshoot 回弹要一颗欠阻尼弹簧,response/dampingFraction 两个参数就是账本。
materials/gel-material.reasonEn: Pairs with: The feel ledger of jelly rebound: an overshooting bounce needs an underdamped spring — response and dampingFraction are the ledger.

materials/gel-material.reasonZh: 反向自「糖果果冻风」的精选:搭配关系,原句「流派级组织读完接材质级配方:高光内衬+糖色加浓+弹性回弹三件套在 gel-material 条目。」
materials/gel-material.reasonEn: Reverse from "Gel-Candy Design" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "After the style-level organization, the material-level recipe: the glossy lining plus candy densification plus elastic rebound trio lives in the gel-material entry."

materials/glass-effect-api.reasonZh: 搭配:三层 API 的 Web 近似按同一层级搭在 backdrop-filter 上:容器/单块/身份一一对应。
materials/glass-effect-api.reasonEn: Pairs with: The web approximation of the three API layers builds on backdrop-filter at the same hierarchy: container, element and identity map one to one.

materials/glass-effect-api.reasonZh: 对比:SwiftUI 两套材质入口易混:Material 枚举是六档标准磨砂,glassEffect 是 Liquid Glass 声明——何时用哪套。
materials/glass-effect-api.reasonEn: Contrasts: SwiftUI's two material entry points are easy to confuse: the Material enum is the six-tier standard frost, glassEffect declares Liquid Glass — which to use when.

materials/glass-effect-api.reasonZh: 反向自「液态玻璃」的精选:搭配关系,原句「材质读完读它的声明式 API 面:glassEffect/Container/Union 三层与 morph 匹配规则。」
materials/glass-effect-api.reasonEn: Reverse from "Liquid Glass" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "After the material, its declarative API surface: the three layers of glassEffect, GlassEffectContainer and glassEffectID, plus the morph-matching rules."

materials/glass-text.reasonZh: 搭配:文字透镜的位移走滤镜路线:SVG 原语经 filter: url() 挂载,与 CSS 十枚函数族同属一个属性的两套词汇。
materials/glass-text.reasonEn: Pairs with: The text lens rides the filter route: SVG primitives mount via filter: url() — the same property, a second vocabulary beside the ten CSS functions.

materials/glass-text.reasonZh: 搭配:假位移路线的合成器:字形副本色相错开后用 screen 混合叠印——混合模式把红蓝折射率差近似出来。
materials/glass-text.reasonEn: Pairs with: The faux route's compositor: hue-shifted glyph copies stack with screen blending — blend modes approximate the red-blue refraction gap.

materials/glass-text.reasonZh: 反向自「玻璃色散边」的精选:先修关系,原句「容器级的色散边读完,接文字级:同一套 SVG 位移/双层副本路线缩到字形,红蓝错位出现在笔画边缘上。」
materials/glass-text.reasonEn: Reverse from "Chromatic Edge" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After container-level fringing, go character-level: the same SVG-displacement and double-copy routes shrink onto glyphs."

materials/grain-gradient.reasonZh: 搭配:精修档用 mix-blend-mode: multiply 让噪点只与渐变混合——混合模式的入口与隔离技巧在专门条目。
materials/grain-gradient.reasonEn: Pairs with: The refined tier uses mix-blend-mode: multiply so noise blends with the gradient alone — blend modes' entry points and isolation tricks live in the dedicated entry.

materials/grain-gradient.reasonZh: 搭配:把噪点推成颗粒靠 contrast/brightness 滤镜链——函数语义与链序在 filter 函数族条目。
materials/grain-gradient.reasonEn: Pairs with: Pushing noise into grain rides the contrast/brightness filter chain — function semantics and chain order live in the filter-functions entry.

materials/grain-gradient.reasonZh: 反向自「Fluent 亚克力」的精选:搭配关系,原句「官方配方的第四层就是噪点:feTurbulence 噪点层的参数与用法在专门条目展开。」
materials/grain-gradient.reasonEn: Reverse from "Fluent Acrylic" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The official recipe's fourth layer is noise: the feTurbulence noise layer's parameters and usage unfold in the dedicated entry."

materials/halo-glow-border.reasonZh: 搭配:边缘受光的两条画法:conic 光环用锐利层做线,镜面高光用 inset 顶缘高光带——同一道「天光」两种落笔。
materials/halo-glow-border.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two ways to draw edge light: the conic ring's sharp layer vs the specular's inset top band — one skylight, two strokes.

materials/halo-glow-border.reasonZh: 搭配:把光环放回暗场语言里用:柔光设计以光分层、光色与内容主色同族,光环的模糊层外溢也要守同一光源。
materials/halo-glow-border.reasonEn: Pairs with: Use the halo inside the dark-scene language: soft-glow tiers by light with glow hue in the content's family — the halo's blurred layer obeys the same source.

materials/halo-glow-border.reasonZh: 反向自「呼吸光晕」的精选:搭配关系,原句「通知点的两种发光常同框:呼吸管时间维度,光环描边管空间轮廓——1–2px 的 conic 环外溢成光晕。」
materials/halo-glow-border.reasonEn: Reverse from "Breathing Glow" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Two glows of a notification dot often combine: breathing owns time, the halo border owns contour — a 1–2px conic ring bleeding into a halo."

materials/inner-glow-panel.reasonZh: 搭配:内泛光是柔光设计语言里的静音档:暗场容器不向外溢光,只留上沿受光与下沿环境暗。
materials/inner-glow-panel.reasonEn: Pairs with: Inner glow is the quiet tier of the soft-glow language: dark containers keep light in — a lit top edge and an ambient-dark bottom.

materials/inner-glow-panel.reasonZh: 对比:发光方向二选一:内泛光把光关在面板内部当「静音版」,呼吸辉光让光斑以 2–6s 周期向外往复——一静一动。
materials/inner-glow-panel.reasonEn: Contrasts: Pick a glow direction: inner glow locks light inside the panel (the muted take), breathing glow pulses outward on a 2–6s cycle — still vs alive.

materials/inner-glow-panel.reasonZh: 反向自「柔光玻璃」的精选:对比关系,原句「同是玻璃面板的发光,方向相反:渗光/泛光向外,内泛光把光关在内部——发光层的两个音量档。」
materials/inner-glow-panel.reasonEn: Reverse from "Soft-Glow Glass" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two volume levels of a glowing panel: bleed and bloom face outward, inner glow keeps light locked inside."

materials/iridescent-glass.reasonZh: 搭配:同一配方的两个尺度:conic 渐变双实例在光环条目做「锐利层做线、模糊层做光」,在面板上长成虹彩材质。
materials/iridescent-glass.reasonEn: Pairs with: One recipe, two scales: the conic double-instance draws a sharp line plus blurred halo on borders, and grows into a panel-wide iridescent material.

materials/iridescent-glass.reasonZh: 搭配:薄膜干涉的两个实现档:条目用缓慢流转的 conic 结构色,全息虹彩用跨色相光谱渐变模拟衍射薄膜。
materials/iridescent-glass.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two tiers of thin-film interference: drifting conic structural color here, cross-hue spectral gradients standing in for diffraction there.

materials/iridescent-glass.reasonZh: 反向自「Y2K 复古未来主义」的精选:搭配关系,原句「「虹彩油膜渐变」的材质级落地:薄膜干涉条目把油膜结构色做成会流转的面板材质(铬字色标调密即接近油膜)。」
materials/iridescent-glass.reasonEn: Reverse from "Y2K Retro-Futurism" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Where the iridescent oil-slick gradient lands as a material: the thin-film entry turns oil-slip structural color into a drifting panel material (densify the chrome stops to approach the film)."

materials/liquid-glass.reasonZh: 先修:读材质范式前必须先懂 Web 底座:玻璃舱的 blur/saturate、折射回退与能力检测全部落在 backdrop-filter 上。
materials/liquid-glass.reasonEn: Requires: Understand the web base before the material paradigm: the glass capsule's blur/saturate, refraction fallback and capability detection all ride on backdrop-filter.

materials/liquid-glass.reasonZh: 搭配:clear 变体的 35% 深色压暗层是 HIG 给死的数值——压暗遮罩的通用分档在专门条目展开。
materials/liquid-glass.reasonEn: Pairs with: The clear variant's 35% dark dimming layer is a HIG-locked number — the general tiering of dimming veils unfolds in the dedicated entry.

materials/liquid-glass.reasonZh: 反向自「毛玻璃」的精选:先修关系,原句「读完概念看官方终极形态:regular/clear 变体、亮背景 35% 深色压暗与「只给导航层」的纪律,是玻璃语法的参考答案。」
materials/liquid-glass.reasonEn: Reverse from "Glassmorphism" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After the concept, meet the official endgame: regular/clear variants, the 35% dark dimming on bright backdrops and the nav-layer-only discipline — the reference answer of the glass syntax."

materials/m3-state-layers.reasonZh: 搭配:玻璃卡片的反馈层:材质管氛围、状态层管交互(hover +8%/focus +10%/press +10%)——配方 a 的四层之二。
materials/m3-state-layers.reasonEn: Pairs with: The feedback layer of the glass card: material owns ambience, state layer owns interaction (hover +8%, focus +10%, press +10%) — two of recipe-a's four layers.

materials/m3-state-layers.reasonZh: 搭配:第三层分工:状态层管反馈、主题投影管海拔(静止 0~+3、hover 抬一级)——三层各司其职不互相越权。
materials/m3-state-layers.reasonEn: Pairs with: The third division of labor: state layer owns feedback, themed shadow owns elevation (0 to +3 at rest, hover lifts one level) — three layers, no overreach.

materials/m3-state-layers.reasonZh: 用于配方「玻璃卡片·完整版」的组合条目
materials/m3-state-layers.reasonEn: Combined in the "Glass Card Pro" recipe

materials/mist-glass.reasonZh: 对比:同一根密度轴的暗色端:高雾度亮场只留色温,黑玻璃深色基底连信息都不透——亮暗两端对照选型。
materials/mist-glass.reasonEn: Contrasts: The dark end of the same density axis: bright high haze keeps only color temperature, smoked glass gives up information entirely.

materials/mist-glass.reasonZh: 搭配:重度均质化的引擎就是 backdrop-filter:大半径 blur 加降饱和,把「身后」内容压成只剩色温。
materials/mist-glass.reasonEn: Pairs with: The engine of heavy homogenization is backdrop-filter: a large blur with desaturation compresses what's behind into color temperature only.

materials/mist-glass.reasonZh: 反向自「清透磨砂」的精选:对比关系,原句「磨砂密度轴的两端易混:超薄磨砂让背景尽量原样透过,高雾度只留色温不留信息——选型先定这一档。」
materials/mist-glass.reasonEn: Reverse from "Clear Frost" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two ends of the frost-density axis: ultra-thin frost passes the backdrop through nearly intact, high haze keeps only the color temperature."

materials/paper-texture.reasonZh: 搭配:纸纹正是拟物材质清单的一员:feTurbulence 噪点、细网格与套印错位,给回潮的材质家族提供哑光纸面。
materials/paper-texture.reasonEn: Pairs with: Paper grain is a member of the skeuomorphic material list: feTurbulence noise, hairline grids and misregistered prints supply the matte paper.

materials/paper-texture.reasonZh: 搭配:riso 双色套印的 multiply 错印是「叠印」语法的最小实现:两层错位已成立,叠满三层即极繁的图案场。
materials/paper-texture.reasonEn: Pairs with: Riso's two-plate multiply misprint is the minimal form of overprint: two offset layers already work — stack to three and it becomes maximalism's motif field.

materials/paper-texture.reasonZh: 反向自「颗粒噪点渐变」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同一枚 feTurbulence 的两种用法:颗粒渐变用 contrast/brightness 推噪点杀色带,纸面用它铺哑光底纹。」
materials/paper-texture.reasonEn: Reverse from "Grain Gradient" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "One feTurbulence, two uses: grain gradients push noise into anti-banding speckle, paper lays it down as matte tooth."

materials/smoked-glass.reasonZh: 搭配:黑玻璃的「厚」感来源之一:顶部拉丝高光正是 inset 顶缘高光带在深色基底上的用法。
materials/smoked-glass.reasonEn: Pairs with: One source of black glass's thickness: the brushed top highlight is the inset top-edge band at work on a dark base.

materials/smoked-glass.reasonZh: 对比:暗场的两种立场二选一:柔光设计让面板自发光、以光分层;黑玻璃把光挡在外面、以密度分层。
materials/smoked-glass.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two dark-scene stances: soft-glow makes panels emit and tiers by light; smoked glass keeps light out and tiers by density.

materials/smoked-glass.reasonZh: 反向自「雾面玻璃」的精选:对比关系,原句「同一根密度轴的暗色端:高雾度亮场只留色温,黑玻璃深色基底连信息都不透——亮暗两端对照选型。」
materials/smoked-glass.reasonEn: Reverse from "Mist Glass" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "The dark end of the same density axis: bright high haze keeps only color temperature, smoked glass gives up information entirely."

materials/soft-glow-glass.reasonZh: 搭配:泛光的时间化就是呼吸:静态 bloom 加上 2–6s 的 alpha/blur 往复,面板从「发光」变成「呼吸」。
materials/soft-glow-glass.reasonEn: Pairs with: Breathing is bloom over time: add a 2–6s alpha/blur cycle to static bloom and the panel stops just glowing — it starts breathing.

materials/soft-glow-glass.reasonZh: 对比:同是玻璃面板的发光,方向相反:渗光/泛光向外,内泛光把光关在内部——发光层的两个音量档。
materials/soft-glow-glass.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two volume levels of a glowing panel: bleed and bloom face outward, inner glow keeps light locked inside.

materials/soft-glow-glass.reasonZh: 反向自「柔光设计」的精选:先修关系,原句「风格语言读完接材质实现件:渗光/泛光/受光亮边三件套,让面板自己成为场景里的光源。」
materials/soft-glow-glass.reasonEn: Reverse from "Soft-Glow Design" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After the style language, the material implementation: the bleed, bloom and lit-edge trio makes the panel a light source of its own."

materials/specular-highlight.reasonZh: 搭配:官方 lensing 的 web 近似:「1px 内侧高光+顶缘受光」对应 Liquid Glass 的受光形态——复刻配方在玻璃舱条目。
materials/specular-highlight.reasonEn: Pairs with: The web approximation of official lensing: the 1px inner highlight plus lit top edge matches Liquid Glass's lit form — the replication recipe lives in the capsule entry.

materials/specular-highlight.reasonZh: 搭配:深色玻璃卡的点睛层:顶缘高光带+同色 hairline 让磨砂面板「厚」起来——demo 底色即玻璃卡生产配方。
materials/specular-highlight.reasonEn: Pairs with: The finishing layer of the dark glass card: a top-edge highlight band plus a same-color hairline makes the frosted panel read thick — the demo base color is the production glass-card recipe.

materials/specular-highlight.reasonZh: 反向自「全息铬光」的精选:搭配关系,原句「卡面上跟随指针的镜面高光正是动态版配方:inset 顶缘高光带与光斑位移的做法在专门条目。」
materials/specular-highlight.reasonEn: Reverse from "Holographic Chrome" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The pointer-tracking specular on the card face is exactly the dynamic recipe: inset top-edge highlight bands and moving light spots live in the dedicated entry."

materials/swiftui-materials.reasonZh: 搭配:六档磨砂的 Web 近似全部落在 backdrop-filter 的「透明度×模糊」组合上(vibrancy 用前景透明度近似)。
materials/swiftui-materials.reasonEn: Pairs with: The web approximation of the six frost tiers rides entirely on backdrop-filter's opacity-by-blur combinations (vibrancy approximated by foreground opacity).

materials/swiftui-materials.reasonZh: 对比:Apple 两类材质的选型题:Liquid Glass 只给控件/导航功能层,内容层退回标准磨砂档位——何时用哪族。
materials/swiftui-materials.reasonEn: Contrasts: Apple's two-material selection question: Liquid Glass belongs to controls and nav functional layers, content falls back to the standard frost tiers — which family when.

materials/swiftui-materials.reasonZh: 反向自「Fluent 云母」的精选:对比关系,原句「平台材质清单的两种性格:SwiftUI 六档半透明磨砂逐元素透底,Mica 不透明单次采样只做长驻窗口底。」
materials/swiftui-materials.reasonEn: Reverse from "Fluent Mica" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two temperaments in platform material menus: SwiftUI's six translucent frost tiers pass the backdrop through per element, Mica is opaque single-sample for the resident window base."

materials/theme-shadow.reasonZh: 对比:高度语言的两档:「贴地」是紧贴椭圆接触阴影,「悬浮」是偏移大、更弥散的投影——先分清高度叙事再选阴影。
materials/theme-shadow.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two tiers of height language: 'grounded' is the tight elliptical contact shadow, 'floating' the larger, softer offset — settle the height story before picking shadows.

materials/theme-shadow.reasonZh: 搭配:空间 UI 以「少量大阴影」把深度当层级语言——海拔阴影正是它落到 Web 的参数化件。
materials/theme-shadow.reasonEn: Pairs with: Spatial UI treats depth as hierarchy with a few large shadows — elevation shadowing is its parameterized piece on the web.

materials/theme-shadow.reasonZh: 路径「从零到一块玻璃卡」的下一站:自定义控件必配按压态(Apple 铁律):scale 0.96 + alpha 状态层为什么必须成对出现,触感不靠玻璃本身表达。
materials/theme-shadow.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Zero to Glass" path: Custom controls always carry a press state (Apple's rule): why scale 0.96 + an alpha state layer must appear as a pair, and why touch feedback never rides on the glass itself.

motion/choreography.reasonZh: 搭配:「方向即空间模型」的完整模式表在 page-transitions:通知自顶部、抽屉自侧缘、sheet 自底部的 M3 官方归纳与本条目同源。
motion/choreography.reasonEn: Pairs with: The full pattern table behind 'direction is the spatial model' lives in page-transitions: notifications from top, drawers from the side, sheets from the bottom — same M3 source.

motion/choreography.reasonZh: 搭配:逐字标题接力共享同一套交错数学:总铺开时间 = stagger×(字符数−1)+rise,标题越长 stagger 越要小——kinetic-typography 给出完整账。
motion/choreography.reasonEn: Pairs with: Per-character headline reveals share the same stagger math: total spread = stagger×(chars−1)+rise, so longer titles need smaller staggers — kinetic-typography does the accounting.

motion/choreography.reasonZh: 反向自「滚动驱动动画」的精选:搭配关系,原句「长列表入场从一次性 stagger 换成滚动触发 reveal 的正规路径——choreography 条目明示 20 项以上改走这里。」
motion/choreography.reasonEn: Reverse from "Scroll-driven Animations" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The sanctioned path from one-shot stagger to scroll-triggered reveals — choreography explicitly redirects lists beyond ~20 items here."

motion/count-up.reasonZh: 先修:逐帧滚动的数字必须等宽,否则宽度逐帧抖动——本条目结构第一课就是 tabular-nums,先把 OpenType tnum 的原理搞懂。
motion/count-up.reasonEn: Requires: Frame-updating digits must be tabular or the width jitters every frame — this entry's structural lesson one is tabular-nums; understand OpenType tnum first.

motion/count-up.reasonZh: 搭配:加载完成的收尾交接就是 count-up:进度条消失、终值揭晓——两条目把「等待」与「揭晓」拼成完整时间轴。
motion/count-up.reasonEn: Pairs with: The completion hand-off is count-up: the progress bar exits and the final value reveals — together they form the full wait-then-reveal timeline.

motion/count-up.reasonZh: 反向自「便当盒布局」的精选:搭配关系,原句「bento 指标卡的数据登场仪式:数值从 0 滚到终点的计数动画,正是仪表盘指标的标配。」
motion/count-up.reasonEn: Reverse from "Bento Grid" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The data entrance ritual of bento stat cards: the count-up from zero to the final value is the dashboard-metric standard."

motion/cubic-bezier.reasonZh: 延伸:会调四控制点之后,easing-math 是曲线的数学层:牛顿迭代求值、linear() 采样偏差,浏览器引擎同款算法。
motion/cubic-bezier.reasonEn: Extends: Once you can tune the four control points, easing-math is the math layer: Newton-iteration evaluation and linear() sampling error — the algorithms browser engines run.

motion/cubic-bezier.reasonZh: 搭配:单条曲线的语义(过冲、减速收尾)读完后,官方六组「曲线×时长」配对表告诉你哪种过场用哪条曲线。
motion/cubic-bezier.reasonEn: Pairs with: After reading what one curve means (overshoot, decelerating stop), the official six-pair easing×duration table tells you which curve each transition type takes.

motion/cubic-bezier.reasonZh: 反向自「物理弹簧」的精选:对比关系,原句「弹簧与贝塞尔二选一时的边界:单段 cubic-bezier 画不出可打断、继承速度的真弹簧——两条目把「什么时候不该用贝塞尔」讲成对照表。」
motion/cubic-bezier.reasonEn: Reverse from "Physics Spring (Motion)" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "The boundary when choosing spring vs bezier: a single cubic-bezier cannot express an interruptible, velocity-inheriting true spring — the two entries form that comparison."

motion/damping-craft.reasonZh: 先修:ζ=c/(2√(km))、过冲公式与整定时间的推导和仿真对拍在 spring-integrator——先过一遍数学,ζ 档位表才不是口诀。
motion/damping-craft.reasonEn: Requires: The derivation of ζ=c/(2√(km)), the overshoot formula and settling time, verified against simulation, live in spring-integrator — do the math first so the ζ table isn't a chant.

motion/damping-craft.reasonZh: 搭配:同一张 ζ 档位表的工程化落点:分段控件滑签的 300/25(ζ≈0.72)档与反例 500/50 过阻尼档,在 slot-spring 现场演示。
motion/damping-craft.reasonEn: Pairs with: The engineering landing of the same ζ table: segmented-control pill at 300/25 (ζ≈0.72) and the overdamped 500/50 counterexample, demonstrated live in slot-spring.

motion/damping-craft.reasonZh: 反向自「物理弹簧」的精选:搭配关系,原句「调 stiffness/damping 前先查 ζ 档位:Motion 默认 100/10 即 ζ=0.5(过冲约 16%),damping-craft 把「弹不弹」算给你看。」
motion/damping-craft.reasonEn: Reverse from "Physics Spring (Motion)" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Check the ζ table before tuning stiffness/damping: Motion's default 100/10 is ζ=0.5 (≈16% overshoot) — damping-craft computes how bouncy a setting feels."

motion/easing-math.reasonZh: 搭配:动画数学的两半在此会师:easing-math 管贝塞尔反解与 linear() 采样,spring-integrator 管弹簧数值积分——条目结尾互称「另一半数学」。
motion/easing-math.reasonEn: Pairs with: The two halves of animation math meet here: bezier solving and linear() sampling in easing-math, spring numerical integration in spring-integrator — each calls the other 'the other half'.

motion/easing-math.reasonZh: 搭配:曲线求值数学如何落到设计层:进出曲线对(handoff)的 C¹ 连续交接就是本条目牛顿迭代/段插值在生产里的用法。
motion/easing-math.reasonEn: Pairs with: How curve-evaluation math lands at the design layer: handoff's C¹-continuous drag-to-spring junction is Newton iteration and segment interpolation in production.

motion/easing-math.reasonZh: 路径「动效基本功」的下一站:曲线知识立刻用于最小交互单元(按压):Material 的 state layer 是官方落点,HIG「输入方式决定动效强度」在此落成手感。
motion/easing-math.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Motion Fundamentals" path: Curve knowledge lands immediately on the smallest interaction unit, the press: Material's state layer is the official anchor, and HIG's "input method sets motion intensity" becomes feel here.

motion/easing-pairs.reasonZh: 搭配:交错入场的 250ms std-decel / 退场 200ms std-accel 直接出自这张官方配对表——choreography 是它的编排应用现场。
motion/easing-pairs.reasonEn: Pairs with: The staggered entrance 250ms std-decel and exit 200ms std-accel come straight from this official pairing table — choreography is where it's applied to orchestration.

motion/easing-pairs.reasonZh: 搭配:配对表在 SPA 路由上的 API 落地:整页过场的时长曲线覆写到 ::view-transition-* 伪元素——条目原文明示去 view-transitions。
motion/easing-pairs.reasonEn: Pairs with: Where the pairing table lands as an API for SPA routes: page-level durations and curves overwrite the ::view-transition-* pseudo-elements — this entry points to view-transitions.

motion/easing-pairs.reasonZh: 反向自「贝塞尔缓动」的精选:搭配关系,原句「单条曲线的语义(过冲、减速收尾)读完后,官方六组「曲线×时长」配对表告诉你哪种过场用哪条曲线。」
motion/easing-pairs.reasonEn: Reverse from "Cubic Bézier Easing" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "After reading what one curve means (overshoot, decelerating stop), the official six-pair easing×duration table tells you which curve each transition type takes."

motion/flip-technique.reasonZh: 对比:FLIP 明示边界:重排补间归它,连续拖拽跟手不归它——那是直接操纵+弹簧的领域(handoff-curves)。
motion/flip-technique.reasonEn: Contrasts: FLIP states its own boundary: reorder tweening is its domain, continuous drag-follow is not — that belongs to direct manipulation plus springs (handoff-curves).

motion/flip-technique.reasonZh: 搭配:「昂贵的事情只做一次、只动 transform」的性能底线在本条目与 smooth-craft 之间互相引用——FLIP 是它的一次性重排特例。
motion/flip-technique.reasonEn: Pairs with: 'Do expensive things once, animate only transform' is the performance floor cross-cited between this entry and smooth-craft — FLIP is its one-shot reorder special case.

motion/flip-technique.reasonZh: 反向自「视图过渡」的精选:对比关系,原句「同一思路的两代实现二选一:手写 FLIP 自己量测反向 transform,View Transitions 让浏览器拍快照接管——flip-technique 条目把这个对照写明。」
motion/flip-technique.reasonEn: Reverse from "View Transitions" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two generations of one idea: hand-rolled FLIP measures and inverts transforms yourself, View Transitions lets the browser snapshot — flip-technique spells out that comparison."

motion/handoff-curves.reasonZh: 先修:「抄弹簧先算 ζ」:速度灌进低阻尼弹簧(ζ<0.4)会失控过冲——先在 damping-craft 过 ζ 手感分档,再决定释放弹簧参数。
motion/handoff-curves.reasonEn: Requires: 'Compute ζ before copying spring numbers': injecting velocity into a low-damping spring (ζ<0.4) overshoots wildly — go through damping-craft's ζ bands before picking release parameters.

motion/handoff-curves.reasonZh: 搭配:释放段就是一颗 physics 弹簧:「打断瞬间速度不归零」的继承语义与 Motion 文档同源——弹簧参数语义在 motion-spring。
motion/handoff-curves.reasonEn: Pairs with: The release segment is a physics spring: the 'velocity not zeroed on interrupt' inheritance semantics come from the same Motion docs — parameter semantics live in motion-spring.

motion/handoff-curves.reasonZh: 反向自「惯性手势」的精选:对比关系,原句「inertia 滑行没有到位回弹、越界才换边界弹簧;handoff 是拖拽与弹簧的速度接力——两种释放物理,条目原文互为对照。」
motion/handoff-curves.reasonEn: Reverse from "Inertia Gesture (Motion)" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Inertia gliding has no arrival bounce — only boundary springs on overflow; handoff is drag-to-spring velocity relay: two release physics, cross-referenced as contrasts."

motion/haptics-web.reasonZh: 搭配:触觉脉冲必须有同步的视觉回声:按压态的色彩/透明度反馈就是那个回声——haptics 条目原文互指 press-feedback。
motion/haptics-web.reasonEn: Pairs with: A haptic pulse needs a synchronized visual echo: the press state's color/opacity feedback is that echo — the haptics entry points to press-feedback itself.

motion/haptics-web.reasonZh: 搭配:HIG 的 Notification 三件套(success/warning/error)就是为操作成败设计的脉冲,与 toast 的结果反馈同步触发——两条目共享这个场景。
motion/haptics-web.reasonEn: Pairs with: HIG's Notification trio (success/warning/error) are pulse sequences designed for operation outcomes, fired alongside toasts — the shared scene of both entries.

motion/haptics-web.reasonZh: 反向自「果冻凝胶材质」的精选:搭配关系,原句「按压 squash 回弹常配一段触觉脉冲:Web 唯一通道是 navigator.vibrate,段数语义对齐 HIG 三类预设。」
motion/haptics-web.reasonEn: Reverse from "Gel Material" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Squash-and-rebound often pairs with a haptic pulse: navigator.vibrate is the web's only channel, its segments aligned to HIG's three presets."

motion/inertia-gesture.reasonZh: 对比:inertia 滑行没有到位回弹、越界才换边界弹簧;handoff 是拖拽与弹簧的速度接力——两种释放物理,条目原文互为对照。
motion/inertia-gesture.reasonEn: Contrasts: Inertia gliding has no arrival bounce — only boundary springs on overflow; handoff is drag-to-spring velocity relay: two release physics, cross-referenced as contrasts.

motion/inertia-gesture.reasonZh: 搭配:越界兜底就是一颗弹簧(bounceStiffness 500 / bounceDamping 10)——inertia 与 physics 弹簧同属手势动效全家桶。
motion/inertia-gesture.reasonEn: Pairs with: The boundary fallback is literally a spring (bounceStiffness 500 / bounceDamping 10) — inertia and physics springs form one gesture-motion family.

motion/inertia-gesture.reasonZh: 反向自「滚动吸附」的精选:对比关系,原句「做「一滑一停」先二选一:原生 scroll-snap 零 JS 接管停靠,还是 JS inertia+modifyTarget 自算物理——两条目互指对方补另一半。」
motion/inertia-gesture.reasonEn: Reverse from "Scroll Snap" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "For 'flick-and-stop', choose first: native scroll-snap takes over docking with zero JS, or JS inertia+modifyTarget computes the physics — each entry points to the other for its half."

motion/kinetic-typography.reasonZh: 先修:轴动画的前提是轴体系:wght/wdth 注册轴范围与 @font-face 区间声明在 variable-fonts 是基础条目——本条目原文如此分工。
motion/kinetic-typography.reasonEn: Requires: Axis animation presupposes the axis system: registered wght/wdth ranges and @font-face interval declarations are the foundation entry (variable-fonts) — this entry says so itself.

motion/kinetic-typography.reasonZh: 搭配:标题逐字接力可以嵌进容器转场:本条目原文明示与 page-transitions 的 container transform 衔接。
motion/kinetic-typography.reasonEn: Pairs with: Character-by-character headline reveals can nest inside container transitions: this entry itself names the connection to page-transitions.

motion/kinetic-typography.reasonZh: 反向自「编排交错」的精选:搭配关系,原句「逐字标题揭示就是字符级 stagger:同一套 i×间隔数学,加上 mask 裁剪与 aria 整句——kinetic-typography 展开。」
motion/kinetic-typography.reasonEn: Reverse from "Stagger Orchestration (Motion)" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Per-character headline reveals are character-level staggers: the same i×interval math plus mask clipping and whole-sentence aria — kinetic-typography expands it."

motion/linear-easing.reasonZh: 先修:采样输入就是弹簧的 k/c/m 物理参数——先懂 stiffness/damping 的弹簧语义,才谈把它们编译成 linear()。
motion/linear-easing.reasonEn: Requires: The sampling inputs are spring physics k/c/m — understand stiffness/damping semantics before compiling them into linear().

motion/linear-easing.reasonZh: 延伸:编译产物如何被浏览器消费是下一步:linear() 的段内插值、钳制与求值规范(CSS Easing 2)在 easing-math 逐条可对账。
motion/linear-easing.reasonEn: Extends: How the compiled output is consumed comes next: linear() segment interpolation, clamping and the CSS Easing 2 evaluation spec, checkable step by step in easing-math.

motion/linear-easing.reasonZh: 反向自「丝滑工艺」的精选:搭配关系,原句「工艺清单最后一条「弹簧烤进 CSS 用 linear() 采样」的完整管线:采样、抽稀、产物体积都在 linear-easing 展开。」
motion/linear-easing.reasonEn: Reverse from "Smoothness Craft" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The last item of the craft checklist — baking springs into CSS via linear() — becomes a full pipeline in linear-easing: sampling, simplification, output size."

motion/m3-duration-tokens.reasonZh: 搭配:同一张官方选型表的两半:这里管四档 16 枚时长令牌,easing-pairs 管「过场类型→曲线+时长」的六组配对。
motion/m3-duration-tokens.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two halves of one official selection table: the four-tier 16 duration tokens here, the six easing×duration pairings per transition type in easing-pairs.

motion/m3-duration-tokens.reasonZh: 搭配:完成态淡入的 200ms + Standard 就是 short4 官方档——进度条形态切换的每一段时长都能回表对档。
motion/m3-duration-tokens.reasonEn: Pairs with: The completion fade's 200ms + Standard is the official short4 tier — every phase of the progress timeline maps back to a token tier.

motion/m3-duration-tokens.reasonZh: 反向自「M3 弹簧令牌」的精选:搭配关系,原句「M3 官方 token 表的两半:本条目管曲线与 Compose damping/stiffness,duration 条目管四档 16 枚时长令牌——选档时对着读。」
motion/m3-duration-tokens.reasonEn: Reverse from "M3 Spring Tokens" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The two halves of M3's official token set: curves + Compose damping/stiffness here, the four-tier 16 duration tokens there — read side by side when picking tiers."

motion/m3-spring-tokens.reasonZh: 先修:token 表的 Web 落地就是「cubic-bezier + 时长」逐档抄写——先会读四控制点,12 枚 token 才抄得准。
motion/m3-spring-tokens.reasonEn: Requires: The Web form of these tokens is verbatim cubic-bezier + duration per token — read the four control points first to transcribe the 12 tokens accurately.

motion/m3-spring-tokens.reasonZh: 搭配:M3 官方 token 表的两半:本条目管曲线与 Compose damping/stiffness,duration 条目管四档 16 枚时长令牌——选档时对着读。
motion/m3-spring-tokens.reasonEn: Pairs with: The two halves of M3's official token set: curves + Compose damping/stiffness here, the four-tier 16 duration tokens there — read side by side when picking tiers.

motion/m3-spring-tokens.reasonZh: 反向自「SwiftUI 弹簧」的精选:搭配关系,原句「iOS 与 Android 各自把 ζ 做成官方 API 的两种方式:Apple 给 response/dampingFraction,Google 给 12 枚换算 token 表。」
motion/m3-spring-tokens.reasonEn: Reverse from "SwiftUI Spring" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Two platform answers to exposing ζ as an official API: Apple's response/dampingFraction vs Google's 12-token conversion table."

motion/magnetic-hover.reasonZh: 延伸:lerp 回位是「先快后慢」的指数逼近;想要真弹簧的速度接力回弹,handoff-curves 是自然升级。
motion/magnetic-hover.reasonEn: Extends: lerp return is exponential ease-out; for true spring return with velocity hand-off, handoff-curves is the natural upgrade.

motion/magnetic-hover.reasonZh: 搭配:磁吸管「预告」、按压反馈管「确认」:同一颗按钮的两层触感,HIG 高频交互告诫两边都引。
motion/magnetic-hover.reasonEn: Pairs with: Magnetic pull previews, press feedback confirms: two layers of feel on one button, both citing HIG's warning on high-frequency interactions.

motion/magnetic-hover.reasonZh: 反向自「丝滑工艺」的精选:搭配关系,原句「磁吸按钮是「只动 transform、逐帧直写」工艺的教科书场景:magnetic-hover 条目自认与 smooth-craft 的这层关系。」
motion/magnetic-hover.reasonEn: Reverse from "Smoothness Craft" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The magnetic button is the textbook scene for write-transform-per-frame craft: magnetic-hover itself names this relationship to smooth-craft."

motion/motion-spring.reasonZh: 对比:弹簧与贝塞尔二选一时的边界:单段 cubic-bezier 画不出可打断、继承速度的真弹簧——两条目把「什么时候不该用贝塞尔」讲成对照表。
motion/motion-spring.reasonEn: Contrasts: The boundary when choosing spring vs bezier: a single cubic-bezier cannot express an interruptible, velocity-inheriting true spring — the two entries form that comparison.

motion/motion-spring.reasonZh: 搭配:调 stiffness/damping 前先查 ζ 档位:Motion 默认 100/10 即 ζ=0.5(过冲约 16%),damping-craft 把「弹不弹」算给你看。
motion/motion-spring.reasonEn: Pairs with: Check the ζ table before tuning stiffness/damping: Motion's default 100/10 is ζ=0.5 (≈16% overshoot) — damping-craft computes how bouncy a setting feels.

motion/motion-spring.reasonZh: 反向自「SwiftUI 弹簧」的精选:对比关系,原句「两套弹簧参数轴不能直接互传:SwiftUI 的 response/dampingFraction 与 Motion 的 stiffness/damping 必须走二阶阻尼谐振子换算——两条目并读就是换算对照。」
motion/motion-spring.reasonEn: Reverse from "SwiftUI Spring" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "The two spring parameter axes don't interchange directly: SwiftUI's response/dampingFraction vs Motion's stiffness/damping must go through the damped-oscillator conversion — read together they are that table."

motion/overlay-entrance.reasonZh: 搭配:浮层入场只动 opacity/transform、will-change 用后即撤——正是 smooth-craft 工艺清单在浮层场景的逐条执行。
motion/overlay-entrance.reasonEn: Pairs with: Overlay entrances animate only opacity/transform and remove will-change after use — smooth-craft's craft checklist executed in the overlay scene.

motion/overlay-entrance.reasonZh: 延伸:浮层「从触发钮长出来」的 origin 语义读完,page-transitions 把空间模型升到屏与屏:container/forward/lateral/toplevel 六模式选型。
motion/overlay-entrance.reasonEn: Extends: After the 'grows from its trigger' origin semantics, page-transitions scales the spatial model up to screens: the container/forward/lateral/toplevel pattern table.

motion/overlay-entrance.reasonZh: 反向自「Toast 弹簧入场」的精选:搭配关系,原句「「入场短于退场」铁律的第二个浮层落点:toast 0.35s 弹入/0.4s 缓出,overlay 条目给 shadcn 200ms 入/150ms 出的同一纪律。」
motion/overlay-entrance.reasonEn: Reverse from "Toast Spring Entrance" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The 'enter no longer than exit' rule's second overlay instance: toast 0.35s spring-in / 0.4s ease-out; overlay-entrance gives the same discipline as shadcn 200ms in / 150ms out."

motion/page-transitions.reasonZh: 搭配:六种转场模式的时长都回 M3 官方档:container 500ms、进入 decel 400ms、退出 accel 200ms——选完模式回表取令牌。
motion/page-transitions.reasonEn: Pairs with: All six transition patterns resolve to M3's official tiers: container 500ms, entrance decel 400ms, exit accel 200ms — pick the pattern, then look the token up.

motion/page-transitions.reasonZh: 搭配:模式只定语义,时长与曲线由官方配对表定:forward 的进入 decel 400 / 退出 accel 200 就是配对表两端的直用。
motion/page-transitions.reasonEn: Pairs with: Patterns decide semantics; the official pairing table decides duration and curve — forward's decel 400 in / accel 200 out is used straight from that table's ends.

motion/page-transitions.reasonZh: 反向自「视图过渡」的精选:先修关系,原句「API 机制(快照、伪元素树、morph 赋名)读完,page-transitions 回答更高一层的问题:哪种转场模式服务哪种起止关系。」
motion/page-transitions.reasonEn: Reverse from "View Transitions" curated: Requires relation, quoting "Once the API mechanics are clear (snapshots, pseudo-element tree, named morphs), page-transitions answers the higher question: which pattern fits which start/end relationship."

motion/parallax.reasonZh: 先修:视差就是 scroll() 时间轴上的分层速率差——先懂 animation-timeline 与 animation-range 基础,分层乘数才读得懂。
motion/parallax.reasonEn: Requires: Parallax is layered speed ratios on a scroll() timeline — understand animation-timeline and animation-range basics before the per-layer multipliers make sense.

motion/parallax.reasonZh: 搭配:iOS 前进/后退的层级视差(背景慢于前景)是两条目共享的官方例证——滚动侧与转场侧各讲半边。
motion/parallax.reasonEn: Pairs with: iOS forward/back transitions using parallax (background slower than foreground) are the official example both entries share — scroll side and transition side each tell half.

motion/parallax.reasonZh: 反向自「极光渐变」的精选:搭配关系,原句「媒体英雄区配方把两者拼在一起:极光垫氛围底,视差用滚动速率差推内容深度。」
motion/parallax.reasonEn: Reverse from "Aurora Gradient" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The media-hero recipe puts them together: aurora lays the ambient bed, parallax pushes content depth with scroll-rate differences."

motion/press-feedback.reasonZh: 搭配:小控件反馈的时长选档实例:按压瞬时、松手 100–120ms,对齐 M3 short 档的官方口径。
motion/press-feedback.reasonEn: Pairs with: The duration-tier case study for control feedback: instant press, 100–120ms release, aligned with M3's official short tier.

motion/press-feedback.reasonZh: 搭配:按压反馈只动 scale/opacity/filter 的性能纪律,是 smooth-craft「只动合成器属性」总纲的具体落点。
motion/press-feedback.reasonEn: Pairs with: Press feedback animates only scale/opacity/filter — a concrete application of smooth-craft's compositor-only master rule.

motion/press-feedback.reasonZh: 路径「从零到一块玻璃卡」的下一站:玻璃最易翻车在可读性:掌握对比度公式,才能按透出的最亮/最暗背景两端核对玻璃上文字的 4.5:1。
motion/press-feedback.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Zero to Glass" path: Readability is where glass fails: master the contrast ratio formula to check text-on-glass against the brightest and darkest backdrop extremes for 4.5:1.

motion/progress-motion.reasonZh: 搭配:「越接近目标动力越强」的完整效应与伦理边界(人为进度必须诚实)在 goal-gradient 条目——本条目把它用在百分比收尾段。
motion/progress-motion.reasonEn: Pairs with: The full goal-gradient effect and its ethical boundary (artificial progress must stay honest) live in the goal-gradient entry — this entry applies it to the percent phase's finish.

motion/progress-motion.reasonZh: 搭配:「用形态切换消化等待」的同一个 Google 搜索案例(调研 04§2.2)在两条目各讲一半:这里讲进度并入转场,choreography 讲滑入即编排。
motion/progress-motion.reasonEn: Pairs with: The same Google Search case (research 04§2.2) of digesting wait into motion appears in both entries: here as progress merged into the transition, in choreography as slide-in-as-orchestration.

motion/progress-motion.reasonZh: 反向自「数字滚动」的精选:搭配关系,原句「加载完成的收尾交接就是 count-up:进度条消失、终值揭晓——两条目把「等待」与「揭晓」拼成完整时间轴。」
motion/progress-motion.reasonEn: Reverse from "Count-Up Number" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The completion hand-off is count-up: the progress bar exits and the final value reveals — together they form the full wait-then-reveal timeline."

motion/scroll-driven-animations.reasonZh: 搭配:滚动侧两大原生能力同框:scroll()/view() 时间轴驱动动画,scroll-snap-type 管停靠——互不替代,常一起上。
motion/scroll-driven-animations.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two native scroll powers side by side: scroll()/view() timelines drive animations, scroll-snap-type handles docking — neither replaces the other.

motion/scroll-driven-animations.reasonZh: 搭配:长列表入场从一次性 stagger 换成滚动触发 reveal 的正规路径——choreography 条目明示 20 项以上改走这里。
motion/scroll-driven-animations.reasonEn: Pairs with: The sanctioned path from one-shot stagger to scroll-triggered reveals — choreography explicitly redirects lists beyond ~20 items here.

motion/scroll-driven-animations.reasonZh: 反向自「视差滚动」的精选:延伸关系,原句「视差就是 scroll() 时间轴上的分层速率差——先懂 animation-timeline 与 animation-range 基础,分层乘数才读得懂。」
motion/scroll-driven-animations.reasonEn: Reverse from "Parallax" curated: Extends relation, quoting "Parallax is layered speed ratios on a scroll() timeline — understand animation-timeline and animation-range basics before the per-layer multipliers make sense."

motion/scroll-overflow.reasonZh: 搭配:「容器永远同时挂 overscroll-behavior: contain」是两条目共享的同一条纪律——snap 管停靠,overscroll 管链式滚动边界。
motion/scroll-overflow.reasonEn: Pairs with: 'Always pair the container with overscroll-behavior: contain' is one discipline shared by both entries — snap owns docking, overscroll owns the scroll-chain boundary.

motion/scroll-overflow.reasonZh: 搭配:同一个弹层的两半工程:overlay-entrance 管入场编排与焦点交接,本条目管内层滚动链治理(overscroll-behavior + 锁背景)。
motion/scroll-overflow.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two halves of the same dialog: overlay-entrance owns entrance choreography and focus hand-off, this entry owns inner scroll-chain containment (overscroll-behavior + background lock).

motion/scroll-overflow.reasonZh: 反向自「自定义滚动条」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同一只滚动容器的两件治理:scrollbar-width/color 管滚动条形态与槽位,overscroll-behavior 管滚动链与回弹——thin + contain 是同一份惯例。」
motion/scroll-overflow.reasonEn: Reverse from "Custom Scrollbar" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Two governances of one scroll container: scrollbar-width/color own the bar's form and gutter, overscroll-behavior owns the scroll chain — thin + contain is one convention."

motion/scroll-snap.reasonZh: 对比:做「一滑一停」先二选一:原生 scroll-snap 零 JS 接管停靠,还是 JS inertia+modifyTarget 自算物理——两条目互指对方补另一半。
motion/scroll-snap.reasonEn: Contrasts: For 'flick-and-stop', choose first: native scroll-snap takes over docking with zero JS, or JS inertia+modifyTarget computes the physics — each entry points to the other for its half.

motion/scroll-snap.reasonZh: 搭配:吸顶导航与吸附滚动的配合件:scroll-padding 给 sticky 头部留位,否则停靠内容被遮——两条目在锚点定位场景互为搭子。
motion/scroll-snap.reasonEn: Pairs with: Sticky headers and snap scrolling are fittings for each other: scroll-padding reserves room for the sticky header, or docked content hides behind it — the anchor scene both entries serve.

motion/scroll-snap.reasonZh: 反向自「滚动驱动动画」的精选:搭配关系,原句「滚动侧两大原生能力同框:scroll()/view() 时间轴驱动动画,scroll-snap-type 管停靠——互不替代,常一起上。」
motion/scroll-snap.reasonEn: Reverse from "Scroll-driven Animations" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Two native scroll powers side by side: scroll()/view() timelines drive animations, scroll-snap-type handles docking — neither replaces the other."

motion/shake-decay.reasonZh: 先修:速度注入版抖动把初速度灌进欠阻尼弹簧——先懂 Motion 弹簧的 velocity 语义(缺省取当前值速度),再看抖动怎么搭。
motion/shake-decay.reasonEn: Requires: The velocity-injected shake pours an initial velocity into an underdamped spring — understand Motion's velocity semantics (defaults to current value velocity) first.

motion/shake-decay.reasonZh: 搭配:衰减公式 λ=ζω₀、包络半衰期 ln2/λ 与 Motion spring.ts 的 exponentialDecay 逐字对应——数学推导全在 spring-integrator 可验算。
motion/shake-decay.reasonEn: Pairs with: The decay formulas λ=ζω₀ and half-life ln2/λ correspond verbatim to Motion spring.ts's exponentialDecay — the full derivation is checkable in spring-integrator.

motion/shake-decay.reasonZh: 反向自「阻尼感设计」的精选:搭配关系,原句「错误抖动的衰减包络就是 ζ 与 λ 的应用:想要更慢衰减怎么同时调 damping 与 stiffness,本条目给公式,shake-decay 给实现。」
motion/shake-decay.reasonEn: Reverse from "Damping Ratio Craft" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "An error shake's decaying envelope is ζ and λ in action: how to slow the decay by co-tuning damping and stiffness — the formulas here, the implementation in shake-decay."

motion/skeleton-loading.reasonZh: 延伸:骨架形态的专条读完,progress-motion 是完整时间轴:骨架→循环→百分比的形态切换阈值(NN/g)与目标梯度收尾。
motion/skeleton-loading.reasonEn: Extends: After the skeleton-specific entry, progress-motion is the full timeline: the skeleton→loop→percent switching thresholds (NN/g) and the goal-gradient finish.

motion/skeleton-loading.reasonZh: 搭配:内容淡入的 200ms 不是拍脑袋:short4 200ms + Standard easing 正是 M3 时长令牌表的官方档位。
motion/skeleton-loading.reasonEn: Pairs with: The 200ms content fade-in is not a guess: short4 200ms + Standard easing comes straight from M3's official duration-token table.

motion/skeleton-loading.reasonZh: 反向自「便当盒布局」的精选:搭配关系,原句「bento 首屏的加载前奏:骨架块尺寸=真实卡片尺寸,内容到达零位移换载——布局的预告片。」
motion/skeleton-loading.reasonEn: Reverse from "Bento Grid" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The first-load overture of a bento screen: skeleton blocks sized exactly like the real cards so content lands with zero shift — the layout's trailer."

motion/slot-spring.reasonZh: 搭配:BuildUI AnimatedTabs 的单一 layoutId 气泡就是库内自动做的 FLIP——手写四步在 flip-technique,库版省掉量测样板。
motion/slot-spring.reasonEn: Pairs with: BuildUI AnimatedTabs' single layoutId pill is FLIP performed automatically inside the library — the hand-written four steps live in flip-technique, the library version skips the boilerplate.

motion/slot-spring.reasonZh: 搭配:槽位间连续点击的中断续接(当前值+当前速度续跑)在 handoff-curves 展开成完整时序范式——两条目互链的「弹簧手感」专条。
motion/slot-spring.reasonEn: Pairs with: Slot-to-slot retargeting that continues from current position+velocity is expanded into a full timing pattern in handoff-curves — the two entries cross-link as spring-feel companions.

motion/slot-spring.reasonZh: 反向自「阻尼感设计」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同一张 ζ 档位表的工程化落点:分段控件滑签的 300/25(ζ≈0.72)档与反例 500/50 过阻尼档,在 slot-spring 现场演示。」
motion/slot-spring.reasonEn: Reverse from "Damping Ratio Craft" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The engineering landing of the same ζ table: segmented-control pill at 300/25 (ζ≈0.72) and the overdamped 500/50 counterexample, demonstrated live in slot-spring."

motion/smooth-craft.reasonZh: 搭配:工艺清单最后一条「弹簧烤进 CSS 用 linear() 采样」的完整管线:采样、抽稀、产物体积都在 linear-easing 展开。
motion/smooth-craft.reasonEn: Pairs with: The last item of the craft checklist — baking springs into CSS via linear() — becomes a full pipeline in linear-easing: sampling, simplification, output size.

motion/smooth-craft.reasonZh: 搭配:磁吸按钮是「只动 transform、逐帧直写」工艺的教科书场景:magnetic-hover 条目自认与 smooth-craft 的这层关系。
motion/smooth-craft.reasonEn: Pairs with: The magnetic button is the textbook scene for write-transform-per-frame craft: magnetic-hover itself names this relationship to smooth-craft.

motion/smooth-craft.reasonZh: 反向自「按压反馈对」的精选:搭配关系,原句「按压反馈只动 scale/opacity/filter 的性能纪律,是 smooth-craft「只动合成器属性」总纲的具体落点。」
motion/smooth-craft.reasonEn: Reverse from "Press Feedback Pair" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Press feedback animates only scale/opacity/filter — a concrete application of smooth-craft's compositor-only master rule."

motion/spring-integrator.reasonZh: 延伸:积分器每帧从 (xₙ, vₙ) 继续迭代,这正是「可打断物理动画」的工程含义——slot-spring 是它的槽位工程化现场(条目结尾姊妹清单明示)。
motion/spring-integrator.reasonEn: Extends: The integrator continues each frame from (xₙ, vₙ) — exactly what 'interruptible physics animation' means in engineering; slot-spring is its slot-based engineering landing (named in this entry's sister list).

motion/spring-integrator.reasonZh: 搭配:同一方程的两个身份:这里解数学(k=100/c=10/m=1 即 Motion 默认弹簧的解析对拍),motion-spring 是把它做成 API 的库版。
motion/spring-integrator.reasonEn: Pairs with: One equation, two identities: the math here (k=100/c=10/m=1 is Motion's default spring, analytics cross-checked) and the library API version in motion-spring.

motion/spring-integrator.reasonZh: 反向自「阻尼感设计」的精选:延伸关系,原句「ζ=c/(2√(km))、过冲公式与整定时间的推导和仿真对拍在 spring-integrator——先过一遍数学,ζ 档位表才不是口诀。」
motion/spring-integrator.reasonEn: Reverse from "Damping Ratio Craft" curated: Extends relation, quoting "The derivation of ζ=c/(2√(km)), the overshoot formula and settling time, verified against simulation, live in spring-integrator — do the math first so the ζ table isn't a chant."

motion/stagger-orchestration.reasonZh: 对比:同一套交错数学的两个实现二选一:这里是 Motion staggerChildren 的库版编排,choreography 是零依赖纯 CSS 版。
motion/stagger-orchestration.reasonEn: Contrasts: One stagger math, two implementations: Motion's staggerChildren orchestration here vs the zero-dependency pure-CSS version in choreography — pick one.

motion/stagger-orchestration.reasonZh: 搭配:逐字标题揭示就是字符级 stagger:同一套 i×间隔数学,加上 mask 裁剪与 aria 整句——kinetic-typography 展开。
motion/stagger-orchestration.reasonEn: Pairs with: Per-character headline reveals are character-level staggers: the same i×interval math plus mask clipping and whole-sentence aria — kinetic-typography expands it.

motion/stagger-orchestration.reasonZh: 反向自「滚动驱动动画」的精选:搭配关系,原句「滚动侧读完看编排侧的边界:长列表(>20 项)整段 stagger 尾部等待线性增长,分界与参数轴在专门条目。」
motion/stagger-orchestration.reasonEn: Reverse from "Scroll-driven Animations" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "After the scroll side, the orchestration boundary: whole-list stagger beyond ~20 items grows tail waits linearly — the cutoff and math live in stagger."

motion/swiftui-spring.reasonZh: 先修:dampingFraction 就是阻尼比 ζ(Apple 官方默认 0.825)——不懂 ζ 与过冲公式,读这组参数轴只能凭感觉。
motion/swiftui-spring.reasonEn: Requires: dampingFraction is exactly the damping ratio ζ (Apple's default 0.825) — without ζ and the overshoot formula, this parameter axis is just vibes.

motion/swiftui-spring.reasonZh: 对比:两套弹簧参数轴不能直接互传:SwiftUI 的 response/dampingFraction 与 Motion 的 stiffness/damping 必须走二阶阻尼谐振子换算——两条目并读就是换算对照。
motion/swiftui-spring.reasonEn: Contrasts: The two spring parameter axes don't interchange directly: SwiftUI's response/dampingFraction vs Motion's stiffness/damping must go through the damped-oscillator conversion — read together they are that table.

motion/swiftui-spring.reasonZh: 反向自「果冻凝胶材质」的精选:搭配关系,原句「果冻按压回弹的手感账:overshoot 回弹要一颗欠阻尼弹簧,response/dampingFraction 两个参数就是账本。」
motion/swiftui-spring.reasonEn: Reverse from "Gel Material" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The feel ledger of jelly rebound: an overshooting bounce needs an underdamped spring — response and dampingFraction are the ledger."

motion/theme-css-blobbing.titleZh: 液滴连接桥(metaball 单 path 融合)
motion/theme-css-blobbing.reasonZh: 搭配:原型通路接到生产级:多色/带内容的液体改走 metaball 单 path——拖拽场景里 Pointer Events 拖子液滴、膜逐帧跟随的先例在那边。
motion/theme-css-blobbing.reasonEn: Pairs with: From prototype route to production: multi-color or content-bearing liquids move to metaball's single path — the drag precedent of Pointer-Events-followed droplets and per-frame membranes lives there.

motion/theme-css-blobbing.reasonZh: 搭配:无 SVG 通路与 gooey 招互为参照:那边为滤镜付出逐帧重绘成本并留出血,这边以显式实底 + 高对比两大前提换零滤镜依赖。
motion/theme-css-blobbing.reasonEn: Pairs with: The no-SVG route and the gooey trick reference each other: there the filter pays a per-frame repaint cost plus bleed margins, here two hard preconditions (explicit backdrop, high contrast) buy zero filter dependency.

motion/theme-css-blobbing.reasonZh: 反向自「Gooey alpha 阈值滤镜」的精选:对比关系,原句「goo 的两条通路二选一:SVG 滤镜(blur + alpha 阈值)可叠加任意元素层,contrast+blur 是无 SVG 的 goo 通路——显式实底与高对比两大前提是它的代价。」
motion/theme-css-blobbing.reasonEn: Reverse from "Theme Gooey Filter" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two routes to goo: an SVG filter (blur + alpha threshold) layers over anything, contrast+blur is the goo route without SVG — at the cost of its two hard preconditions, an explicit backdrop and high contrast."

motion/theme-flip-stagger.reasonZh: 搭配:逐卡错峰就是同一套交错数学:第 i 项的延迟 ≈ i × stagger,这里把库版编排换成纯 CSS 3D 关键帧 + animationend 换面。
