motion/theme-flip-stagger.reasonEn: Pairs with: Per-card offsets are the same stagger math — item i starts at ≈ i × stagger — recast here as pure-CSS 3D keyframes with face swaps hooked on animationend.

motion/theme-flip-stagger.reasonZh: 搭配:换肤编排的姊妹篇:那边液块按级联逐块擦除(第 i 块在 i × 级联后启动),这边卡片逐张翻到 90° 侧棱换装——同构时间结构两种块形。
motion/theme-flip-stagger.reasonEn: Pairs with: Sister orchestrations of re-skinning: cells wipe in cascade (block i starts at i × cascade) there, cards flip to their 90° edge one by one here — one timing structure, two block shapes.

motion/theme-flip-stagger.reasonZh: 反向自「视图过渡」的精选:搭配关系,原句「元素级翻转换肤的 API 版与纯 CSS 版并读:同一手感、同一不对称时序,API 版有快照捕获成本,纯 CSS 版换面帧要自己落在 90°。」
motion/theme-flip-stagger.reasonEn: Reverse from "View Transitions" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Read the API version of the element flip re-skin next to the pure-CSS one: same feel, same asymmetric timing — the API version pays snapshot capture, the pure-CSS version must land the swap frame at 90° itself."

motion/theme-goo-filter.reasonZh: 对比:goo 的两条通路二选一:SVG 滤镜(blur + alpha 阈值)可叠加任意元素层,contrast+blur 是无 SVG 的 goo 通路——显式实底与高对比两大前提是它的代价。
motion/theme-goo-filter.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two routes to goo: an SVG filter (blur + alpha threshold) layers over anything, contrast+blur is the goo route without SVG — at the cost of its two hard preconditions, an explicit backdrop and high contrast.

motion/theme-goo-filter.titleZh: 液滴连接桥(metaball 单 path 融合)
motion/theme-goo-filter.reasonZh: 对比:多元素融合的两种实现易混:滤镜靠模糊+阈值判据粘连,metaball 用一条贝塞尔「连接膜」把两个圆焊成单条 path——性能与可控性互有胜负。
motion/theme-goo-filter.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two ways to fuse multiple elements, easy to blur together: the filter fuses by a blur-plus-threshold criterion, metaball welds two circles into one path with a bezier membrane — performance and control trade off.

motion/theme-goo-filter.reasonZh: 反向自「湍流液缘」的精选:对比关系,原句「同族液体滤镜二选一:goo 把容器内多个形状融成一体,湍流位移只扭单个遮罩的边——融合与扭边是两条通路,先分清再选。」
motion/theme-goo-filter.reasonEn: Reverse from "Turbulence Edge" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two liquid-filter routes to choose between: goo fuses multiple shapes inside a container, turbulence displacement twists one mask's edge only — fusion vs fringe, decide before picking."

motion/theme-liquid-reveal.reasonZh: 搭配:同族揭示的两个变体对照读:那边固定形状液块把舞台铺满后逐块擦除,这边是 VT 真揭示 + 液柱/液滴/波面联合轮廓逐帧重算。
motion/theme-liquid-reveal.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two variants of one reveal family: fixed-shape cells filling the stage and wiping block by block there, a true VT reveal with a per-frame column/droplet/wave joint contour here.

motion/theme-liquid-reveal.reasonZh: 搭配:整屏波浪与液柱涌流是同族两档:波浪涌入与其共享同一 VT 骨架,差异只在揭示主体是整片液面还是从按钮流出的联合轮廓。
motion/theme-liquid-reveal.reasonEn: Pairs with: Full-screen wave and pouring column are two tiers of one family: the wave flood shares the same VT skeleton, differing only in whether the reveal subject is one liquid surface or a joint contour pouring from the button.

motion/theme-liquid-reveal.titleZh: 液滴连接桥(metaball 单 path 融合)
motion/theme-liquid-reveal.reasonZh: 反向自「液滴连接桥(metaball 单 path 融合)」的精选:搭配关系,原句「「液柱—液滴—飞溅」联合轮廓的膜描述法读完,看它长成站点级配方:d 是液柱 + 分离液滴 + 飞溅液滴 + 波浪液面的逐帧并集。」
motion/theme-liquid-reveal.reasonEn: Reverse from "Theme Metaball Bridge" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "After the membrane description of the 'column-droplets-splash' joint contour, see it grow into a site-level recipe: d is the per-frame union of column, separated droplets, splash and wavy surface."

motion/theme-metaball-bridge.reasonZh: 对比:液态 path 的两条实现路线二选一:同构 path 靠「指令数、点数完全相同」才能插值,metaball 逐帧重算 d、断膜直接置空,不受环数约束。
motion/theme-metaball-bridge.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two implementations of liquid paths: same-structure paths interpolate only when instruction and point counts match exactly, while metaball recomputes d per frame and empties it on break — free of ring-count constraints.

motion/theme-metaball-bridge.reasonZh: 搭配:「液柱—液滴—飞溅」联合轮廓的膜描述法读完,看它长成站点级配方:d 是液柱 + 分离液滴 + 飞溅液滴 + 波浪液面的逐帧并集。
motion/theme-metaball-bridge.reasonEn: Pairs with: After the membrane description of the 'column-droplets-splash' joint contour, see it grow into a site-level recipe: d is the per-frame union of column, separated droplets, splash and wavy surface.

motion/theme-metaball-bridge.reasonZh: 反向自「Gooey alpha 阈值滤镜」的精选:对比关系,原句「多元素融合的两种实现易混:滤镜靠模糊+阈值判据粘连,metaball 用一条贝塞尔「连接膜」把两个圆焊成单条 path——性能与可控性互有胜负。」
motion/theme-metaball-bridge.reasonEn: Reverse from "Theme Gooey Filter" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two ways to fuse multiple elements, easy to blur together: the filter fuses by a blur-plus-threshold criterion, metaball welds two circles into one path with a bezier membrane — performance and control trade off."

motion/theme-reveal-wipes.reasonZh: 搭配:液块级联就是 stagger 数学的纯 CSS 现场版:第一项 0 延迟立即入场、末项在 stagger×(n−1) 后启动,这里即第 i 块在 i×级联后擦除。
motion/theme-reveal-wipes.reasonEn: Pairs with: The cell cascade is the stagger math performed in pure CSS: first item at zero delay, last at stagger×(n−1) — here the i-th cell wipes at i×cascade.

motion/theme-reveal-wipes.reasonZh: 对比:同一换肤骨架的两个几何答案易混:那边是官方圆形扩散(快照层被圆形 clip-path 逐步揭开),这边是其余几何的纯 overlay 逐块擦除。
motion/theme-reveal-wipes.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two geometric answers on one re-skin skeleton, easy to blur: the official circle reveal (snapshot layer opened step by step by a circular clip-path) vs pure-overlay per-cell wipes of every other geometry.

motion/theme-reveal-wipes.reasonZh: 反向自「元素级翻转换肤」的精选:搭配关系,原句「换肤编排的姊妹篇:那边液块按级联逐块擦除(第 i 块在 i × 级联后启动),这边卡片逐张翻到 90° 侧棱换装——同构时间结构两种块形。」
motion/theme-reveal-wipes.reasonEn: Reverse from "Theme Flip Stagger" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Sister orchestrations of re-skinning: cells wipe in cascade (block i starts at i × cascade) there, cards flip to their 90° edge one by one here — one timing structure, two block shapes."

motion/theme-toggle-morph.reasonZh: 搭配:gooey 招的滤镜配方与这条目同源:Bebber 基础 goo 原方(blur 10 + alpha 18/−7)在专门条目逐字展开,含出血与大面积性能三诫。
motion/theme-toggle-morph.reasonEn: Pairs with: The gooey trick's filter recipe shares this entry's source: Bebber's base goo formula (blur 10 + alpha 18/-7) unfolds verbatim there, with the bleed and large-area performance commandments.

motion/theme-toggle-morph.reasonZh: 搭配:按钮本体变形只管本页控件;跨页导航间的主题衔接升到屏与屏——「转场选型的主角不是动画,而是起止态关系」的模式表在 page-transitions。
motion/theme-toggle-morph.reasonEn: Pairs with: The button morph owns controls on this page only; theme continuity across navigations scales to screens — the pattern table where the start/end relationship, not the animation, decides the transition lives in page-transitions.

motion/theme-toggle-morph.titleZh: 液滴连接桥(metaball 单 path 融合)
motion/theme-toggle-morph.reasonZh: 反向自「液滴连接桥(metaball 单 path 融合)」的精选:对比关系,原句「液态 path 的两条实现路线二选一:同构 path 靠「指令数、点数完全相同」才能插值,metaball 逐帧重算 d、断膜直接置空,不受环数约束。」
motion/theme-toggle-morph.reasonEn: Reverse from "Theme Metaball Bridge" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two implementations of liquid paths: same-structure paths interpolate only when instruction and point counts match exactly, while metaball recomputes d per frame and empties it on break — free of ring-count constraints."

motion/theme-turbulence-edge.reasonZh: 对比:同族液体滤镜二选一:goo 把容器内多个形状融成一体,湍流位移只扭单个遮罩的边——融合与扭边是两条通路,先分清再选。
motion/theme-turbulence-edge.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two liquid-filter routes to choose between: goo fuses multiple shapes inside a container, turbulence displacement twists one mask's edge only — fusion vs fringe, decide before picking.

motion/theme-turbulence-edge.reasonZh: 搭配:同一枚 feTurbulence 的两种岗位:那边把噪声平铺成静态颗粒为渐变消色带,这边用 feDisplacementMap 把遮罩硬边扭成液缘。
motion/theme-turbulence-edge.reasonEn: Pairs with: One feTurbulence, two jobs: there it tiles noise into a static grain layer that de-bands gradients, here feDisplacementMap twists a mask's hard edge into a liquid fringe.

motion/theme-turbulence-edge.reasonZh: 反向自「波浪涌入」的精选:搭配关系,原句「平滑波身与湍流毛缘分层各司其职:波身由 JS 逐帧算 path,毛缘由滤镜静态扭出,两者可叠成「波身 + 毛缘」。」
motion/theme-turbulence-edge.reasonEn: Reverse from "Theme Wave Flood" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The smooth wave body and the turbulent fringe split across two layers: the body is a per-frame JS path, the fringe a static filter distortion — stack them as body plus fringe."

motion/theme-water-fill.reasonZh: 对比:液面高度与进度条易混:「量」的空间隐喻不是任务完成度——等待时间轴、形态切换阈值与 percent-done 语义归 progress-motion。
motion/theme-water-fill.reasonEn: Contrasts: Liquid level and progress bars are easy to conflate: the spatial metaphor of 'amount' is not task completion — the waiting timeline, form-switch thresholds and percent-done semantics belong to progress-motion.

motion/theme-water-fill.reasonZh: 搭配:同一条 §6.1 双正弦液面配方的两个形态:那边整屏涌入换肤,这边圆环裁剪做量具——共用 1:1.618 拍效应与逐帧 path 采样。
motion/theme-water-fill.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two shapes of one §6.1 two-sine surface recipe: a full-screen flood that re-skins there, a ring-clipped gauge here — sharing the 1:1.618 beat effect and per-frame path sampling.

motion/theme-water-fill.reasonZh: 反向自「液体主题切换」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同一套双正弦液面公式的两种裁剪:圆环内做「液面高度即量值」的量具,全视口做换肤揭示——采样公式同构,外层裁剪与语义不同。」
motion/theme-water-fill.reasonEn: Reverse from "Liquid Theme Reveal" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "One two-sine surface formula, two croppings: ring-clipped as a 'level means quantity' gauge, full-viewport as a re-skin reveal — the sampling math is isomorphic, the crop and semantics differ."

motion/theme-wave-flood.reasonZh: 搭配:平滑波身与湍流毛缘分层各司其职:波身由 JS 逐帧算 path,毛缘由滤镜静态扭出,两者可叠成「波身 + 毛缘」。
motion/theme-wave-flood.reasonEn: Pairs with: The smooth wave body and the turbulent fringe split across two layers: the body is a per-frame JS path, the fringe a static filter distortion — stack them as body plus fringe.

motion/theme-wave-flood.reasonZh: 搭配:液面 clipPath 挂靠的正是这套快照机制:回调前后各拍一张快照、渲染冻结、伪元素树承载旧新两侧——先懂机制再读液态配方。
motion/theme-wave-flood.reasonEn: Pairs with: The liquid clipPath hangs off exactly this snapshot mechanism: a snapshot on each side of the callback, rendering frozen, old/new carried by the pseudo-element tree — mechanics first, liquid recipe second.

motion/theme-wave-flood.titleZh: 注水指示(液面高度表进度/深度)
motion/theme-wave-flood.reasonZh: 反向自「注水指示(液面高度表进度/深度)」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同一条 §6.1 双正弦液面配方的两个形态:那边整屏涌入换肤,这边圆环裁剪做量具——共用 1:1.618 拍效应与逐帧 path 采样。」
motion/theme-wave-flood.reasonEn: Reverse from "Theme Water Fill" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Two shapes of one §6.1 two-sine surface recipe: a full-screen flood that re-skins there, a ring-clipped gauge here — sharing the 1:1.618 beat effect and per-frame path sampling."

motion/toast-spring.reasonZh: 搭配:stiffness 300 / damping 25 → ζ≈0.72、过冲≈3.8% 的「弹而不闹」档,直接查 damping-craft 的 ζ 手感表。
motion/toast-spring.reasonEn: Pairs with: stiffness 300 / damping 25 → ζ≈0.72, ≈3.8% overshoot: the 'bouncy but quiet' band, read straight off damping-craft's ζ table.

motion/toast-spring.reasonZh: 搭配:「入场短于退场」铁律的第二个浮层落点:toast 0.35s 弹入/0.4s 缓出,overlay 条目给 shadcn 200ms 入/150ms 出的同一纪律。
motion/toast-spring.reasonEn: Pairs with: The 'enter no longer than exit' rule's second overlay instance: toast 0.35s spring-in / 0.4s ease-out; overlay-entrance gives the same discipline as shadcn 200ms in / 150ms out.

motion/toast-spring.reasonZh: 反向自「触觉反馈 Vibration」的精选:搭配关系,原句「HIG 的 Notification 三件套(success/warning/error)就是为操作成败设计的脉冲,与 toast 的结果反馈同步触发——两条目共享这个场景。」
motion/toast-spring.reasonEn: Reverse from "Web Haptics (Vibration API)" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "HIG's Notification trio (success/warning/error) are pulse sequences designed for operation outcomes, fired alongside toasts — the shared scene of both entries."

motion/view-transitions.reasonZh: 延伸:API 机制(快照、伪元素树、morph 赋名)读完,page-transitions 回答更高一层的问题:哪种转场模式服务哪种起止关系。
motion/view-transitions.reasonEn: Extends: Once the API mechanics are clear (snapshots, pseudo-element tree, named morphs), page-transitions answers the higher question: which pattern fits which start/end relationship.

motion/view-transitions.reasonZh: 搭配:同一个 View Transitions API 的两种用法对照:这里是元素级 morph 赋名,theme-transition 是 root 快照的圆形揭示换肤。
motion/view-transitions.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two uses of one View Transitions API, contrasted: element-level named morphs here vs root-snapshot circular reveal for theme switching there.

motion/view-transitions.reasonZh: 反向自「缓动-时长配对」的精选:搭配关系,原句「配对表在 SPA 路由上的 API 落地:整页过场的时长曲线覆写到 ::view-transition-* 伪元素——条目原文明示去 view-transitions。」
motion/view-transitions.reasonEn: Reverse from "Easing-Duration Pairs" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Where the pairing table lands as an API for SPA routes: page-level durations and curves overwrite the ::view-transition-* pseudo-elements — this entry points to view-transitions."

principles/aesthetic-usability.reasonZh: 搭配:审美可用性效应要在测试规程里设防:首轮可用性测试用未抛光稿,好评不能替代 1.4.3 的 4.5:1 对比度法定线——美观不再能掩盖问题。
principles/aesthetic-usability.reasonEn: Pairs with: The aesthetic-usability effect needs guards in the test protocol: run first-round tests on unpolished wireframes — good scores never replace the 4.5:1 legal line of SC 1.4.3; beauty stops masking problems.

principles/aesthetic-usability.reasonZh: 搭配:缺陷档 slow-response 把成功反馈拖到 900ms,就是一台小型 Doherty 实验——精修侧的感知分也扛不住「等一下再点」的迟滞。
principles/aesthetic-usability.reasonEn: Pairs with: The slow-response handicap drags success feedback to 900ms — a miniature Doherty experiment: even the polished side's perceived score can't survive the wait-then-click lag.

principles/aesthetic-usability.reasonZh: 反向自「Fitts 定律」的精选:搭配关系,原句「Fitts 的误点数据与「美观容忍」实验互补成对:小目标拉高误点后,精修卡片的感知分跌得更少——缺陷对两侧等量注入才隔离得出审美容忍。」
principles/aesthetic-usability.reasonEn: Reverse from "Fitts's Law" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Fitts's miss data pairs with the beauty-tolerance experiment: after small targets raise misses, the polished card's perceived score drops less — only equal handicap injection on both sides isolates that tolerance."

principles/apg-patterns.reasonZh: 延伸:读完 30 个模式的三段规范,到键盘导航条目看惯例跑起来的现场:roving tabindex、focus≠selected、Esc 释放困焦并归还焦点。
principles/apg-patterns.reasonEn: Extends: After the 30 patterns' three-section specs, watch the conventions run live in the keyboard-navigation entry: roving tabindex, focus≠selected, and Esc releasing the trap back to the opener.

principles/apg-patterns.reasonZh: 搭配:APG 卡片的 roles 与 states & properties 三段规范,就是清单「健壮」组 4.1.2(名称/角色/值)的实现手册——动手前查、照抄即过。
principles/apg-patterns.reasonEn: Pairs with: The APG card's roles and states & properties sections are the field manual for the checklist's Robust row 4.1.2 (name/role/value) — look it up before building, copy it and it passes.

principles/apg-patterns.reasonZh: 反向自「Jakob 定律」的精选:搭配关系,原句「「遵循平台惯例」落到自绘组件就是 APG:30 个模式的键盘交互/roles/states 三段规范——发明新交互范式前,先查惯例库有没有现成答案。」
principles/apg-patterns.reasonEn: Reverse from "Jakob's Law" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "'Follow platform conventions' lands on custom widgets as APG: the keyboard/roles/states three-section specs of 30 patterns — before inventing a new interaction paradigm, check the convention library."

principles/contrast-ratio-formula.reasonZh: 路径「从零到一块玻璃卡」的下一站:收口:四层各司其职(材质管氛围、状态层管反馈、投影管海拔、按压对管触感)的完整配方,把前五步组装成生产级方案并一键复刻。
principles/contrast-ratio-formula.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Zero to Glass" path: The capstone: the full recipe where four layers each own one job (material ambience, state-layer feedback, shadow elevation, press-pair touch) assembles the previous five steps into a production-grade, one-click-replicable card.

principles/contrast-ratio-formula.reasonZh: 反向自「WCAG 对比度」的精选:延伸关系,原句「检查器的每一步(γ 解码→加权求和→比值)都有独立推导条目:先懂公式来历,四道阈值才判得明白。」
principles/contrast-ratio-formula.reasonEn: Reverse from "WCAG Contrast" curated: Extends relation, quoting "Every step of the checker (γ decode → weighted sum → ratio) has its own derivation entry: understand the formula's origin and the four thresholds judge clearly."

principles/contrast-ratio-formula.reasonZh: 反向自「OKLCH 转换公式」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同一段数学的两次出场:γ 解码既是 sRGB→OKLab 管线的第一步,也是 WCAG 相对亮度的第一步——两页互为对账。」
principles/contrast-ratio-formula.reasonEn: Reverse from "OKLCH Conversion" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "One piece of math, two appearances: gamma decode opens both the sRGB-to-OKLab pipeline and WCAG relative luminance — the two pages audit each other."

principles/doherty-threshold.reasonZh: 搭配:>10s 的等待给完进度还要给「完成后的收尾」——峰终定律正是那条收尾法则:提交成功页与任务完成态值得独立打磨,不顺手带过。
principles/doherty-threshold.reasonEn: Pairs with: Waits beyond 10s need progress plus a designed finish — peak-end is that finish rule: success pages and completion states deserve their own polish, never an afterthought.

principles/doherty-threshold.reasonZh: 反向自「AI 思考中指示器」的精选:搭配关系,原句「思考指示器的形态升降级就按 NN/g 三限画档(0.1/1/10s),而 1s 恰是 Doherty 阈值的邻居——两条时间线在等待分层上互补成套。」
principles/doherty-threshold.reasonEn: Reverse from "AI Thinking Indicator" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The thinking indicator's form tiers follow NN/g's three limits (0.1/1/10s), and 1s sits right at Doherty's doorstep — the two timelines complement each other as one wait-layering kit."

styles/bento-grid.reasonEn: Pairs with: The first-load overture of a bento screen: skeleton blocks sized exactly like the real cards so content lands with zero shift — the layout's trailer.

styles/bento-grid.reasonZh: 用于配方「仪表盘数据卡」的组合条目

styles/classic-brutalism.reasonZh: 对比:判据差异一表分清:阴影(无 vs 硬偏移)、色彩(黑白灰 vs 高饱和)、字体(系统默认 vs 展示体)——共同只有直角与黑边。
styles/classic-brutalism.reasonEn: Contrasts: One table settles the criteria: shadow (none vs hard offset), color (mono vs high-saturation), type (system vs display) — only right angles and black borders are shared.

styles/classic-brutalism.reasonZh: 对比:都做「去装饰」但立场相反:扁平是设计过的系统纪律,经典粗野是未装修的诚实默认——两种朴素别混。
styles/classic-brutalism.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both strip decoration from opposite stances: flat is a designed system discipline, classic brutalism is honest, unrenovated default — don't conflate the two plainnesses.

styles/classic-brutalism.reasonZh: 反向自「字体搭配」的精选:搭配关系,原句「配字的零依赖极值:经典粗野停在系统默认字(Times New Roman 系)实现「零字体下载」,越过这条边界,配字问题本身消失了。」
styles/classic-brutalism.reasonEn: Reverse from "Font Pairing" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The zero-dependency extreme of font choice: classic brutalism stops at the system default face for zero font downloads — past this boundary the pairing question disappears."

styles/claymorphism.reasonZh: 对比:分野在结构上就能看出来:黏土元素自带底色浮于页面之上,新拟物与背景同色被对比度反噬——修复者与被修复者对照读。
styles/claymorphism.reasonEn: Contrasts: The split shows in structure: clay elements carry their own fill floating above the page, neumorphism shares the background color and loses contrast — read the fix against the failure.

styles/claymorphism.reasonZh: 搭配:同为「亲和系」体积暗示:黏土哑光充气、果冻透光含糖——同一情绪轴的两种材质路线。
styles/claymorphism.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two 'friendly' volume cues: clay is matte and inflatable, gel is translucent and sugary — two material routes on the same emotional axis.

styles/claymorphism.reasonZh: 反向自「果冻凝胶材质」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同为「充气」体积暗示:黏土用粉彩底与双内阴影浮出页面,凝胶用半透明糖色与高光内衬——哑光与透光两条路线。」
styles/claymorphism.reasonEn: Reverse from "Gel Material" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Two inflatable volume cues: clay floats on pastel fills with double inset shadows, gel on translucent candy with a glossy lining — matte vs translucent."

styles/cyberpunk.reasonZh: 搭配:电光青/品红/酸黄只在近黑底上成立——极光渐变正是暗底氛围光的成熟配方:多层低亮度光斑缓慢平移。
styles/cyberpunk.reasonEn: Pairs with: Electric cyan, magenta and acid yellow only hold on a near-black base — the aurora gradient is the mature recipe for dark-scene ambience: low-luminance blobs drifting slowly.

styles/cyberpunk.reasonZh: 对比:同在暗场舞台,构图相反:赛博朋克以故障、扫描线铺满氛围,全息铬光只给一件反光主体当主角。
styles/cyberpunk.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both on the dark stage with opposite composition: cyberpunk floods the mood with glitch and scanlines, holographic chrome spotlights a single reflective subject.

styles/cyberpunk.reasonZh: 反向自「玻璃色散边」的精选:搭配关系,原句「色散边是赛博朋克「故障即氛围」的材质级实现:扫描线与 RGB 通道错位之外,真实光学也提供红蓝错位。」
styles/cyberpunk.reasonEn: Reverse from "Chromatic Edge" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The chromatic edge is cyberpunk's material-level glitch: beyond scanlines and RGB shifts, real optics supply the red-blue misalignment."

styles/editorial-magazine.reasonZh: 搭配:杂志级行长的落地件:45–90 字符纪律在 measure 条目里用 ch 单位定宽成形。
styles/editorial-magazine.reasonEn: Pairs with: Where magazine line length lands: the 45–90-character rule takes shape with ch-unit caps in the measure entry.

styles/editorial-magazine.reasonZh: 搭配:杂志的留白纪律与极简共享同一批刻度(65ch 行长即极简页示例值)——两页互为参照。
styles/editorial-magazine.reasonEn: Pairs with: The magazine's whitespace discipline and minimalism share the same scales (65ch is the minimalism page's example) — read the two as references to each other.

styles/editorial-magazine.reasonZh: 反向自「瑞士国际主义」的精选:对比关系,原句「网格排版的两大纪律易混:瑞士用模块网格立客观结构(齐左不齐右),杂志用栏格服务编辑叙事(五级层级)。」
styles/editorial-magazine.reasonEn: Reverse from "Swiss International Style" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "The two grid-typography disciplines are easy to confuse: Swiss builds objective structure with the modular grid (flush left, ragged right), the magazine serves editorial narrative with column grids (five levels)."

styles/flat-design.reasonZh: 对比:都自称「网页默认语言」:瑞士立客观结构(网格+无衬线),扁平立无装饰材质观(无渐变无高光)——两种基线的分界。
styles/flat-design.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both claim to be the web's default language: Swiss builds objective structure (grid plus sans), flat builds an unadorned material stance (no gradient, no gloss) — where the two baselines divide.

styles/flat-design.reasonZh: 对比:系统语言的两次换防:2013 扁平取代拟物,2020 年代中期玻璃系又接替扁平——同一生态位的二选一。
styles/flat-design.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two handovers of the system-language seat: flat replaced skeuomorphism in 2013, glass took over from flat in the mid-2020s — an either/or within one niche.

styles/flat-design.reasonZh: 反向自「极简主义」的精选:搭配关系,原句「扁平化是极简纪律在系统语言层的执行版:两者共享「用最少的元素完成任务」的基线,互为理论与落地。」
styles/flat-design.reasonEn: Reverse from "Minimalism" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Flat design is minimalism's discipline executed as a system language: both share the 'least elements to finish the task' baseline — theory and implementation side by side."

styles/frutiger-aero.reasonZh: 延伸:玻璃时代的前身读完,自然接玻璃语法正文:水感气泡与椭圆光泽如何长成 2018–2020 的毛玻璃。
styles/frutiger-aero.reasonEn: Extends: After the forerunner of the glass era, continue into the glass syntax proper: how watery bubbles and elliptical gloss grew into the 2018–2020 frosted glass.

styles/frutiger-aero.reasonZh: 搭配:水感玻璃质感在 Web 上的实现件:气泡与玻璃面板的模糊透底全靠 backdrop-filter 配方。
styles/frutiger-aero.reasonEn: Pairs with: The implementation piece of watery glass on the web: bubble and panel blur-translucency rides entirely on backdrop-filter recipes.

styles/frutiger-aero.reasonZh: 反向自「Y2K 复古未来主义」的精选:先修关系,原句「读完 Y2K 看它的后继:镀铬果冻与荧光铬银如何褪成天空蓝草绿的水感玻璃。」
styles/frutiger-aero.reasonEn: Reverse from "Y2K Retro-Futurism" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After Y2K, meet its successor: how chrome jelly and fluorescent silver faded into sky-blue, grass-green watery glass."

styles/gel-candy-design.reasonZh: 搭配:流派级组织读完接材质级配方:高光内衬+糖色加浓+弹性回弹三件套在 gel-material 条目。
styles/gel-candy-design.reasonEn: Pairs with: After the style-level organization, the material-level recipe: the glossy lining plus candy densification plus elastic rebound trio lives in the gel-material entry.

styles/gel-candy-design.reasonZh: 搭配:糖果场景的玻璃用超薄档:糖果色已给足色彩,雾度反而要低——clear-frost 的参数域正是配套。
styles/gel-candy-design.reasonEn: Pairs with: Candy scenes use the ultra-thin frost: candy color already supplies saturation, so haze must stay low — clear-frost's parameter range is the matching piece.

styles/gel-candy-design.reasonZh: 反向自「黏土拟物」的精选:搭配关系,原句「同为「亲和系」体积暗示:黏土哑光充气、果冻透光含糖——同一情绪轴的两种材质路线。」
styles/gel-candy-design.reasonEn: Reverse from "Claymorphism" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Two 'friendly' volume cues: clay is matte and inflatable, gel is translucent and sugary — two material routes on the same emotional axis."

styles/glassmorphism.reasonZh: 搭配:毛玻璃的 Web 底座就是 backdrop-filter:blur+saturate+brightness 三件套与实底回退,概念与实现成对读。
styles/glassmorphism.reasonEn: Pairs with: The web base of frosted glass is backdrop-filter: the blur+saturate+brightness trio and solid-surface fallback — read concept and implementation as a pair.

styles/glassmorphism.reasonZh: 搭配:生产级玻璃卡的四层分工之二:材质管氛围、主题投影管海拔——玻璃缺实体边界,必须配 elevation 才有层级。
styles/glassmorphism.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two of the four production glass-card layers: material owns ambience, themed shadow owns elevation — glass lacks solid borders and needs elevation for hierarchy.

styles/glassmorphism.reasonZh: 反向自「新拟物」的精选:对比关系,原句「同为 2018–2020 的质感风潮:玻璃靠模糊+亮边透出背景,新拟物靠同色明暗挤压——两种「柔和立体」的材质观互为对照。」
styles/glassmorphism.reasonEn: Reverse from "Neumorphism" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two texture waves of 2018–2020: glass borrows the background via blur and lit edges, neumorphism squeezes forms from same-color light and shadow — two opposing views of soft depth."

styles/holographic-chrome.reasonZh: 对比:铬与虹彩油膜是同一批素材,用法相反:Y2K 拼成本末怀旧素材库,全息铬光立「深色舞台一件反光主体」的纪律。
styles/holographic-chrome.reasonEn: Contrasts: Chrome and iridescent film share stock but invert the method: Y2K collages them as a nostalgia library, holographic chrome enforces one reflective subject on a dark stage.

styles/holographic-chrome.reasonZh: 搭配:卡面上跟随指针的镜面高光正是动态版配方:inset 顶缘高光带与光斑位移的做法在专门条目。
styles/holographic-chrome.reasonEn: Pairs with: The pointer-tracking specular on the card face is exactly the dynamic recipe: inset top-edge highlight bands and moving light spots live in the dedicated entry.

styles/holographic-chrome.reasonZh: 反向自「赛博朋克」的精选:对比关系,原句「同在暗场舞台,构图相反:赛博朋克以故障、扫描线铺满氛围,全息铬光只给一件反光主体当主角。」
styles/holographic-chrome.reasonEn: Reverse from "Cyberpunk" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both on the dark stage with opposite composition: cyberpunk floods the mood with glitch and scanlines, holographic chrome spotlights a single reflective subject."

styles/maximalism.reasonZh: 对比:逐项对照的两列:每屏色相 1–2 vs ≥5、字阶 1.125–1.25 vs ≥1.333、装饰 ≤1 层 vs ≥3 层——读反方向才能定边界。
styles/maximalism.reasonEn: Contrasts: A line-by-line contrast table: 1–2 vs 5+ hues per screen, 1.125–1.25 vs 1.333+ type jumps, ≤1 vs 3+ decoration layers — read the opposite to find your boundary.

styles/maximalism.reasonZh: 对比:版面密度之争的两极:编辑自信的慷慨留白 vs 边距收缩的叠印占满——同一版心两种立场。
styles/maximalism.reasonEn: Contrasts: The two poles of layout density: the editor's confident whitespace vs margin-shrinking overprint — one grid, two stances.

styles/maximalism.reasonZh: 反向自「孟菲斯设计」的精选:对比关系,原句「都把表面占满:孟菲斯以「图案场」为骨架的 80s 语汇,极繁以 ≥3 层叠印为总体策略——时代与手法都不同。」
styles/maximalism.reasonEn: Reverse from "Memphis Design" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both fill the surface: Memphis is an 80s vocabulary built on a motif field, maximalism a strategy of three-plus stacked print layers — different eras and methods."

styles/memphis-design.reasonZh: 对比:都把表面占满:孟菲斯以「图案场」为骨架的 80s 语汇,极繁以 ≥3 层叠印为总体策略——时代与手法都不同。
styles/memphis-design.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both fill the surface: Memphis is an 80s vocabulary built on a motif field, maximalism a strategy of three-plus stacked print layers — different eras and methods.

styles/memphis-design.reasonZh: 搭配:孟菲斯图形在 80s–90s 中期渗透流行文化、至今是大众记忆载体;Y2K 复古拼贴与之同属世纪末语汇,活动页常一起回潮。
styles/memphis-design.reasonEn: Pairs with: Memphis graphics saturated pop culture through the mid-90s and remain a mass-memory carrier; Y2K collage belongs to the same end-of-century vocabulary, and retro event pages revive them together.

styles/memphis-design.reasonZh: 反向自「新粗野主义」的精选:对比关系,原句「硬偏移阴影是共享语法,骨架却不同:孟菲斯以图案为骨架,新粗野主义以描边为骨架——同款 4px 4px 0 #000 两种用法。」
styles/memphis-design.reasonEn: Reverse from "Neo-Brutalism" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Hard offset shadows are shared grammar but the skeletons differ: Memphis builds on motifs, neo-brutalism on borders — the same 4px 4px 0 #000 used two ways."

styles/minimalism.reasonZh: 搭配:扁平化是极简纪律在系统语言层的执行版:两者共享「用最少的元素完成任务」的基线,互为理论与落地。
styles/minimalism.reasonEn: Pairs with: Flat design is minimalism's discipline executed as a system language: both share the 'least elements to finish the task' baseline — theory and implementation side by side.

styles/minimalism.reasonZh: 对比:「朴素默认」的两个源头易混:瑞士以数学网格立客观结构,极简以受限元素立任务基线——都自称默认语言,立论不同。
styles/minimalism.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two sources of the 'plain default' look are easy to confuse: Swiss builds objective structure on the math grid, minimalism builds a task baseline on restrained elements — both claim the default, on different grounds.

styles/minimalism.reasonZh: 反向自「杂志编辑风」的精选:搭配关系,原句「杂志的留白纪律与极简共享同一批刻度(65ch 行长即极简页示例值)——两页互为参照。」
styles/minimalism.reasonEn: Reverse from "Editorial Magazine" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The magazine's whitespace discipline and minimalism share the same scales (65ch is the minimalism page's example) — read the two as references to each other."

styles/neo-brutalism.reasonZh: 对比:同代两条最大化路线共享「饱和色」,分歧在阴影的硬度与边界的有无:粗黑描边+硬投影 vs 无边柔光+弹性高光。
styles/neo-brutalism.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two maximal routes of the same moment share saturated color but split on shadow hardness and borders: thick outlines with hard offsets vs borderless glow with elastic highlights.

styles/neo-brutalism.reasonZh: 对比:硬偏移阴影是共享语法,骨架却不同:孟菲斯以图案为骨架,新粗野主义以描边为骨架——同款 4px 4px 0 #000 两种用法。
styles/neo-brutalism.reasonEn: Contrasts: Hard offset shadows are shared grammar but the skeletons differ: Memphis builds on motifs, neo-brutalism on borders — the same 4px 4px 0 #000 used two ways.

styles/neo-brutalism.reasonZh: 反向自「经典粗野主义」的精选:对比关系,原句「判据差异一表分清:阴影(无 vs 硬偏移)、色彩(黑白灰 vs 高饱和)、字体(系统默认 vs 展示体)——共同只有直角与黑边。」
styles/neo-brutalism.reasonEn: Reverse from "Classic Brutalism" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "One table settles the criteria: shadow (none vs hard offset), color (mono vs high-saturation), type (system vs display) — only right angles and black borders are shared."

styles/neumorphism.reasonZh: 对比:同为 2018–2020 的质感风潮:玻璃靠模糊+亮边透出背景,新拟物靠同色明暗挤压——两种「柔和立体」的材质观互为对照。
styles/neumorphism.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two texture waves of 2018–2020: glass borrows the background via blur and lit edges, neumorphism squeezes forms from same-color light and shadow — two opposing views of soft depth.

styles/neumorphism.reasonZh: 对比:都做柔和立体,可读性下限天差地别:新拟物同色挤压对比天生孱弱,柔光设计由实底内容层兜底。
styles/neumorphism.reasonEn: Contrasts: Both chase soft depth with very different legibility floors: same-color squeezing is inherently low-contrast, while soft-glow lets the solid content layer backstop readability.

styles/neumorphism.reasonZh: 反向自「黏土拟物」的精选:对比关系,原句「分野在结构上就能看出来:黏土元素自带底色浮于页面之上,新拟物与背景同色被对比度反噬——修复者与被修复者对照读。」
styles/neumorphism.reasonEn: Reverse from "Claymorphism" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "The split shows in structure: clay elements carry their own fill floating above the page, neumorphism shares the background color and loses contrast — read the fix against the failure."

styles/skeuomorphism.reasonZh: 对比:同一段历史的正反两面:2013 iOS 7 以「装饰干扰内容」为由转向平色——两种材质观的边界条件。
styles/skeuomorphism.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two sides of the same history: iOS 7 turned to flat color in 2013 citing decoration that distracts from content — the boundary conditions of two material views.

styles/skeuomorphism.reasonZh: 搭配:2026 拟物回潮的「Y2K 科技拟物」分支与复古未来主义共享铬金属、果冻塑料素材——复古科技的表亲。
styles/skeuomorphism.reasonEn: Pairs with: The Y2K techno-skeuomorphism branch of the 2026 revival shares chrome and jelly-plastic stock with retro-futurism — cousins of retro tech.

styles/skeuomorphism.reasonZh: 反向自「纸纹材质」的精选:搭配关系,原句「纸纹正是拟物材质清单的一员:feTurbulence 噪点、细网格与套印错位,给回潮的材质家族提供哑光纸面。」
styles/skeuomorphism.reasonEn: Reverse from "Paper Texture" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Paper grain is a member of the skeuomorphic material list: feTurbulence noise, hairline grids and misregistered prints supply the matte paper."

styles/soft-glow-design.reasonZh: 对比:玻璃的辨识度在「模糊+亮边」,光非必要;柔光设计在玻璃语法之上注入光学事件(渗光/泛光/呼吸),光即层级。
styles/soft-glow-design.reasonEn: Contrasts: Glass is known by blur plus lit edges, light optional; soft-glow injects optical events (bleed, bloom, breathing) on top of the glass grammar — light becomes the hierarchy.

styles/soft-glow-design.reasonZh: 搭配:本流派是 Liquid Glass 与早期 glassmorphism 在「发光维度」上的合流——读官方设计语言的语义与约束再谈发光。
styles/soft-glow-design.reasonEn: Pairs with: This style is where Liquid Glass and early glassmorphism converge on the glow dimension — read the official language's semantics and constraints before glowing.

styles/soft-glow-design.reasonZh: 反向自「新拟物」的精选:对比关系,原句「都做柔和立体,可读性下限天差地别:新拟物同色挤压对比天生孱弱,柔光设计由实底内容层兜底。」
styles/soft-glow-design.reasonEn: Reverse from "Neumorphism" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Both chase soft depth with very different legibility floors: same-color squeezing is inherently low-contrast, while soft-glow lets the solid content layer backstop readability."

styles/spatial-ui.reasonZh: 搭配:Apple 两代玻璃材质范式互参:visionOS 环境浮窗与 iOS 26 功能层玻璃——平台语义与「节制使用」约束一脉相承。
styles/spatial-ui.reasonEn: Pairs with: Apple's two glass-material paradigms in dialogue: visionOS floating windows and iOS 26 functional-layer glass — the platform semantics and use-sparingly discipline carry through.

styles/spatial-ui.reasonZh: 搭配:窗口模糊身后环境光斑,「环境越丰富,玻璃越立体」与 glassmorphism 同规则——彩色底纪律在空间场景同样成立。
styles/spatial-ui.reasonEn: Pairs with: Windows blur the ambient blobs behind them — a richer environment makes the glass more dimensional, the same rule as glassmorphism: the colorful-backdrop discipline holds in space too.

styles/spatial-ui.reasonZh: 反向自「Fluent 主题阴影」的精选:搭配关系,原句「空间 UI 以「少量大阴影」把深度当层级语言——海拔阴影正是它落到 Web 的参数化件。」
styles/spatial-ui.reasonEn: Reverse from "ThemeShadow (Fluent)" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Spatial UI treats depth as hierarchy with a few large shadows — elevation shadowing is its parameterized piece on the web."

styles/swiss-international.reasonZh: 搭配:瑞士三件套「列数/栏距/基线」落到 Web 排版:基线网格条目给出固定步长与可视化开关的做法。
styles/swiss-international.reasonEn: Pairs with: The Swiss trio — columns, gutters, baselines — lands in web typography: the baseline-grid entry gives the fixed step and visualization toggle.

styles/swiss-international.reasonZh: 对比:网格排版的两大纪律易混:瑞士用模块网格立客观结构(齐左不齐右),杂志用栏格服务编辑叙事(五级层级)。
styles/swiss-international.reasonEn: Contrasts: The two grid-typography disciplines are easy to confuse: Swiss builds objective structure with the modular grid (flush left, ragged right), the magazine serves editorial narrative with column grids (five levels).

styles/swiss-international.reasonZh: 反向自「极简主义」的精选:对比关系,原句「「朴素默认」的两个源头易混:瑞士以数学网格立客观结构,极简以受限元素立任务基线——都自称默认语言,立论不同。」
styles/swiss-international.reasonEn: Reverse from "Minimalism" curated: Contrasts relation, quoting "Two sources of the 'plain default' look are easy to confuse: Swiss builds objective structure on the math grid, minimalism builds a task baseline on restrained elements — both claim the default, on different grounds."

styles/y2k-retro-futurism.reasonZh: 延伸:读完 Y2K 看它的后继:镀铬果冻与荧光铬银如何褪成天空蓝草绿的水感玻璃。
styles/y2k-retro-futurism.reasonEn: Extends: After Y2K, meet its successor: how chrome jelly and fluorescent silver faded into sky-blue, grass-green watery glass.

styles/y2k-retro-futurism.reasonZh: 搭配:「虹彩油膜渐变」的材质级落地:薄膜干涉条目把油膜结构色做成会流转的面板材质(铬字色标调密即接近油膜)。
styles/y2k-retro-futurism.reasonEn: Pairs with: Where the iridescent oil-slick gradient lands as a material: the thin-film entry turns oil-slip structural color into a drifting panel material (densify the chrome stops to approach the film).

styles/y2k-retro-futurism.reasonZh: 反向自「拟物化」的精选:搭配关系,原句「2026 拟物回潮的「Y2K 科技拟物」分支与复古未来主义共享铬金属、果冻塑料素材——复古科技的表亲。」
styles/y2k-retro-futurism.reasonEn: Reverse from "Skeuomorphism" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The Y2K techno-skeuomorphism branch of the 2026 revival shares chrome and jelly-plastic stock with retro-futurism — cousins of retro tech."

type/baseline-grid.reasonZh: 搭配:垂直步长与水平槽宽是同一套倍数纪律的两面:4/8 网格步长对栅格 8/16/24/32 槽阶,判据都是整数倍或半步。
type/baseline-grid.reasonEn: Pairs with: Vertical steps and horizontal gutters are two faces of one multiple discipline: the 4/8 grid against the 8/16/24/32 gutter ladder, both judged in whole or half steps.

type/baseline-grid.reasonZh: 反向自「瑞士国际主义」的精选:搭配关系,原句「瑞士三件套「列数/栏距/基线」落到 Web 排版:基线网格条目给出固定步长与可视化开关的做法。」
type/baseline-grid.reasonEn: Reverse from "Swiss International Style" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The Swiss trio — columns, gutters, baselines — lands in web typography: the baseline-grid entry gives the fixed step and visualization toggle."

type/baseline-grid.reasonZh: 反向自「子网格 Subgrid」的精选:搭配关系,原句「跨卡对齐的最终判据回到基线:subgrid 共享行轨道后,标题/页脚行盒是否落格,用基线网格的步长判据与可视化叠加验收。」
type/baseline-grid.reasonEn: Reverse from "Subgrid" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Cross-card alignment settles on the baseline: once subgrid shares row tracks, whether title/footer line boxes land on the grid is judged by the baseline grid's step rule and overlay."

type/cjk-typography.reasonZh: 搭配:中文字框方正使「字符数」即「字数」,45–90 字符口径可按字数折算——但中文行长指导值,目标条目如实标注未核实。
type/cjk-typography.reasonEn: Pairs with: Square CJK glyphs make character count = glyph count, so the 45–90-character rule converts per glyph — though the entry flags its Chinese line-length guidance as unverified.

type/cjk-typography.reasonZh: 搭配:中文断行自带禁则(句号不落行首),balance 再叠一层各行均衡——标题断行的两道工序可以同开。
type/cjk-typography.reasonEn: Pairs with: CJK line breaking carries its own kinsoku rules; balance adds line-evening on top — the two passes can run together on headings.

type/cjk-typography.reasonZh: 反向自「书写模式」的精选:搭配关系,原句「竖排诗笺读完回到横排正字:中西文间距、标点挤压、段首缩进的 CLREQ 条款在任何排式下都适用——系统展开在 cjk-typography。」
type/cjk-typography.reasonEn: Reverse from "Writing Modes" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "After the vertical poem, back to horizontal orthography: the CLREQ rules for CJK-Latin spacing, punctuation squeezing and paragraph indent hold in any style — unfolded in cjk-typography."

type/display-typography.reasonZh: 搭配:展示级大字号的生产供给:clamp() 流式大字的 --step-5 令牌由 Utopia 公式生成——斜率与截距的推导在 fluid-type-scale。
type/display-typography.reasonEn: Pairs with: The production supply of display sizes: the clamp() --step-5 token comes from the Utopia formula — the slope-and-intercept derivation lives in fluid-type-scale.

type/display-typography.reasonZh: 延伸:展示级字重档读完,字体文件何时换上由加载策略决定:封锁/交换/失败三周期与五档取值是排版的工程后半场。
type/display-typography.reasonEn: Extends: After the display-weight tiers, when the font file actually swaps is a loading-policy decision: the block/swap/fail periods and five values are typography's engineering half.

type/display-typography.reasonZh: 反向自「可变字体」的精选:搭配关系,原句「展示级字重的供给层:600 档落在 Inter Variable wght 100–900 真实轴上连续取值,opsz 14–32 分 text/display 光学档——非合成加粗。」
type/display-typography.reasonEn: Reverse from "Variable Fonts" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The supply layer of display weights: the 600 tier rides Inter Variable's real wght 100–900 axis with continuous values, opsz 14–32 splits text/display optics — never synthetic bold."

type/drop-cap-initial.reasonZh: 搭配:首字下沉的「占据 N 行」就是行高单元语言:initial-letter 按行数占位,天然要在纵向韵律里对账。
type/drop-cap-initial.reasonEn: Pairs with: A drop cap's 'span N lines' is line-height-unit language: initial-letter occupies by line count and must reconcile with vertical rhythm.

type/drop-cap-initial.reasonZh: 搭配:首字是展示级待遇:字号按行数放大、字重加粗——大字号的字距与行高纪律在展示排版条目。
type/drop-cap-initial.reasonEn: Pairs with: The initial letter gets display treatment: scaled by line count and bolded — the tracking and leading rules for large type live in display typography.

type/drop-cap-initial.reasonZh: 反向自「杂志编辑风」的精选:搭配关系,原句「杂志开篇的首字下沉落地件:initial-letter 占多行、正文环绕,不支持时退 ::first-letter + float。」
type/drop-cap-initial.reasonEn: Reverse from "Editorial Magazine" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Where the magazine's opening drop cap lands: initial-letter spans lines with text wrap, falling back to ::first-letter + float."

type/fluid-spacing.reasonZh: 搭配:流式间距令牌遇上多语言:令牌按 block/inline 主次轴命名,dir 翻转时留白语义不漂移——阿语与英语用户读同一套 token。
type/fluid-spacing.reasonEn: Pairs with: Fluid spacing tokens meet multilingual UI: name tokens by the block/inline axes so whitespace semantics don't drift on dir flip — Arabic and English readers get the same tokens.

type/fluid-spacing.reasonZh: 路径「设计令牌工程」的下一站:收束到完整产线:源色 → 调色板 → roles 自动派生是 M3 dynamic color 官方链路,换源色后全部 roles 同步再生、组件零改。
type/fluid-spacing.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Design Tokens" path: Converge on the full pipeline: source color → palette → roles auto-derivation is M3's official dynamic color chain — swap the source and every role regenerates with zero component changes.

type/fluid-spacing.reasonZh: 反向自「模数倍率公式」的精选:搭配关系,原句「字阶的流体公式同样管间距:--space-3xs…3xl 令牌沿视口线性伸缩,一端定值、中间插值。」
type/fluid-spacing.reasonEn: Reverse from "Modular Scale Math" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The type scale's fluid formula also governs spacing: --space-3xs…3xl tokens scale linearly with the viewport — one end fixed, interpolated between."

type/fluid-type-scale.reasonZh: 搭配:字阶令牌的正文下限不是审美:行高/段距/字距/词距四比率是 SC 1.4.12 的覆写阈值,--step-0 的行高注释即此意识。
type/fluid-type-scale.reasonEn: Pairs with: The body floor of a type scale is not taste: the four ratios (leading/paragraph/letter/word spacing) are the SC 1.4.12 override thresholds — the --step-0 comment encodes it.

type/fluid-type-scale.reasonZh: 延伸:clamp 字阶用起来之后,补它的数学底座:size(n)=base×ratioⁿ 的几何级数与 Utopia 流体公式的推导。
type/fluid-type-scale.reasonEn: Extends: Once the clamp scale is in use, its math base: the size(n)=base×ratioⁿ series and the Utopia fluid formula, derived.

type/fluid-type-scale.reasonZh: 路径「设计令牌工程」的下一站:与上一步同一工具(clamp/calc)换到间距轴——刻意相邻形成迁移练习,间距随视口连续缩放、断点无跳变。
type/fluid-type-scale.reasonEn: Next stop on the "Design Tokens" path: The same tools (clamp/calc) move to the spacing axis — deliberately adjacent to transfer practice, with spacing scaling continuously and no breakpoint jumps.

type/font-display-strategy.reasonZh: 搭配:同为 @font-face 层的决策:font-display 管加载期间显示什么,区间声明管一个文件带整套轴——两件一起配,加载与轴语义才完整。
type/font-display-strategy.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two @font-face decisions: font-display governs what shows during loading, interval declarations let one file carry whole axes — configure both for a complete supply.

type/font-display-strategy.reasonZh: 搭配:后备字栈不是摆设:交换期显示的就是它——度量差异决定布局偏移,泛型收尾、逐级回退的配对纪律在 font-pairing。
type/font-display-strategy.reasonEn: Pairs with: The fallback stack is not decoration: the swap period shows exactly it — metric fit and the pairing discipline (generic last, cascade fallback) live in font-pairing.

type/font-display-strategy.reasonZh: 反向自「展示级排版」的精选:先修关系,原句「展示级字重档读完,字体文件何时换上由加载策略决定:封锁/交换/失败三周期与五档取值是排版的工程后半场。」
type/font-display-strategy.reasonEn: Reverse from "Display Typography" curated: Requires relation, quoting "After the display-weight tiers, when the font file actually swaps is a loading-policy decision: the block/swap/fail periods and five values are typography's engineering half."

type/font-pairing.reasonZh: 搭配:单字族策略的字重实验靠真轴:Inter Variable 的 wght 轴驱动 300–900 连续变化,替代合成加粗。
type/font-pairing.reasonEn: Pairs with: The single-family weight experiment rides a real axis: Inter Variable's wght drives 300–900 continuously instead of synthetic bold.

type/font-pairing.reasonZh: 搭配:搭配的中文一侧:字族分工之外,中文正文还有缩进、对齐、中西间距、标点挤压四条自己的规矩。
type/font-pairing.reasonEn: Pairs with: The Chinese side of pairing: beyond family roles, Chinese body text carries its own four rules — indent, justification, script spacing, punctuation squeeze.

type/font-pairing.reasonZh: 反向自「杂志编辑风」的精选:搭配关系,原句「五级层级的字体分工就是一套 pairing 实例:衬线展示字管调性、无衬线正文管阅读。」
type/font-pairing.reasonEn: Reverse from "Editorial Magazine" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The five-level hierarchy's family split is a pairing case study: serif display owns tone, sans body owns reading."

type/measure-line-length.reasonZh: 搭配:字符行长与流式字阶各管一维:measure 用 ch 锁字符数,字号伸缩交给 --step 令牌——物理栏宽由 ch 行长与字阶共同决定。
type/measure-line-length.reasonEn: Pairs with: Character measure and fluid scale each own one dimension: measure locks the character count in ch, font size breathes via --step tokens — physical width is decided jointly.

type/measure-line-length.reasonZh: 搭配:行长定宽之后断行的最后一道工序:balance 均衡标题各行,pretty 给长正文防孤行。
type/measure-line-length.reasonEn: Pairs with: The last pass after fixing the measure: balance evens heading lines, pretty guards long body text against orphans.

type/measure-line-length.reasonZh: 反向自「杂志编辑风」的精选:搭配关系,原句「杂志级行长的落地件:45–90 字符纪律在 measure 条目里用 ch 单位定宽成形。」
type/measure-line-length.reasonEn: Reverse from "Editorial Magazine" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Where magazine line length lands: the 45–90-character rule takes shape with ch-unit caps in the measure entry."

type/modular-scale-math.reasonZh: 搭配:字阶的流体公式同样管间距:--space-3xs…3xl 令牌沿视口线性伸缩,一端定值、中间插值。
type/modular-scale-math.reasonEn: Pairs with: The type scale's fluid formula also governs spacing: --space-3xs…3xl tokens scale linearly with the viewport — one end fixed, interpolated between.

type/modular-scale-math.reasonZh: 搭配:字阶的几何级数与行高的基线倍数是同一门「倍数学」:层级向上乘比率,行盒按基线半格吸附。
type/modular-scale-math.reasonEn: Pairs with: The scale's geometric series and line-height's baseline multiples are the same mathematics of ratios: hierarchy multiplies upward, line boxes snap to half-steps.

type/modular-scale-math.reasonZh: 反向自「流式字阶」的精选:先修关系,原句「clamp 字阶用起来之后,补它的数学底座:size(n)=base×ratioⁿ 的几何级数与 Utopia 流体公式的推导。」
type/modular-scale-math.reasonEn: Reverse from "Fluid Type Scale" curated: Requires relation, quoting "Once the clamp scale is in use, its math base: the size(n)=base×ratioⁿ series and the Utopia fluid formula, derived."

type/rhythm-formula.reasonZh: 搭配:行高吸附到哪条格:4px 半格与 8px 步长的网格本体,用可视化叠加层与逐块偏移审计现场验——吸附公式在 baseline-grid 落成验收。
type/rhythm-formula.reasonEn: Pairs with: Where snapped line-heights land: the 4px half-step and 8px grid body, verified live by the visualization overlay and per-block offset audits — the snap formula becomes acceptance in baseline-grid.

type/rhythm-formula.reasonZh: 搭配:行高公式的版面级应用:lh=fs×m 算出单元之后,标题反推、间距取整倍、行盒逐行叠加成整页韵律。
type/rhythm-formula.reasonEn: Pairs with: The page-level application of the line-height formula: once lh=fs×m sets the unit, headings back-solve and spacing rounds into a full-page rhythm.

type/rhythm-formula.reasonZh: 反向自「模数倍率公式」的精选:搭配关系,原句「字阶的几何级数与行高的基线倍数是同一门「倍数学」:层级向上乘比率,行盒按基线半格吸附。」
type/rhythm-formula.reasonEn: Reverse from "Modular Scale Math" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The scale's geometric series and line-height's baseline multiples are the same mathematics of ratios: hierarchy multiplies upward, line boxes snap to half-steps."

type/small-caps-features.reasonZh: 搭配:同一套 font-variant 高层机制:小型大写之外,表格数字也是 OpenType 特性(tnum),等宽让列对齐与计数不抖。
type/small-caps-features.reasonEn: Pairs with: One font-variant mechanism, two features: beyond small caps, tabular figures are the tnum OpenType feature — equal widths keep columns and counters steady.

type/small-caps-features.reasonZh: 搭配:同是「选字体」的决策场景:pairing 讲对比与职责分离(最多两种字体),特性表质量决定小型大写能不能落地。
type/small-caps-features.reasonEn: Pairs with: Both are font-choice decisions: pairing rules on contrast and role separation (two families max), while feature-table quality decides whether small caps land.

type/small-caps-features.reasonZh: 反向自「可变字体」的精选:搭配关系,原句「字体文件里的另一组开关:可变轴管连续字重,OpenType 特性表(smcp/liga/zero)管字形替换——两套系统。」
type/small-caps-features.reasonEn: Reverse from "Variable Fonts" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "Another switchbank inside the font file: variation axes own continuous weight, OpenType feature tables (smcp/liga/zero) own glyph swaps — two systems."

type/tabular-numbers.reasonZh: 搭配:同一字体文件的两类 OpenType 能力:tnum 特性表管数字等宽,fvar 注册轴管字重/光学连续取档——CSS 都只是开关,字体不含表则声明无效。
type/tabular-numbers.reasonEn: Pairs with: Two OpenType powers in one font file: the tnum feature table equalizes digits, fvar registered axes slide weight/optical continuously — CSS merely flips the switch, no table no effect.

type/tabular-numbers.reasonZh: 对比:数字的两种特殊排法易混:tnum 让横排数字列等宽对齐,text-combine-upright 把多位数压进竖排的一个字格——场景不同别互串。
type/tabular-numbers.reasonEn: Contrasts: Two special digit treatments easy to blur: tnum equalizes horizontal numeric columns, text-combine-upright squeezes multi-digit years into one vertical cell — different scenes, no swapping.

type/tabular-numbers.reasonZh: 反向自「数字滚动」的精选:延伸关系,原句「逐帧滚动的数字必须等宽,否则宽度逐帧抖动——本条目结构第一课就是 tabular-nums,先把 OpenType tnum 的原理搞懂。」
type/tabular-numbers.reasonEn: Reverse from "Count-Up Number" curated: Extends relation, quoting "Frame-updating digits must be tabular or the width jitters every frame — this entry's structural lesson one is tabular-nums; understand OpenType tnum first."

type/text-wrap-balance.reasonZh: 搭配:大标题折成两三行时,展示级观感还取决于折行质量:balance 均衡各行给大字标题收末行,字号/字距/行高联动在 display-typography。
type/text-wrap-balance.reasonEn: Pairs with: When a display headline wraps to two or three lines, its look also depends on wrap quality: balance evens the lines — the size/tracking/leading triad lives in display-typography.

type/text-wrap-balance.reasonZh: 搭配:标题 balance 的排版语境:杂志级 headline 层级与 pull quote 的版面里,断行均衡是显学。
type/text-wrap-balance.reasonEn: Pairs with: The typographic home of balanced headlines: in a magazine's headline hierarchy and pull-quote spreads, evened line breaks are doctrine.

type/text-wrap-balance.reasonZh: 反向自「行长与可读性」的精选:搭配关系,原句「行长定宽之后断行的最后一道工序:balance 均衡标题各行,pretty 给长正文防孤行。」
type/text-wrap-balance.reasonEn: Reverse from "Measure & Line Length" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The last pass after fixing the measure: balance evens heading lines, pretty guards long body text against orphans."

type/variable-fonts.reasonZh: 搭配:展示级字重的供给层:600 档落在 Inter Variable wght 100–900 真实轴上连续取值,opsz 14–32 分 text/display 光学档——非合成加粗。
type/variable-fonts.reasonEn: Pairs with: The supply layer of display weights: the 600 tier rides Inter Variable's real wght 100–900 axis with continuous values, opsz 14–32 splits text/display optics — never synthetic bold.

type/variable-fonts.reasonZh: 搭配:字体文件里的另一组开关:可变轴管连续字重,OpenType 特性表(smcp/liga/zero)管字形替换——两套系统。
type/variable-fonts.reasonEn: Pairs with: Another switchbank inside the font file: variation axes own continuous weight, OpenType feature tables (smcp/liga/zero) own glyph swaps — two systems.

type/variable-fonts.reasonZh: 反向自「动态文字」的精选:延伸关系,原句「轴动画的前提是轴体系:wght/wdth 注册轴范围与 @font-face 区间声明在 variable-fonts 是基础条目——本条目原文如此分工。」
type/variable-fonts.reasonEn: Reverse from "Kinetic Typography" curated: Extends relation, quoting "Axis animation presupposes the axis system: registered wght/wdth ranges and @font-face interval declarations are the foundation entry (variable-fonts) — this entry says so itself."

type/vertical-rhythm.reasonZh: 搭配:纵向韵律的网格化执行:把行高单元落成固定步长(8px/半步 4px),再开可视化让偏离无处藏。
type/vertical-rhythm.reasonEn: Pairs with: Vertical rhythm's grid execution: turn the line-height unit into a fixed step (8px, half-step 4px) and overlay the visualization.

type/vertical-rhythm.reasonZh: 搭配:行高单元的倍数从哪来:字阶的几何级数 size(n)=base×ratioⁿ 是同一套倍数语言的字号侧。
type/vertical-rhythm.reasonEn: Pairs with: Where the rhythm unit's multiples come from: the scale's geometric series is the same ratio language on the type side.

type/vertical-rhythm.reasonZh: 反向自「行高韵律公式」的精选:搭配关系,原句「行高公式的版面级应用:lh=fs×m 算出单元之后,标题反推、间距取整倍、行盒逐行叠加成整页韵律。」
type/vertical-rhythm.reasonEn: Reverse from "Line-height Rhythm" curated: Pairs with relation, quoting "The page-level application of the line-height formula: once lh=fs×m sets the unit, headings back-solve and spacing rounds into a full-page rhythm."

type/wcag-text-spacing.reasonZh: 搭配:韵律默认值就是无障碍默认值:单元=行高比 18/12=1.5 恰好满足 SC 1.4.12 阈值——两条纪律在同一个默认值上重合。
type/wcag-text-spacing.reasonEn: Pairs with: The rhythm default is the accessibility default: a unit equal to leading at 18/12 = 1.5 exactly meets the SC 1.4.12 threshold — the two disciplines coincide on one default.

type/wcag-text-spacing.reasonZh: 搭配:1.5 倍行高同时是基线网格的落格条件:16px×1.5=24px=3 步——用户覆写行高时行盒离开步长,网格可视化立即报警。
type/wcag-text-spacing.reasonEn: Pairs with: A 1.5 line-height is also the baseline grid's landing condition: 16px × 1.5 = 24px = 3 steps — when users override line-height the line boxes leave the grid, visibly.

rationale.zh: 16 号调研 §7-配方 a:玻璃拟态的唯一完整官方体系是 Apple Liquid Glass——玻璃只给控件与导航层(Don't use Liquid Glass in the content layer)、Use Liquid Glass effects sparingly;两个变体按语义选:regular(模糊+调亮度,适合 alert/sidebar/popover 等文字多的浮层)与 clear(高透,只给媒体之上的组件;底层内容亮时加 35% 不透明度暗色压暗层),厚度 ultraThin/thin/regular/thick 按语义选、越厚对比越好;材质上放文字必须用 vibrant 色(https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/materials )。按压反馈不靠玻璃表达,交给 M3 内容色状态层:颜色取内容色(on color)而非容器色、一次只叠一层,固定档 hover +8%/focus +10%/press +10%/drag +16%(https://m3.material.io/foundations/interaction/states/state-layers );海拔语义交给投影——M3 静止卡只允许 0~+3、hover 可抬一级,阴影「小而锐=近、大而柔=远」(https://m3.material.io/styles/elevation/applying-elevation );Ant 三级阴影中卡片 hover 用第 1 层 @shadow-1(0 1px 2px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.16)…,§2.3 精确值),配 motionDurationFast 0.1s 过渡(https://ant.design/docs/spec/shadow-cn/ ),只在层级真变化时换档。自定义按钮必配按压态——Apple「Always include a press state for a custom button」(https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons ),本站按压对 = scale 0.96 + alpha 状态层成对出现。TDesign/Arco/Semi 无官方玻璃拟态卡片配方 → 未证实(§9 清单;容器/间距可引 TDesign 布局数值辅助,https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/layout )。四件套分工:材质管氛围、状态层管反馈、投影管海拔、按压对管触感(§8 巧思 1–3;组合衔接口径 = 玻璃管氛围、别再叠装饰,按压态交给状态层/按压变形,Liquid Glass 对直接触摸加强反馈)。
rationale.en: Research 16 §7 recipe-a: Apple Liquid Glass is the only complete official glass system — glass belongs to controls/nav layers only (Don't use Liquid Glass in the content layer), use it sparingly; pick variants by semantics: regular (blur + brightness tuning for text-heavy overlays like alerts/sidebars/popovers) and clear (highly translucent, only over media; add a 35%-opacity dark dimming layer when the underlying content is bright), thickness ultraThin/thin/regular/thick by semantics — thicker = better contrast; text on materials must use vibrant colors (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/materials ). Press feedback is NOT expressed with glass but with M3 content-color state layers: color from the content color (on color), one layer at a time, fixed tiers hover +8% / focus +10% / press +10% / drag +16% (https://m3.material.io/foundations/interaction/states/state-layers ); elevation semantics live in shadows — M3 allows 0~+3 at rest with hover lifting one level, and "small and sharp = near, large and soft = far" (https://m3.material.io/styles/elevation/applying-elevation ); card hover takes Ant's level-1 shadow @shadow-1 (0 1px 2px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.16)…, exact §2.3 values) with a motionDurationFast 0.1s transition (https://ant.design/docs/spec/shadow-cn/ ), switching levels only when hierarchy truly changes. Custom buttons always carry a press state — Apple's "Always include a press state for a custom button" (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons ), here as the paired scale-0.96 + alpha state layer. TDesign/Arco/Semi have no official glassmorphism card recipe → unverified (§9 list; container/spacing may lean on TDesign layout numbers, https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/layout ). Division of labor (§8 craft 1–3): material owns ambience, state layer owns feedback, shadow owns elevation, press pair owns touch (composition glue: glass owns ambience, never stack decoration on it; press states go to state layers / press morphing, and Liquid Glass intensifies feedback for direct touch).

## 目标

组合一块生产级玻璃卡片:玻璃拟态材质层(磨砂玻璃面板)+ M3 内容色状态层反馈 + Fluent 主题投影海拔 + 按压反馈对,悬浮于彩色渐变/照片背景之上;四层各司其职——材质管氛围、状态层管反馈、投影管海拔、按压对管触感。


## 验收要点(逐组件)

### Glassmorphism / 毛玻璃
- backdrop-filter: blur(Npx) 同时写 -webkit- 前缀兜底
- 填充、描边、圆角严格使用参数快照值,不要自行调整
- 背景必须是彩色照片或多层渐变——放在纯色底上玻璃会失效
- 深色变体叠加 rgba(17,25,40,0.55) 一类深填充并反白文字
- 提供 @supports 回退:不支持时提高填充不透明度保证可读

### State Layers (M3) / M3 状态层
- 四个状态层取内容色(如 on-primary),不透明度严格用快照值 8/10/10/16%,不要自行改色
- 四层可同时叠加(如 hover+focus+press),层序 press 在 hover 之上
- focus 态保留可见焦点环,不只靠状态层
- 状态层用单个绝对定位覆盖层 + data 属性驱动,不逐状态换 background-image

### ThemeShadow (Fluent) / Fluent 主题阴影
- z 语义正确:阴影 blur/offset 随 z 增大而增大,alpha 随 z 增大而减小(弥散变淡)
- 快照值直接驱动:elevation 映射到模糊/偏移,opacity 作为阴影 alpha 增益
- 所有投影均为矩形(遵循 ThemeShadow 矩形限定),文字标注这是 Web 近似
- z=0 的卡片无阴影,且阴影不作为层级唯一线索(卡片标注 z 值)

### Press Feedback Pair / 按压反馈对
- 按下瞬间 0ms 生效:实现 `:active { transition: none }`(Arco 官方工艺),松手才给 `--press-release-ms` 过渡
- scale(0.97)+alpha(0.8) 需标注为社区常见值、未证实,不得写成任何库的官方默认
- 色彩阶进版只过渡 color/background-color/border-color/box-shadow/opacity(AntD 官方五属性语义)
- 键盘触发(Space/Enter)与指针按压呈现同一按压态;提供 :focus-visible 焦点反馈
- prefers-reduced-motion 时去掉 scale/过渡,保留瞬时状态切换

### 配方级
- 玻璃材质层与交互反馈层严格分层:材质只管氛围(blur/fill/border/radius),反馈交给状态层与按压对,不在玻璃上再叠装饰
- 状态层颜色取内容色(on color)而非容器色,一次只叠一层;hover +8%、focus +10%、press +10%
- 投影只在层级真变化时换档:hover 抬升至第一层悬浮阴影(Ant @shadow-1 语义),静止回落
- 自定义按钮必须配按压态(Apple Buttons 铁律):scale 0.96 + alpha 状态层成对出现
- 玻璃上文字按透出的最亮/最暗背景两端核对 4.5:1;不支持 backdrop-filter 时提供实底回退

This is a multi-component composition. Replicate it one-to-one; follow each component's official-default parameter snapshot below and do not alter the values.

```json
    "value": "instant"
  },
  {
    "name": "mode",
    "value": "scale"
  }
]
```

## Acceptance Criteria (per component)

### Glassmorphism
- backdrop-filter: blur(Npx) with the -webkit- prefixed fallback in place
- Fill, border and radius use the exact parameter snapshot values; do not adjust them
- The backdrop must be a colorful photo or multi-stop gradient — glass breaks on flat color
- The dark variant stacks a deep fill like rgba(17,25,40,0.55) and flips text to light
- Provide an @supports fallback: raise fill opacity for readability when unsupported

### State Layers (M3)
- The four state layers use the content color (e.g. on-primary) with opacities exactly at the snapshot 8/10/10/16%; do not recolor them
- The four layers can stack simultaneously (e.g. hover+focus+press), press above hover in z-order
- The focus state keeps a visible focus ring; never rely on the state layer alone
- Implement state layers as one absolutely positioned overlay per state driven by data attributes — not by swapping background-image per state

### ThemeShadow (Fluent)
- z semantics correct: shadow blur/offset grow with z while alpha falls (diffuse = fainter)
- Snapshot values drive everything: elevation maps to blur/offset, opacity is the shadow-alpha gain
- Every shadow is rectangular (respecting ThemeShadow's constraint) and the UI states this is a Web approximation
- The z=0 card has no shadow, and z values are labeled on cards — shadow is never the only hierarchy cue

### Press Feedback Pair
- The press lands in 0ms: implement `:active { transition: none }` (Arco's official craft); only the release gets the `--press-release-ms` transition
- scale(0.97) + alpha(0.8) must be flagged as community-common, unverified — never presented as any library's official default
- The color-step variant transitions only color/background-color/border-color/box-shadow/opacity (AntD's official five-prop semantics)
- Keyboard activation (Space/Enter) shows the same pressed state as pointer press; provide a :focus-visible focus cue
- Under prefers-reduced-motion, drop the scale/transition but keep the instant state flip

### Recipe-level
- Material and interaction layers stay separated: the material only sets ambience (blur/fill/border/radius); feedback goes to state layers and the press pair — never stack decoration on glass
- State layers use the content color (on color), not the container color; one layer at a time; hover +8%, focus +10%, press +10%
- Shadow levels change only when hierarchy truly changes: hover lifts to the level-1 shadow (Ant @shadow-1 semantics) and settles back at rest
- Custom buttons always carry a press state (Apple Buttons rule): scale 0.96 paired with an alpha state layer
- Check text on glass against the brightest and darkest backdrop extremes for 4.5:1; provide a solid-surface fallback when backdrop-filter is unsupported

rationale.zh: 16 号调研 §7-配方 b:「bento grid」官方术语未证实(§9 清单),替代依据是各系栅格数值——容器层 bento 取调研配方 repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr))/行高 180px/间隙 16px/圆角 24px(superdesign.dev 条目 schema 官方默认);面板密度层走 Grafana 面板数值 gap 8px(GRID_CELL_VMARGIN)/行高 30px(GRID_CELL_HEIGHT)/KPI 面板 3 格=90px、Power BI 字号阶梯 45/12/12/10;宏观栅格依据 = Ant 24 栅格/基数 8(https://ant.design/docs/spec/layout-cn/ )+ TDesign 基数 8px/gutter 16px(https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/layout )+ M3 spacing 线性 scale(https://m3.material.io/styles/spacing/applying-spacing )。密度切换只动间距不动字号(Ant Table 三档 cellPadding 16/12/8 而 cellFontSize 恒 14,https://ant.design/components/table-cn/ ;ProTable 密度切换是一等工具栏能力)。骨架占位尺寸=真实卡片尺寸、加载完成零位移——Ant「只在第一次加载数据时使用骨架屏」(https://ant.design/components/skeleton-cn/ )+ Apple Loading「show something as soon as possible」内容到达即替换(https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/loading )+ M3 把 Skeleton loaders 官方列为六大转场模式之一(https://m3.material.io/styles/motion/transitions/transition-patterns )+ TDesign 首屏禁顺序动画(https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/motion )(§8 巧思 5「骨架屏是布局的预告片」)。磁吸按钮为点缀层(radius 0.45/lerp 0.15,条目 schema 默认),触屏与 reduced-motion 用户直接关掉磁吸走普通按压态。
rationale.en: Research 16 §7 recipe-b: "bento grid" is not an official term anywhere (§9 unverified list) — the working basis is each system's grid numbers. The container bento takes the researched recipe repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr))/180px rows/16px gap/24px radius (entry-schema defaults from superdesign.dev); the panel density layer uses Grafana panel numbers — gap 8px (GRID_CELL_VMARGIN), row height 30px (GRID_CELL_HEIGHT), KPI panel = 3 rows = 90px, Power BI type ladder 45/12/12/10. Macro-grid grounding: Ant 24-col/base-8 (https://ant.design/docs/spec/layout-cn/ ) + TDesign base 8px/gutter 16px (https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/layout ) + M3 linear spacing scale (https://m3.material.io/styles/spacing/applying-spacing ). Density switches spacing only, never font size (Ant Table three cellPadding tiers 16/12/8 with cellFontSize fixed at 14, https://ant.design/components/table-cn/ ; ProTable ships density switching as a first-class toolbar action). Skeleton sizes equal real card sizes so loading lands with zero shift — Ant "use skeletons only on the first data load" (https://ant.design/components/skeleton-cn/ ) + Apple Loading "show something as soon as possible", replace on arrival (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/loading ) + M3 officially lists skeleton loaders among its six transition patterns (https://m3.material.io/styles/motion/transitions/transition-patterns ) + TDesign forbids first-screen sequential animation (https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/motion ) (§8 craft 5: "the skeleton is the layout's trailer"). The magnetic button is an accent layer (radius 0.45 / lerp 0.15, entry-schema defaults) — touch and reduced-motion users get plain press states with magnetics off.

- 内容淡入 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)(M3 short4 + Standard easing)
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时停用扫光与淡入,加载状态用文字/aria-busy 兜底
- 加载语义同时经 aria-busy 与可见文字传达,不依赖动画

### Magnetic Hover / 磁吸交互
- 距离判定:reach = max(宽, 高)/2 ÷ (1 − radius),半径内目标 = 指针偏移 × radius,半径外目标归零
- 逐帧插值 current += (target − current) × lerp(默认 0.15),配 rAF 循环,位移直写 el.style.translate
- 触屏(e.pointerType === touch / (hover: none))与 prefers-reduced-motion 下磁吸整体关闭,直出普通 hover
- CSS 挂 @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), (hover: none) { translate: none } 双保险
- 按钮可键盘聚焦,focus-visible 描边不产生位移;磁吸语义同时由颜色/文字承担

### 配方级
- 两套网格各司其职:容器 bento(cols 4/rowHeight 180px/gap 16px/radius 24px)管板块构图,面板内密度(gap 8px/rowHeight 30px,--dvz-gap/--dvz-row)管信息密度;间隙不统一 bento 立刻散架
- 密度切换只动间距与行高、字号阶梯基本不动(comfortable 45/12/12/10;compact 演示档:间距减半、行高 ×0.8、callout 45→32、label 10→9——官方无 compact 数值惯例,未证实;9px 已是 AA 可读下限);Ant Table 口径:三档 cellPadding 16/12/8 而 cellFontSize 恒 14
- 骨架占位尺寸=真实卡片尺寸(同一 grid 模板),内容到达快速淡入、零位移;骨架只用于首次加载(重放按钮仅为演示),「正在加载」语义用 aria-busy/状态文字兜底而非只靠扫光动画
- 扫光脉动 1200ms 水平档为社区常见值(未证实:M3 只要求「微妙脉动」未记载数值);reduced-motion 时脉动停用、色块保持静态基色
- 磁吸按钮是点缀不是必需:radius 0.45/lerp 0.15(逐帧插值 current += (target−current)×0.15),prefers-reduced-motion 或 hover:none 时整体关闭、直出普通按压态;键盘聚焦走 focus-visible 描边不产生位移

## Acceptance Criteria (per component)

### Bento Grid
- grid-template-columns: repeat(N, minmax(0,1fr)) with one uniform gap (default 16px)
- Row height uses the parameter value (default 180px); the hero cell spans 2×2
- Cell radius uses the parameter value (default 24px, never below 16px)
- Cell size encodes priority: the largest cell carries the most important fact, one fact per cell
- Breakpoints reduce columns (768px→2, 480px→1 with spans reset); DOM order = reading order, no reliance on dense for sequencing

### Dashboard Density
- Grid constants verbatim from the research: 24 columns, 30px rows, 8px panel gaps, 3-row minimum panels (Grafana source-verified)
- Font ladder 45/12/12/10 labeled as Power BI's official example values, not enforced defaults
- Compact-preset values honestly labeled as demo-proposed (no official compact conventions exist)
- Keep tiers separate: grid gap from grid variables, panel padding from intra-panel density
- MDX states Tableau's numeric conventions are unpublished (not found) — no invented values

### Skeleton Loading
- Placeholder and content blocks align in size; the swap causes no layout shift
- The sweep animates only transform (translateX) at the snapshot period --skeleton-duration
- Content fades in at 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) (M3 short4 + Standard easing)
- Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, disable the sweep and fade; the loading state rides on text/aria-busy
- The loading semantics are conveyed via aria-busy and visible text, never via motion alone

### Magnetic Hover
- Distance test: reach = max(w,h)/2 ÷ (1 − radius); inside it target = pointer offset × radius, outside it target returns to zero
- Per-frame lerp current += (target − current) × lerp (default 0.15) in an rAF loop, written straight to el.style.translate
- Touch (e.pointerType === touch / (hover: none)) and prefers-reduced-motion switch magnetism off entirely, falling back to plain hover
- CSS carries the @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), (hover: none) { translate: none } belt-and-suspenders
- The button is keyboard-focusable with a focus-visible outline and zero displacement; clickability also rides on color/label

### Recipe-level
- Two grids, two jobs: the container bento (cols 4 / rowHeight 180px / gap 16px / radius 24px) owns composition, in-panel density (gap 8px / rowHeight 30px via --dvz-gap/--dvz-row) owns information density; uneven gaps break the bento instantly
- Density switching changes spacing and row height, leaving the type ladder mostly intact (comfortable 45/12/12/10; compact demo tier: halved spacing, ×0.8 rows, callout 45→32, label 10→9 — no official compact conventions exist, unverified; 9px is at the AA readability floor); Ant Table: cellPadding 16/12/8 across three tiers while cellFontSize stays 14
- Skeleton sizes equal real card sizes (same grid template); content fades in fast with zero shift; skeletons are first-load only (the replay button is a demo affordance); "loading" semantics ride on aria-busy/status text, never on the shimmer alone
- The 1200ms horizontal shimmer is a common community value (unverified: M3 only demands a "subtle pulse" and records no number); under reduced-motion the pulse stops and blocks keep their static base color
- The magnetic button is an accent, not a requirement: radius 0.45 / lerp 0.15 (per-frame current += (target−current)×0.15); fully off under prefers-reduced-motion or hover:none with plain press states instead; keyboard focus keeps the focus-visible ring with zero translation

All button/step-header feedback goes to M3 content-color state layers: hover +8%, focus +10%, press +10%, one layer at a time, color taken from the content color (https://m3.material.io/foundations/interaction/states/state-layers ). Submit feedback = a spring toast: the official spring basis is M3 Expressive motion-physics (spatial + effects springs, https://m3.material.io/blog/building-with-m3-expressive ), demo params take the entry-schema defaults stiffness 300 / damping 25 (ζ≈0.722, overshoot ≈3.8%), edge bottom, lifetime 4000ms (sonner TOAST_LIFETIME source value); Ant's split: light feedback = 3s message, heavy = result page countdown (https://ant.design/components/message-cn/ ; https://ant.design/docs/spec/research-result-cn/ ); the counter-rule: TDesign "UI uses Cubic curves only, Elastic is for cartoon illustration" — the spring stops at a slight overshoot (https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/motion ); no vendor publishes a form-step spring parameter table → unverified. ## 目标

组合一条分段表单流:Ant Steps 步骤条(任务分解、error 可标出错步、<532px 自动竖排)+ 每一步按钮/步骤头的 M3 内容色状态层反馈(hover +8%/focus +10%/press +10%,一次一层)+ 最后一步「再次确认」后提交,底部弹出一枚弹簧吐司(stiffness 300/damping 25/edge bottom/lifetime 4000ms,悬停暂停、✕ 可关、Esc 关闭并归还焦点)+ 步骤头工具栏 roving tabindex 方向键导航、主按钮绑 Return。

这是一个多组件组合方案,请一比一复刻。逐组件严格遵循下方官方默认参数快照,不要自行调整数值。

## 验收要点(逐组件)

### Steps / 步骤条
- ol/li 有序列表 + 当前步 aria-current="step";四态用图形(✓/✕/数字)+ 文字,不依赖单色
- 状态推算:i<current 为 finish,i=current 为 process,i>current 为 wait;errorAt 显式覆盖优先
- process 步进度环用 conic-gradient 严格取 percent 参数值(0% 不画环),连接线填充色 #1677ff
- 步骤头是原生 button,点击/Enter 设置当前步并同步 aria-current;焦点环可见
- 错误态 #ff4d4f + ✕ 图形 + 文字说明;窄屏(<532px)或 orientation=vertical 时转纵向;动效尊重 prefers-reduced-motion

### State Layers (M3) / M3 状态层
- 四个状态层取内容色(如 on-primary),不透明度严格用快照值 8/10/10/16%,不要自行改色
- 四层可同时叠加(如 hover+focus+press),层序 press 在 hover 之上
- focus 态保留可见焦点环,不只靠状态层
- 状态层用单个绝对定位覆盖层 + data 属性驱动,不逐状态换 background-image

### Toast Spring Entrance / Toast 弹簧入场
- 入场初态与 react-hot-toast 同构:屏外滑入 + scale 0.6 + opacity 0.5(方向按边缘)
- 入场弹簧参数严格 stiffness 300 / damping 25(mass 1,ζ≈0.722),退场 0.4s cubic-bezier(.06,.71,.55,1)
- 生命周期 4000ms 自动消失(sonner 源码值);计时在卸载/手动关闭时清理
- 容器 role=status(aria-live=polite),消息可 ✕ 手动关闭;不承载关键信息
- prefers-reduced-motion 时入/出均为纯 fade(react-hot-toast 官方降级)

### Keyboard Navigation / 键盘导航全景
- 三个场景的键位严格按 APG/WebAIM:工具栏方向键 roving;Tabs 方向键选择;对话框 Esc 归还焦点
- skip link 在获得键盘焦点时可见,点击跳过重复块
- ring 为 JS 型参数:native 不覆盖默认 outline,strong 用 --kn-ring-width 实线环
- focus ≠ selection:标签页上焦点环与选中填充同时可辨且不同
- 按键日志经 aria-live 播报;所有交互均可纯键盘完成

### 配方级
- 步骤条是承诺清单:线性任务才分步、步骤头始终告知进度、出错步用 error 态显式标出;每步是完整数据、最后合并提交(Ant StepsForm 口径);宽度 <532px 自动转竖排
- 最后一步必须「再次确认」后才提交(Ant 表单页模板铁律),成功给明确结果反馈:轻反馈 = 弹簧吐司(重反馈才用结果页倒计时)
- 状态层颜色取内容色(on color)而非容器色,一次只叠一层:hover +8%、focus +10%、press +10%;焦点态另配 focus-visible 描边,状态不只靠颜色承载
- 弹簧吐司参数 = 条目官方默认:stiffness 300 / damping 25(ζ≈0.722、过冲≈3.8%,轻微过冲即止——TDesign「UI 一律 Cubic」)/ edge bottom / lifetime 4000ms;悬停暂停计时、✕ 可手动关闭;reduced-motion 时入出场退化为纯 fade
- 键盘路径完整:步骤头 roving tabindex + 方向键;Esc 关吐司并归还焦点到提交按钮;主按钮绑 Return;无 tabindex≥1、无 outline:0(键盘导航工程红线)

## Acceptance Criteria (per component)

### Steps
- ol/li ordered list + aria-current="step" on the active header; four states use glyphs (✓/✕/number) plus text, never color alone
- Derivation: i<current finish, i=current process, i>current wait; errorAt overrides explicitly
- The process ring uses conic-gradient from the exact percent param (no ring at 0%); connector fill #1677ff
- Headers are native buttons; click/Enter sets current and syncs aria-current; focus ring visible

### State Layers (M3)
- The four state layers use the content color (e.g. on-primary) with opacities exactly at the snapshot 8/10/10/16%; do not recolor them
- The four layers can stack simultaneously (e.g. hover+focus+press), press above hover in z-order
- The focus state keeps a visible focus ring; never rely on the state layer alone
- Implement state layers as one absolutely positioned overlay per state driven by data attributes — not by swapping background-image per state

### Toast Spring Entrance
- Entrance initial state mirrors react-hot-toast: off-screen travel + scale 0.6 + opacity 0.5 (direction per edge)

- Container role=status (aria-live=polite), messages manually closeable via ✕; never critical info
- Under prefers-reduced-motion both directions become a bare fade (react-hot-toast's official degradation)

### Keyboard Navigation
- Scene keys follow APG/WebAIM exactly: toolbar arrows rove; tabs arrows select; dialog Esc returns focus
- The skip link becomes visible on keyboard focus and jumps past repeated blocks
- ring is a JS-type param: native keeps the default outline; strong draws a --kn-ring-width solid ring
- focus ≠ selection: on tabs, the focus ring and the selected fill are simultaneously distinguishable and different
- The key log announces via aria-live; everything is keyboard-only operable

### Recipe-level
- The step bar is a promise list: split only linear tasks, always show progress in the headers, mark the failing step with the error state; each step holds complete data merged at the end (Ant StepsForm); auto-vertical below 532px
- The last step requires an explicit "confirm again" before submit (Ant form-page template rule), and success gets a clear result feedback: light = spring toast (heavy = result-page countdown)
- State layers take the content color (on color), one layer at a time: hover +8%, focus +10%, press +10%; focus adds a focus-visible ring; state never rides on color alone
- Spring toast params = entry official defaults: stiffness 300 / damping 25 (ζ≈0.722, overshoot ≈3.8% and no more — TDesign's "UI is Cubic only") / edge bottom / lifetime 4000ms; hover pauses the timer, ✕ closes manually; reduced-motion degrades entrance/exit to pure fade
- Complete keyboard path: roving tabindex + arrow keys on step headers; Esc dismisses the toast and restores focus to the submit button; the primary button binds Return; no tabindex≥1, no outline:0 (keyboard-navigation engineering red lines)

## 目标

组合一个键盘优先的命令操作面:Ctrl K/Cmd K 唤出命令面板浮层,输入即出建议(子序列 subsequence 匹配、同屏最多 8 条、词首命中加权),浮层入场 scale 0.95 + shiftY 8px + 200ms standard、出场 150ms 更快且不排队,Esc 逐层退栈并归还焦点、Tab 在面板内困焦、输入框永久聚焦、点击外部可关。

这是一个多组件组合方案,请一比一复刻。逐组件严格遵循下方官方默认参数快照,不要自行调整数值。


## 验收要点(逐组件)

### Command Palette / 命令面板
- APG 语义逐项落位:combobox + aria-expanded/aria-controls/aria-autocomplete=list/aria-activedescendant,listbox + option + aria-selected;焦点恒在输入框
- 子序列模糊匹配零依赖实现:词首/连击加权,评分排序,别名字段参与检索;空 query 直出前 N 条
- focus trap:Tab 留在面板内;Esc 关闭并把焦点还给唤起者;开面板锁 body 滚动(补偿滚动条宽度)
- 面板走参数化材质层(blur+saturate+叠色 tint+内高光+hairline+阴影),@supports 门控回退实底;入场只动 opacity/transform,RM 降级直出终态
- 快捷键徽标按平台显示(⌘K / Ctrl K)但不预判水合;aria-keyshortcuts 在触发钮上声明;触屏走搜索钮点击等价路径

### Overlay Entrance / 浮层入场
- 初态严格 scale(0.95)+opacity 0+translateY(8px),入场 200ms(参数快照值,勿自行调整)
- transform-origin 按锚点方向设置(仿 Radix 语义),不得恒为中心
- 点击外部与 Esc 都能关闭;打开时焦点进入浮层,关闭后归还触发钮
- 退场(150ms)必须比入场(200ms)快——『进慢出快』
- prefers-reduced-motion 时取消位移/缩放只留 fade;动画可被中途打断不锁交互

### Keyboard Navigation / 键盘导航全景
- 三个场景的键位严格按 APG/WebAIM:工具栏方向键 roving;Tabs 方向键选择;对话框 Esc 归还焦点
- skip link 在获得键盘焦点时可见,点击跳过重复块
- ring 为 JS 型参数:native 不覆盖默认 outline,strong 用 --kn-ring-width 实线环
- focus ≠ selection:标签页上焦点环与选中填充同时可辨且不同
- 按键日志经 aria-live 播报;所有交互均可纯键盘完成

### 配方级
- 命令面板本体无官方组件(未证实):按官方零件拼装——单一可发现入口(快捷键徽标 Ctrl K,同时收 Ctrl+K 与 Cmd+K)、输入即出建议、最近/建议置顶
- 匹配 = 子序列 subsequence(逐字符按序命中即命中,词首加权、连击加权、残余更短微加权),同屏上限 maxResults 8,超出靠继续键入收窄;空结果态给出「无匹配」而非空白
- 浮层入场 = scale 0.95 + translateY 8px + 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),出场 150ms 更快且不排队(退场必须短于入场);reduced-motion 时取消位移/缩放、保留纯 fade
- 浮层的可发现性与退出不依赖动画:Esc 关闭并归还焦点到触发按钮、点击 backdrop 关闭、Tab 困焦在面板内、输入框永久聚焦、方向键在结果间移动且 Enter 执行
- 焦点管理法则引用 WAI-ARIA APG Dialog(模态困焦必须 Esc 可释放,SC 2.1.2)+ Ant Modal keyboard Esc 默认 true / focusable{trap};M3 focus 状态层 +10% 叠在选中项内容色上

## Goal

Compose a keyboard-first command surface: Ctrl K / Cmd K summons a command-palette overlay, suggestions appear as you type (subsequence matching, at most 8 results on screen, prefix hits weighted), the overlay enters at scale 0.95 + shiftY 8px over 200ms standard and exits in 150ms — faster, never queued — while Esc unwinds the stack and restores focus, Tab traps inside the panel, the input stays permanently focused, and clicking outside dismisses.

This is a multi-component composition. Replicate it one-to-one; follow each component's official-default parameter snapshot below and do not alter the values.

## Parameter Snapshot (per component · official defaults)

### Command Palette (components/command-palette)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "matchMode",
    "value": "subsequence"
  },
  {
    "name": "maxResults",
    "value": "8"
  },
  {
    "name": "hotkeyDisplay",
    "value": "ctrl-k"
  }
]
```

### Overlay Entrance (motion/overlay-entrance)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "initialScale",
    "value": "0.95"
  },
  {
    "name": "shiftY",
    "value": "8px"
  },
  {
    "name": "inDuration",
    "value": "200ms"
  },
  {
    "name": "outDuration",
    "value": "150ms"
  },
  {
    "name": "curve",
    "value": "standard"
  }
]
```

### Keyboard Navigation (principles/keyboard-navigation)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "scene",
    "value": "toolbar"
  },
  {
    "name": "ring",
    "value": "native"
  },
  {
    "name": "ringWidth",
    "value": "3px"
  }
]
```

## Acceptance Criteria (per component)

### Command Palette
- APG semantics placed item by item: combobox + aria-expanded/aria-controls/aria-autocomplete=list/aria-activedescendant, listbox + option + aria-selected; focus always stays on the input
- Zero-dependency subsequence fuzzy matching: word-start/streak bonuses, scored ranking, aliases searchable; an empty query lists the first N entries
- Focus trap: Tab stays inside; Esc closes and returns focus to the invoker; opening locks body scroll (with scrollbar-width compensation)
- The panel uses the parameterized material layer (blur+saturate+tint+inner highlight+hairline+shadow) with @supports fallback to solid; entrance animates only opacity/transform and RM renders the final state instantly
- The hotkey badge shows per platform (⌘K / Ctrl K) without pre-judging hydration; aria-keyshortcuts declared on the trigger; touch uses the search button as the equivalent path

### Overlay Entrance
- Initial state strictly scale(0.95)+opacity 0+translateY(8px), entering over 200ms (snapshot values; do not adjust)
- transform-origin follows the anchor side (Radix semantics), never a constant center
- Both outside-click and Esc dismiss; focus enters the overlay on open and returns to the trigger on close
- The exit (150ms) must be quicker than the entrance (200ms) — 'slow in, quick out'
- Under prefers-reduced-motion drop shift/scale leaving a bare fade; motion stays interruptible and never locks interaction

### Keyboard Navigation
- Scene keys follow APG/WebAIM exactly: toolbar arrows rove; tabs arrows select; dialog Esc returns focus
- The skip link becomes visible on keyboard focus and jumps past repeated blocks
- ring is a JS-type param: native keeps the default outline; strong draws a --kn-ring-width solid ring
- focus ≠ selection: on tabs, the focus ring and the selected fill are simultaneously distinguishable and different
- The key log announces via aria-live; everything is keyboard-only operable

### Recipe-level
- No official command-palette component exists (unverified): assemble from official parts — one discoverable entry (Ctrl K badge, accepting both Ctrl+K and Cmd+K), suggestions as you type, recents/suggestions on top
- Matching = subsequence (characters hit in order; prefix weighted, consecutive hits weighted, shorter residue slightly weighted), maxResults 8 on screen, further typing narrows; an empty state shows "no matches" instead of blank
- Overlay entrance = scale 0.95 + translateY 8px over 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); exit 150ms, faster and never queued (exit shorter than entrance); reduced-motion drops the transform and keeps a pure fade
- Discoverability and dismissal never depend on animation: Esc closes and restores focus to the trigger, backdrop click closes, Tab traps within the panel, the input keeps focus, arrow keys move between results and Enter runs them
- Focus management cites WAI-ARIA APG Dialog (modal trap must release on Esc, SC 2.1.2) + Ant Modal keyboard-Esc default true / focusable{trap}; the M3 focus state layer +10% rides on the selected item's content color
