rationale.zh: 16 号调研 §7-配方 e:视差有官方背书——M3 转场文档明写 iOS 前进/后退转场用 parallax(「background slides slower than the foreground」)以减少运动量,是减动效手段而非炫技(https://m3.material.io/styles/motion/transitions/transition-patterns )(§8 巧思 9);Apple 补 background extension effect + scroll edge effect(https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/layout );demo 取条目 schema 默认 rate 0.3(官方未给推荐值,0.2–0.6 为社区常见分层,未证实)、mode css = animation-timeline: scroll() 声明式滚动驱动(可离主线程),不支持自动落 JS(rAF + scroll 事件)兜底。动态排版 = Apple Dynamic Type 层级(Large 默认档 Body 17pt/Large Title 34pt,visionOS 编辑类 Extra Large Title,https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/typography )+ M3 type-scale-tokens(https://m3.material.io/styles/typography/type-scale-tokens );demo 取条目 schema 默认 stagger 40ms/rise 600ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)/wght 400(Inter Variable 轴域 100–900)/reveal chars,逐字 aria-hidden + 整句 aria-label 保读屏语义。极光渐变背景四家官方规范均无 → 未证实(§9 清单);落地按 Apple「Don't use Liquid Glass in the content layer」自行降级——条目 schema 默认 spots 4/blur 42px/saturate 115%/drift 18s(演示档,生产氛围光建议 60s 级)/spotA 20%/spotB 70%,文字卡独立于滤镜层保 4.5:1。动效红线:visionOS 禁 ~0.2Hz 持续振荡、反馈短促精准(https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/motion );reduced-motion 时视差与漂移全停、逐字直接呈现。
rationale.en: Research 16 §7 recipe-e: parallax is officially endorsed — M3's transition doc states iOS forward/backward transitions use parallax ("background slides slower than the foreground") to reduce motion, a reduction tool not a flourish (https://m3.material.io/styles/motion/transitions/transition-patterns ) (§8 craft 9); Apple adds the background extension effect + scroll edge effect (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/layout ). Demo values take entry-schema defaults: rate 0.3 (no official recommendation exists; 0.2–0.6 is the common community band, unverified) and mode css = declarative animation-timeline: scroll() (can run off the main thread), auto-falling back to JS (rAF + scroll events) when unsupported. Kinetic typography = Apple Dynamic Type hierarchy (Large default: Body 17pt / Large Title 34pt; visionOS Extra Large Title for editorial layouts, https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/typography ) + M3 type-scale-tokens (https://m3.material.io/styles/typography/type-scale-tokens ); demo takes entry-schema defaults: stagger 40ms / rise 600ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) / wght 400 (Inter Variable axis range 100–900) / reveal chars, with per-char aria-hidden + a whole-sentence aria-label preserving screen-reader semantics. The aurora-gradient backdrop has no official spec in any of the four systems → unverified (§9 list); it degrades per Apple's "Don't use Liquid Glass in the content layer" — entry-schema defaults: spots 4 / blur 42px / saturate 115% / drift 18s (demo tier; production ambience should be ~60s) / spotA 20% / spotB 70%, with the text card outside the filter layer holding 4.5:1. Motion red line: visionOS forbids ~0.2Hz sustained oscillation and feedback stays short and precise (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/motion ); under reduced-motion, parallax and drift stop entirely and characters render directly.

## 目标

组合一个媒体头图叙事页:极光渐变背景层(4 光斑 + conic 底、blur 42px + saturate 115%、18s 慢漂)以视差(rate 0.3,背景慢于前景以减动效)随内层滚动拖曳,前景文字 1:1 随滚动;大标题按 Dynamic Type 层级做逐字动态排版(stagger 40ms/rise 600ms/字重轴 wght 400);顶部保留 scroll edge 压暗 scrim,文字卡独立于滤镜层保 4.5:1。

## 验收要点(逐组件)

### Parallax / 视差滚动
- 每层位移 = (1 − p_layer) × 可滚动距离,p_layer = min(rate × 层乘数, 1)
- 声明式实现:animation-timeline: scroll() 写在 animation 简写之后,duration 取 auto
- 只动画 transform;附 JS(rAF + scroll 事件)对照路径并标注主线程代价
- 不支持 scroll() 的浏览器自动落到 JS 路径并显示标注;两级降级都保留内容可读
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时视差整体关闭、静态构图直出,视差层 aria-hidden 且不承载关键信息

### Kinetic Typography / 动态文字
- 拆分单元带 overflow hidden 裁剪容器(mask 语义),上升从 translateY(110%) 到 0,只动 transform+opacity
- 交错间隔与上升时长取参数快照(stagger × i 内联 delay;rise 经 --kinetic-rise)
- 字重轴经 @property 注册的变量驱动 font-variation-settings,0.5s 过渡(不支持的浏览器降级为跳变)
- 标题容器 aria-label 整句、拆分 span 全部 aria-hidden;读屏永不读到字母碎片
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时取消上升与轴过渡,文字直接完整呈现

### Aurora Gradient / 极光渐变
- 光斑用 radial-gradient(<尺寸> at x% y%, oklch(L 0.18–0.24 H / .55–.85), transparent ~68%),L 保持在 0.6–0.75
- 模糊与饱和只作用在整层容器(filter: blur(Npx) saturate(S)),不逐光斑设置
- 整层 inset:-25% 外扩,动画只 transform(ease-in-out alternate infinite),避免边缘露底
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时动画停止,背景静止但视觉完整
- 层为 aria-hidden 装饰,文字卡对比度在光斑最亮处仍达 4.5:1

### 配方级
- 视差是减动效手段(M3 官方定义「背景慢于前景以减少运动量」):背景层 rate 0.3、前景文字 1:1,内容永不依赖视差层传达;css 模式走 animation-timeline: scroll(),不支持自动落 JS 兜底

## Acceptance Criteria (per component)

### Parallax
- Per-layer translation = (1 − p_layer) × scrollable distance, with p_layer = min(rate × layer multiplier, 1)
- Declarative implementation: animation-timeline: scroll() declared after the animation shorthand, duration auto
- Animate transform only; include a JS contrast path (rAF + scroll events) labeled with its main-thread cost
- Browsers without scroll() fall back to the JS path with a label; both fallback tiers keep content readable
- Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, parallax switches off and static layers render; parallax layers are aria-hidden decoration carrying nothing critical

### Kinetic Typography
- Split units sit in overflow-hidden mask wrappers; the rise goes from translateY(110%) to 0 animating only transform+opacity
- Stagger interval and rise duration follow the snapshot (stagger × i inline delays; rise via --kinetic-rise)
- The weight axis drives font-variation-settings through a @property-registered variable with a 0.5s transition (browsers without it degrade to jumps)
- The headline container carries the sentence in aria-label and every split span is aria-hidden; screen readers never hear letter fragments
- Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, cancel the rise and axis transition; the text renders complete and static

### Aurora Gradient
- Blobs use radial-gradient(<size> at x% y%, oklch(L 0.18–0.24 H / .55–.85), transparent ~68%) with L pinned at 0.6–0.75
- Blur and saturate apply to the whole layer container (filter: blur(Npx) saturate(S)), not per blob
- The layer is oversized with inset:-25% and animated via transform only (ease-in-out alternate infinite) so no edge gaps show
- Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the animation stops and the background stays visually complete but static
- The layer is aria-hidden decoration; the text card keeps 4.5:1 over the brightest blob

### Recipe-level
- Parallax is a motion-reduction tool (M3's own definition: background slower than foreground to reduce motion): background rate 0.3, foreground 1:1, content never depends on the parallax layer; css mode uses animation-timeline: scroll() with automatic JS fallback
- Aurora gradient has no official spec (unverified): land it on the entry-schema demo defaults (spots 4 / blur 42px / saturate 115% / drift 18s; production ~60s); blobs animate transform only, with the whole-layer filter melting hard edges
- Text sits outside the filter layer and holds 4.5:1 on the dark base; the hero dimming scrim (clear-variant 35% dimming semantics) is checked against the brightest and darkest backdrop extremes
- Kinetic type follows the Dynamic Type hierarchy (large title at ≥34pt tier): per-char stagger 40ms, rise 600ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), weight axis wght 400 (range 100–900); per-char aria-hidden + whole-sentence aria-label keep screen readers intact
- reduced-motion cuts everything at once: parallax stops (all layers render statically), aurora drift stops, per-char rise stops (direct render); text semantics never depend on any layer's animation

The demo takes Ant numbers as stack discipline and toast-spring entry defaults as spring params: stiffness 300 / damping 25 (ζ≈0.722, overshoot ≈3.8% and no more) / edge bottom / lifetime 4000ms (sonner TOAST_LIFETIME source value); the official spring basis is M3 Expressive motion-physics (spatial + effects springs, the latter owning color/opacity transitions — the narrowing progress bar is exactly that form, https://m3.material.io/blog/building-with-m3-expressive ); the entrance band = TDesign drawer/notification/message 280ms desktop / 140ms mobile with dialogs classified as Z-axis motion, and the perceptual-constancy rule "desktop = mobile ×2" (https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/motion ); the demo progress bar = Ant notification showProgress semantics (countdown narrowing with remaining lifetime, hover pauses = pauseOnHover default true). ### Progress Motion / 进度反馈动效
- 形态按时长阈值演进:骨架(<1s 段)→ 循环(2–10s 区间语义)→ 百分比(≥10s 语义)+ 文字说明与完成时间估计

- animate.css ±10px 被明确称为等幅特例,不得说成物理衰减
- 错误状态有三重非动效承载(描边/文案/role=status),reduced-motion 时抖动取消而错误完整
- macOS 登录框参数标注为社区复刻经验、未证实

## Goal

Compose a notification stack: an empty-title submit shakes the input with exponential decay (A 10px / λ 6s⁻¹, 5 beats/0.5s); a valid title springs a toast in from the bottom edge (stiffness 300 / damping 25, ζ≈0.722 with slight overshoot only), at width 384 / 24px from the edge (Ant notification numbers), collapsing into a "+N" pill beyond 3 toasts (Ant stack{threshold:3}); every toast carries a countdown progress bar (showProgress semantics, hover pauses the timer = pauseOnHover), and at lifetime 4000ms it springs back out the same edge; each toast has at most one action (✕), and Esc dismisses the newest while restoring focus.

This is a multi-component composition. Replicate it one-to-one; follow each component's official-default parameter snapshot below and do not alter the values.

## Parameter Snapshot (per component · official defaults)

### Toast Spring Entrance (motion/toast-spring)

## Acceptance Criteria (per component)

### Toast Spring Entrance
- Entrance initial state mirrors react-hot-toast: off-screen travel + scale 0.6 + opacity 0.5 (direction per edge)
- Entrance spring strictly stiffness 300 / damping 25 (mass 1, ζ≈0.722); exit 0.4s cubic-bezier(.06,.71,.55,1)
- 4000ms auto-dismiss lifecycle (sonner's source value); timers cleared on unmount/manual close
- Container role=status (aria-live=polite), messages manually closeable via ✕; never critical info
- Under prefers-reduced-motion both directions become a bare fade (react-hot-toast's official degradation)

### Progress Motion
- Forms evolve by duration thresholds: skeleton (the <1s zone) → loop (the 2–10s semantics) → percent (the ≥10s semantics) + descriptive text and ETA
- Pulse/sweep period follows the snapshot --prog-pulse, animating only transform (compositor path)
- The determinate phase syncs aria-valuenow on role=progressbar; the indeterminate phase provides no value (no invented progress)
- Done-state content fades in fast at 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) (M3 short4 + Standard)
- Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, pulse/sweep/fade are disabled while values and status text keep updating

### Shake · Exponential Decay
- Defaults A=10px, λ=6s⁻¹: 5 beats/0.5s, envelope ×e^(−0.3)≈0.74 per beat (research 10 §4.3 example)
- The spring lane strictly stiffness 500 / damping 24 / velocity=−A·ω_d (ζ≈0.536, λ≈12), flagged as the research tier
- animate.css' ±10px is explicitly named the constant-amplitude special case, never sold as physical decay
- The error carries triple non-motion channels (border/text/role=status); under reduced-motion the shake drops while the error survives
- macOS login-shake numbers are flagged as community replication, unverified

### Recipe-level
- The stack is a state machine, not a message stream (§8 craft 7): Ant stack{threshold:3} / maxCount truncation / key-reuse semantics — beyond 3 toasts collapse into a "+N" pill that expands on click; M3 snackbar allows one at a time and one action max, so each demo toast carries only ✕
- Spring params = entry official defaults: stiffness 300 / damping 25 (ζ≈0.722, overshoot ≈3.8% and no more — TDesign's "UI is Cubic only") / edge bottom / lifetime 4000ms (sonner TOAST_LIFETIME source value); the toast returns to the edge it came from, exit on the same edge and faster
- The progress bar = Ant notification showProgress semantics: width narrows with remaining lifetime and hover pauses the timer (pauseOnHover default true); Ant duration 4.5s / message 3s are the official references, while the demo lifetime takes the toast-spring entry default 4000ms
- Shake decay has no official recipe (unverified): the nearest official neighbors are TDesign's "input shake" micro-motion example and Apple's visionOS ~0.2Hz sustained-oscillation red line; the demo A=10px / λ=6s⁻¹ (entry defaults: 5 beats/0.5s, envelope ×0.74 per beat) is a decaying transient, not sustained oscillation; under reduced-motion the shake stops and error semantics ride on text and border
- Auto-dismiss never loses the message: the bar is visual only; toast semantics ride on role=status/aria-live and the ✕ action (M3: web auto-dismiss must pair with inline feedback); Esc dismisses the newest and restores focus to the send button; reduced-motion degrades entrance/exit to pure fade

tagline.en: Choreographed motion + goal-gradient + empty-state handoff: the onboarding composition.

rationale.zh: 16 号调研 §7-配方 g:Apple Onboarding 主依据——onboarding 在 launching 之后、不属于启动流程;用可交互方式教学(优于说明书);上下文相关提示就近显示(TipKit);前置流程要简短;教程可跳过且不再重复弹出;推迟非必要设置、给默认值;评分/付费请求放在体验之后(https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/onboarding )。编排纪律 = TDesign「页面首次加载不用顺序动画表达内容顺序,直接呈现或淡入淡出」(https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/motion )——demo 首屏直出(纯 fade),交错只给用户触发的步进转场:choreography 条目官方默认 stagger 40ms(社区常见值,未证实;官方无交错间隔推荐值)/方向 up、入 250ms std-decel cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1)/出 200ms std-accel cubic-bezier(0.3,0,1,1) = M3 官方配对表 + Ant「出场整块消失、不设队列依次出场」(https://ant.design/docs/spec/motion-cn/ )+ M3 container transform 保引导卡→功能页连续感(https://m3.material.io/styles/motion/transitions/transition-patterns )。「目标梯度法则」四家规范未以该名收录 → 未证实(§9 清单),替代数值 = visionOS 按钮中心距 ≥60pt、M3 状态层 40dp/交互目标 48dp(https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/layout ;https://m3.material.io/foundations/interaction/states/state-layers );demo 取 goal-gradient 条目官方默认 steps=10/headStart=1(起点预盖 1 章人为进度,「步骤条/会员卡预盖一枚已完成章」签名巧思)。空状态→内容过渡 = Ant Empty——无数据时显式提示 + 初始化引导、children 即 CTA(<Empty><Button>创建</Button></Empty>)、Select/Table 等组件内置 Empty 可全局统一(https://ant.design/components/empty-cn/ ;空状态模板页 https://ant.design/docs/spec/research-empty-cn/ )+ Apple Loading「show something as soon as possible」内容到达即替换(https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/loading )+ M3 把 Skeleton loaders 官方列为转场模式;demo 换载零位移(空态占位尺寸 = 内容尺寸,内容到达快速淡入)。
rationale.en: Research 16 §7 recipe-g: Apple Onboarding leads — onboarding runs after launching, never inside it; teach interactively (better than manuals); show contextual tips near their target (TipKit); keep pre-flows short; tutorials are skippable and never re-shown; defer non-essential setup with defaults; rating/paywall requests come after the experience (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/onboarding ). Choreography discipline = TDesign's "never express content order with sequential animation on first load — present directly or cross-fade" (https://tdesign.tencent.com/design/motion ) — the demo's first paint renders directly (pure fade), and stagger is reserved for user-triggered step transitions: choreography entry defaults stagger 40ms (a common community value, unverified; no official inter-item interval exists) / direction up, in 250ms std-decel cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1) / out 200ms std-accel cubic-bezier(0.3,0,1,1) = M3's official pairing + Ant "exits vanish as whole blocks, never queued" (https://ant.design/docs/spec/motion-cn/ ) + M3 container transform for card→workspace continuity (https://m3.material.io/styles/motion/transitions/transition-patterns ). "Goal gradient" is not codified under that name in any of the four systems → unverified (§9 list); proxy numbers = visionOS ≥60pt button-center spacing and M3 40dp state layer / 48dp target (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/layout ; https://m3.material.io/foundations/interaction/states/state-layers ); the demo takes goal-gradient entry defaults steps=10 / headStart=1 (one artificial progress stamp pre-stamped at the start, the "pre-stamp one tick" craft note). Empty→content handoff = Ant Empty — explicit no-data hint plus initialization guidance, children as CTA (<Empty><Button>create</Button></Empty>), Empty built into Select/Table etc. for global consistency (https://ant.design/components/empty-cn/ ; the empty-state template page https://ant.design/docs/spec/research-empty-cn/ ) + Apple Loading "show something as soon as possible", replacing placeholders on arrival (https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/loading ) + M3's official skeleton-loaders transition pattern; the demo swaps with zero shift (empty placeholder sized = content size, content fading in fast).

prompt.zh:
## 目标

组合一条首启引导:三步卡(欢迎 → 试一试 → 完成)在启动完成后运行,首屏按 TDesign 纪律直出不编排;步进转场用 choreography(stagger 40ms/方向 up,入 250ms std-decel/出 200ms std-accel,出场整块不排队);每步可「跳过」且不再弹(Apple Onboarding);完成后落在空工作台——空状态(插画+标题+说明+children CTA「创建第一个项目」)与内容零位移换载;10 章集章卡预盖 1 章人为进度(headStart=1「完成首启引导」),创建项目即集章并读出剩余章数(目标梯度)。

这是一个多组件组合方案,请一比一复刻。逐组件严格遵循下方官方默认参数快照,不要自行调整数值。

## 参数快照(逐组件 · 官方默认)

### Motion Choreography / 动效编排 Choreography (motion/choreography)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "stagger",
    "value": "40ms"
  },
  {
    "name": "direction",
    "value": "up"
  }
]
```

### Empty / 空状态 (components/empty)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "simple",
    "value": "off"
  },
  {
    "name": "footerAction",
    "value": "on"
  }
]
```

### Goal-Gradient Effect / 目标梯度效应 (principles/goal-gradient)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "steps",
    "value": "10章"
  },
  {
    "name": "headStart",
    "value": "1章"
  }
]
```

## 验收要点(逐组件)

### Motion Choreography / 动效编排 Choreography
- 交错用 animation-delay = i × stagger 实现,不依赖 JS 动效库
- 整组方向统一且与来源空间一致(M3:通知自顶、抽屉自侧、sheet 自底)
- 入/出时长取官方配对:进入 250ms std-decel、退出 200ms std-accel(进入恒长于退出)
- 只动画 opacity 与 transform,并实时显示总铺开时间 stagger × (n−1)
- prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时改纯 opacity 交错淡入,保留节奏去掉位移

### Empty / 空状态
- 空态卡替换原表格区域:无数据时不保留表头/页脚(Carbon 最佳实践)
- 插画按所选档位取 121×116(默认)或 55×35(简洁)比例,并 aria-hidden
- 标题对齐 locale 默认文案『暂无数据』风格,副文案正向表述下一步
- 底部操作可选:关闭时不渲染任何按钮占位
- 空态出现时以 role="status" 播报,插画不承载关键信息

### Goal-Gradient Effect / 目标梯度效应
- steps/headStart 为 JS 型参数经 store 订阅;改动即重开一轮,headStart 预盖格必须带「预盖」视觉标记且如实标注人为进度
- 间隔=距上一章的真实毫秒数(第 1 章相对本轮起点),逐章柱状呈现 + 最近/最短/最长文本,不只靠读图
- 「已集 n/N · 百分比 · 还差 m 章」三组文本实时同步并 aria-live 播报;已集格带 ✓ 字符,不靠颜色单独区分
- 达标后按钮转为「再来一轮」,庆祝态为一次性动画;prefers-reduced-motion 下全部动画取消、数值即时更新
- 标注 Hull 1932/1934 与 Kivetz/Urminsky/Zheng 出处;steps/headStart 标注为 demo 教学参数,定律本身不规定数值

### 配方级
- 引导纪律(Apple Onboarding):在启动完成后、不在启动路径上加塞;可交互教学(真实开关,试用前下一步给轻提示)优于说明书;可跳过且跳过不再重复弹出;推迟非必要设置——demo 不含任何设置项
- 编排纪律(TDesign/Ant/M3):首次加载不用顺序动画——首屏直出(纯 fade 200ms);交错只给用户触发的步进转场:delay = i×40ms、整组统一方向 up、入 250ms std-decel/出 200ms std-accel(M3 官方配对),出场整块消失不排队(Ant)
- 目标梯度法则四家未成文收录(未证实,§9 清单):替代数值 = visionOS 按钮中心距 ≥60pt、M3 状态层 40dp/交互目标 48dp(CTA min-height 48px);demo 参数 = 条目官方默认 steps=10/headStart=1(预盖人为进度);进度由 progressbar(aria-valuenow)承载,不只靠集章图形
- 空状态→内容 = Ant Empty 解剖(插画+标题+说明+children CTA)+ Apple Loading 占位即换:占位尺寸 = 内容尺寸(min-height 118px),内容到达快速淡入、零位移;CTA 是真实按钮(可聚焦、有按压态)
- reduced-motion 一刀切:交错退化为纯 opacity 淡入(位移清零)、集章弹跳停、换载零动画;步骤进度与集章语义全部由文本/aria 承载,不依赖任何一层动画

## 调研出处

out/design-study/16-composition-recipes.md §7 配方 g「首启引导」(依据:HIG Onboarding/Loading/layout、M3 transition-patterns/state-layers、Ant Empty/motion-cn/research-empty、TDesign motion;目标梯度未证实,按条目 schema 默认落地)

## 出处

/uiux-atlas/recipes/onboarding-journey/
prompt.en:
## Goal

Compose a first-run onboarding: a three-step card (Welcome → Try it → Done) running after launch, with the first paint rendered directly per TDesign (no choreography on load); step transitions use choreography (stagger 40ms / direction up, in 250ms std-decel / out 200ms std-accel, exits as whole blocks); every step is skippable and never re-shown (Apple Onboarding); completion lands on an empty workspace — an empty state (art + title + description + children CTA "Create first project") swapping to content with zero shift; a 10-stamp card pre-stamps 1 artificial stamp (headStart=1 for finishing onboarding), and each created project adds a stamp while a readout counts the remaining ones (goal gradient).

This is a multi-component composition. Replicate it one-to-one; follow each component's official-default parameter snapshot below and do not alter the values.

## Parameter Snapshot (per component · official defaults)

### Motion Choreography (motion/choreography)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "stagger",
    "value": "40ms"
  },
  {
    "name": "direction",
    "value": "up"
  }
]
```

### Empty (components/empty)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "simple",
    "value": "off"
  },
  {
    "name": "footerAction",
    "value": "on"
  }
]
```

### Goal-Gradient Effect (principles/goal-gradient)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "steps",
    "value": "10章"
  },
  {
    "name": "headStart",
    "value": "1章"
  }
]
```

## Acceptance Criteria (per component)

### Motion Choreography
- Staggering is animation-delay = i × stagger, with no JS animation library
- One direction per group, consistent with the content's spatial origin (M3: notifications top, drawers side, sheets bottom)
- Enter/exit durations from the official pairs: enter 250ms std-decel, exit 200ms std-accel (enters outlast exits)
- Animate only opacity and transform, and show the total spread stagger × (n−1) live
- Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, cross-fade with opacity only — keep the rhythm, drop the displacement

### Empty
- The empty card replaces the table region: no header/footer retained when there is no data (Carbon best practice)
- Artwork follows the selected tier — 121×116 (default) or 55×35 (simple) proportions — and is aria-hidden
- Title follows the locale default 'No data' style; the sub-copy states the next step positively
- The bottom action is optional: when off, no button placeholder is rendered
- The empty state announces via role="status"; the artwork never carries key information

### Goal-Gradient Effect
- steps/headStart are JS-type params consumed via store subscription; changing them restarts the round, and head-start slots carry a visible 'pre-stamped' mark honestly labeled as artificial progress
- Interval = real milliseconds since the previous stamp (stamp 1 measured from round start), shown per-stamp as bars plus latest/min/max text — never chart-only
- 'n/N · percent · m left' text stays in sync and is announced via aria-live; collected slots carry a ✓ glyph, never color-only
- On completion the button becomes 'another round'; the celebration is a one-shot animation; under prefers-reduced-motion all animation drops and numbers update instantly
- Cite Hull 1932/1934 and Kivetz/Urminsky/Zheng; label steps/headStart as demo teaching params — the law itself sets no numbers

### Recipe-level
- Onboarding discipline (Apple Onboarding): runs after launch, never inside it; interactive teaching (a real switch; a light nudge on Next before it's tried) beats manuals; skippable and never re-shown; non-essential setup deferred — the demo carries no settings
- Choreography discipline (TDesign/Ant/M3): no sequential animation on first load — the first paint renders directly (pure 200ms fade); stagger is reserved for user-triggered step transitions: delay = i×40ms, one shared up direction, in 250ms std-decel / out 200ms std-accel (M3's official pairing), exits as whole blocks never queued (Ant)
- "Goal gradient" is not codified by the four systems (unverified, §9 list): proxy numbers = visionOS ≥60pt button centers, M3 40dp state layer / 48dp target (CTA min-height 48px); demo params = entry official defaults steps=10 / headStart=1 (artificial progress pre-stamped); progress rides on progressbar semantics (aria-valuenow), never on the stamp graphic alone
- Empty→content = Ant Empty anatomy (art + title + description + children CTA) + Apple Loading's placeholder swap: placeholder sized = content size (min-height 118px), content fades in fast with zero shift; the CTA is a real button (focusable, with a pressed state)
- reduced-motion cuts everything at once: stagger degrades to opacity-only fade (transforms zeroed), stamp pop stops, the swap loses all animation; step progress and stamp semantics are carried by text/aria, never by any layer's animation

## Research source

out/design-study/16-composition-recipes.md §7 配方 g「首启引导」(依据:HIG Onboarding/Loading/layout、M3 transition-patterns/state-layers、Ant Empty/motion-cn/research-empty、TDesign motion;目标梯度未证实,按条目 schema 默认落地)

tagline.zh: 数据表 + 图表轴 + 提示框图例(小倍数点缀):数据分析表盘的组合方案。
tagline.en: Data table + chart axes + tooltip/legend (small multiples as accent): the analytics board composition.

rationale.zh: 16 号调研 §7-配方 h:数据表 = Ant Table——密度三档 size large/medium/small(cellPaddingBlock/Inline 16/12/8 而 cellFontSize 三档恒 14:密度只动间距不动字号)、固定列必须给 width 且配 scroll.x、固定表头同、sticky 表头(4.6+)、virtual 虚拟滚动(5.9+,scroll.x/y 必须为 number)、rowHoverBg #fafafa(https://ant.design/components/table-cn/ );ProTable request/schema 驱动 + options 工具栏 {reload,density,setting} 密度切换是一等能力(https://procomponents.ant.design/components/table/ );TDesign Starter「统计报表」模板(https://tdesign.tencent.com/ )。图表轴 = AntV 轴构成五件套(轴标题/轴标签/轴线/刻度线/网格线)——轴标题默认要加,单位(如「亿元」)进轴标题、轴标签省略单位,其他元素已表意时可省轴标题精简画面(https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/specification/module/axis/ );demo 取 dataviz-chart-axes 条目官方默认 gridOpacity 0.09(Grafana getGridColor 9% 透明度公式)/axisLine on(#6E7079 宽 1 = ECharts axisDefault 默认)/tickCount 5(ECharts splitNumber 默认,nice-ticks 取整档距)。提示框与图例 = AntV「信息组件」统一框架(标签 Label/图例 Legend/提示信息 Tooltip/指标卡 Index Card)——PC hover→Tooltip、移动端→指标卡平铺,「信息不丢失地转换形态」;图例位置遵循阅读动线、高阶图例带数值带操作(https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/specification/module/info/ );demo 取 dataviz-tooltip-legend 条目官方默认 legendPos right(ggplot2 源码默认)/tooltipFollow on(ECharts mousemove 触发、showDelay 0/hideDelay 100ms 悬停宽限,WCAG 1.4.13 可关/可悬停/常驻);小倍数点缀 = small-multiples 条目官方默认 layout multiples/scaleMode shared(全面板共用 0–100 同标度,Tufte 定义性要求)/panelGap 8px(Grafana GRID_CELL_VMARGIN 源码值)。表格数字排版 = AntV 数字字体三条件 → font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums 等宽数字、金融财会数值右对齐(https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/specification/language/basic/ );图表内部层级 = 「组件海拔」四档透明度(次要/辅助/正文/强调信息)。表盘级规范 = AntV graph/pubDashboard(通用)/graph/conDashboard(监控)(https://antv.antgroup.com/llms.txt 索引)+ Ant visualization-page-cn/detail-page-cn 模板文档。M3 官方无图表组件与图表指引 → 未证实(components 为通用组件集,sitemap 实测)。价值层:AntV 三价值观 信任感/轻松感/意义感——参考线/事件标记/智能洞见是表盘「意义感」的官方要求(https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/specification/principles/basic/ )。
rationale.en: Research 16 §7 recipe-h: the data table = Ant Table — three density tiers size large/medium/small (cellPaddingBlock/Inline 16/12/8 while cellFontSize stays 14 across all tiers: density changes spacing only, never type size), fixed columns require width + scroll.x, fixed headers likewise, sticky header (4.6+), virtual scrolling (5.9+, scroll.x/y must be numbers), rowHoverBg #fafafa (https://ant.design/components/table-cn/ ); ProTable is request/schema-driven with the options toolbar {reload,density,setting} making density switching a first-class capability (https://procomponents.ant.design/components/table/ ); TDesign Starter's "statistics report" template (https://tdesign.tencent.com/ ). Chart axes = AntV's five-part axis anatomy (title/labels/line/ticks/grid) — the axis title is on by default, units (like "亿元") live in the title while labels omit them, and the title can be dropped when other elements already say it (https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/specification/module/axis/ ); the demo takes dataviz-chart-axes entry defaults gridOpacity 0.09 (Grafana's getGridColor 9%-opacity formula) / axisLine on (#6E7079 at width 1 = the ECharts axisDefault) / tickCount 5 (ECharts splitNumber default, nice-ticks rounding). Tooltip & legend = AntV's unified "info components" frame (Label/Legend/Tooltip/Index Card) — PC hover→Tooltip, mobile→tiled index cards, "morphing without losing information"; legend position follows the reading flow; advanced legends carry values and actions (https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/specification/module/info/ ); the demo takes dataviz-tooltip-legend entry defaults legendPos right (the ggplot2 source default) / tooltipFollow on (ECharts mousemove trigger, showDelay 0 / hideDelay 100ms hover grace, WCAG 1.4.13 dismissible/hoverable/persistent); the small-multiples accent = small-multiples entry defaults layout multiples / scaleMode shared (every panel shares one 0–100 scale, Tufte's defining requirement) / panelGap 8px (Grafana GRID_CELL_VMARGIN source value). Table numerals = AntV's three conditions for number fonts → font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums with financial figures right-aligned (https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/specification/language/basic/ ); in-chart hierarchy = "component elevation" four-band opacity (secondary/support/body/emphasis). Board-level specs = AntV graph/pubDashboard (general) / graph/conDashboard (monitoring) (indexed at https://antv.antgroup.com/llms.txt ) + Ant's visualization-page-cn/detail-page-cn template docs. M3 ships no chart components or chart guidance → unverified (components is a generic set, sitemap checked). The value layer: AntV's trust/ease/significance — reference lines, event marks and smart insights are the official requirements for a board's "sense of significance" (https://antv.antgroup.com/zh/specification/principles/basic/ ).

prompt.zh:
## 目标

组合一个数据分析表盘:左侧手绘 SVG 折线图(网格 opacity 0.09/轴线 #6E7079 宽 1/nice-ticks 5 档/单位进轴标题「活跃指数(分)」且标签省略单位;图例右置;tooltip 跟随指针 + 移出 100ms 悬停宽限 + Esc 可关 + 月带可聚焦键盘读值),右侧数据表(Ant Table 三档密度 cellPadding 16/12·8/8、sticky 表头 + 滚动列、数字列 tabular-nums 右对齐、本年列可排序 aria-sort),底部小倍数点缀(四区域面板共用 0–100 标度、面板 gap 8px);密度切换只动 cellPadding 不动字号。

这是一个多组件组合方案,请一比一复刻。逐组件严格遵循下方官方默认参数快照,不要自行调整数值。

## 参数快照(逐组件 · 官方默认)

### Table / 表格 (components/table)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "size",
    "value": "lg"
  },
  {
    "name": "bordered",
    "value": "off"
  },
  {
    "name": "striped",
    "value": "off"
  },
  {
    "name": "rowCount",
    "value": "5"
  }
]
```

### Chart Axes & Grid / 坐标轴与网格 (dataviz/dataviz-chart-axes)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "gridOpacity",
    "value": "0.09"
  },
  {
    "name": "axisLine",
    "value": "on"
  },
  {
    "name": "tickCount",
    "value": "5"
  }
]
```

### Tooltip & Legend / 图例与提示 (dataviz/dataviz-tooltip-legend)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "legendPos",
    "value": "right"
  },
  {
    "name": "tooltipFollow",
    "value": "on"
  }
]
```

### Small Multiples / 小倍数图 (dataviz/small-multiples)

```json
[
  {
    "name": "layout",
    "value": "multiples"
  },
  {
    "name": "scaleMode",
    "value": "shared"
  },
  {
    "name": "panelGap",
    "value": "8px"
  }
]
```

## 验收要点(逐组件)

### Table / 表格
- 用真实 table/thead/tbody/th(scope)/td 语义标签,不用 div 拼表
- size 三档严格对应单元格内边距 16/12·8/8 px,其余样式不随 size 漂移
- bordered=on 时外框 #d9d9d9、列线 #f0f0f0;striped=on 时偶数行 rgba(0,0,0,0.02)
- 行 hover 底色 rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 恒开,不依赖 striped
- rowCount=0 时不渲染表头,以 role='status' 的空状态替换整表
- 数值列右对齐并启用 tabular-nums

### Chart Axes & Grid / 坐标轴与网格
- 刻度档数默认 5(ECharts splitNumber),用 1/2/2.5/5×10ⁿ 取整档距,不硬凑等分数
- 网格线透明度默认 0.09(Grafana 公式),随主题翻转向文字色
- 类目轴不画横网格(ECharts 源码强制),横网格只属于值轴
- 折线图纵轴从 0 起或明确标注截断;柱状图必须零基线
- MDX 写明三套官方默认值出处(ECharts/Grafana/ggplot2 源码)与许可(ECharts/Grafana=Apache,ggplot2=MIT)

### Tooltip & Legend / 图例与提示
- tooltip 三件套可验收:按 Esc 立即关闭;指针可移入提示本体不消失;移出触发 100ms 后才隐藏(ECharts hideDelay)
- legendPos=none 时改用图上直标,不是简单删掉图例了事
- 图例默认右侧(ggplot2 源码默认),swatch 与系列一一对应且纹理/颜色同步
- 触屏/键盘兜底:柱体可聚焦或可点按触发同一提示
- MDX 写明 ECharts tooltip 五个默认值(trigger/triggerOn/showDelay/hideDelay/transitionDuration)的源码出处

### Small Multiples / 小倍数图
- 全部面板共用同一 y 域(默认 0–100);切换独立标度时逐面板标注刻度上限
- 面板间距默认 8px(Grafana GRID_CELL_VMARGIN 逐字),经 CSS 变量注入可调
- 对照模式如实呈现双轴混杂的读数陷阱(左轴 0–100 / 右轴 0–70,交叉点无意义),不美化
- 每个面板 role="img" + aria-label(系列+时间+指标);跨面板结论写在图外文字摘要
- 系列色取 Okabe-Ito 固化 hex(#0072B2/#E69F00/#009E73/#D55E00),不自行配色

### 配方级
- 轴纪律(AntV 五件套 + dataviz-chart-axes 条目默认):网格只画值轴方向且极浅(opacity 0.09 = Grafana getGridColor 公式)、轴线 #6E7079 宽 1(ECharts 默认)、刻度 5 档 nice-ticks 取整(实际档数可能少 1–2 档);单位进轴标题、轴标签省略单位;类目自明时省 X 轴标题
- 读值双通道(dataviz-tooltip-legend 条目默认):图例右置(ggplot2 legend.position 源码默认)+ tooltip 跟随指针(ECharts mousemove 触发);WCAG 1.4.13 三条全齐——Esc 可关、pointer-events auto 可移入、移出 100ms 宽限(hideDelay);键盘读值走月带 tabIndex + aria-label,信息不依赖悬停动画
- 表格 = Ant Table 口径:三档密度只动 cellPadding(lg 16/md 12·8/sm 8)不动字号(cellFontSize 三档恒 14);sticky 表头 + 滚动列(scroll.y 语义,region 可 Tab 聚焦);行 hover 恒开;固定列配 width+scroll.x、virtual 需 scroll 为 number 等官方前提记录在案,demo 不复现
- 数字排版与图内层级(AntV 语言规范):font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums + 右对齐;图内元素用透明度排 Z 序——网格最浅(0.09)、轴线/标签次之、数据线最实(组件海拔四档语义)
- 小倍数点缀(small-multiples 条目默认):四面板共用 0–100 同标度(shared,量级跨面板可直接比)、面板 gap 8px(Grafana GRID_CELL_VMARGIN 源码值);M3 无官方图表指引(未证实,sitemap 实测)——图表层全部依据出自 AntV

## Acceptance Criteria (per component)

### Table
- Use real table/thead/tbody/th (scope)/td semantic tags, not div soup
- The three size tiers map strictly to cell paddings 16 / 12·8 / 8 px; no other styles drift with size
- bordered=on gives an #d9d9d9 frame with #f0f0f0 column lines; striped=on tints even rows rgba(0,0,0,0.02)
- Row hover fill rgba(0,0,0,0.04) is always on, independent of striping
- At rowCount=0 no header is rendered; a role='status' empty state replaces the whole table
- Numeric columns are right-aligned with tabular-nums enabled

### Chart Axes & Grid
- Default 5 tick classes (ECharts splitNumber), step rounded via 1/2/2.5/5×10ⁿ — no forced equal division
- Gridline opacity defaults to 0.09 (Grafana's formula), inverting toward the theme text color
- No horizontal gridlines on the category axis (ECharts source enforces it) — horizontal grids belong to the value axis
- The line chart's value axis starts at 0 or is explicitly truncated; bar charts must keep the zero baseline
- MDX cites the three official default provenances (ECharts/Grafana/ggplot2 sources) and licenses (ECharts/Grafana = Apache, ggplot2 = MIT)

### Tooltip & Legend
- The tooltip passes the trio: Esc closes instantly; the pointer can enter the tooltip body; hiding waits 100ms after pointer-out (ECharts hideDelay)
- legendPos=none switches to direct labeling on the chart — not a bare legend removal
- Legend defaults to right (ggplot2's source default), swatches one-to-one with series and in sync
- Touch/keyboard fallback: bars are focusable or tappable to trigger the same tooltip
- MDX cites the source provenance of ECharts' five tooltip defaults (trigger/triggerOn/showDelay/hideDelay/transitionDuration)

### Small Multiples
- All panels share one y domain (0–100 by default); when switching to independent scales, label every panel's ceiling
- Panel gap defaults to 8px (Grafana GRID_CELL_VMARGIN verbatim), tunable via an injected CSS variable
- The contrast mode honestly shows the dual-axis trap (left 0–100 / right 0–70, meaningless crossings) without softening it
- Each panel carries role="img" + aria-label (series + period + metric); the cross-panel takeaway lives in text outside the chart
- Series colors come from fixed Okabe-Ito hex (#0072B2/#E69F00/#009E73/#D55E00) — no ad-hoc palette

### Recipe-level
- Axis discipline (AntV's five-part anatomy + dataviz-chart-axes entry defaults): grid only on the value axis and very light (opacity 0.09 = Grafana's getGridColor formula), axis line #6E7079 at width 1 (ECharts default), 5 nice-ticks tiers after rounding (the real count may be 1–2 fewer); the unit lives in the axis title and labels omit it; the X-axis title drops when categories are self-evident
- Dual reading channels (dataviz-tooltip-legend entry defaults): legend on the right (ggplot2's legend.position source default) + tooltip following the pointer (ECharts mousemove trigger); WCAG 1.4.13 fully covered — Esc dismissible, pointer-events auto hoverable, 100ms leave grace (hideDelay); keyboard reading rides on month-band tabIndex + aria-label, never on hover animation
- Table = Ant Table's terms: three density tiers change cellPadding only (lg 16 / md 12·8 / sm 8), never font size (cellFontSize stays 14); sticky header + scrollable body (scroll.y semantics, the region is Tab-focusable); row hover always on; official preconditions like fixed columns needing width+scroll.x and virtual scrolling requiring numeric scroll are on record but not reproduced in the demo
- Numerals and in-chart hierarchy (AntV language spec): font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums + right alignment; in-chart elements order their Z by opacity — grid lightest (0.09), axis line/labels next, data lines most solid (component-elevation four-band semantics)
- Small-multiples accent (small-multiples entry defaults): four panels share one 0–100 scale (shared, magnitudes comparable across panels), panel gap 8px (Grafana GRID_CELL_VMARGIN source value); M3 has no chart guidance (unverified, sitemap checked) — every chart-layer basis comes from AntV

audience.zh: 要把设计语言落成代码资产的前端/设计工程师:三层 token、多主题映射与 registry 工程化。
audience.en: Frontend/design engineers turning a design language into code assets: three-layer tokens, multi-theme mapping and registry engineering.

outcome.zh: 学完你能:定义 primitive/semantic/component 三层令牌清单;用「一套词表、多份映射」支撑多主题(切映射零组件改动);给主题切换挂过渡并带 reduced-motion 闸门;用 clamp 把字号与间距做成随视口流动的响应式令牌;最后从 brand 源色自动派生全部 roles——换源色 + 切主题 + 缩窗口三者叠加无回归。
outcome.en: When you finish you can: define a primitive/semantic/component token inventory; support multi-theme with "one vocabulary, many mappings" (swap mappings, zero component changes); give theme switching a transition gated by reduced-motion; make type and spacing flow with the viewport via clamp as responsive token values; and auto-derive every role from a brand source color — source swap + theme switch + window resize stack with no regression.

whyNow.zh: 词表先行:平台无关的令牌方法学是一切后续的地基——M3 把 design-tokens 置于 Foundations 尾段、customization 之前,「先学令牌再谈换肤」。
whyNow.en: Vocabulary first: the platform-agnostic token methodology underpins everything after — M3 places design-tokens at the end of Foundations before customization, "learn tokens before reskinning".

whyNow.zh: 词表之上学「一套词表、多份映射」:M3/Semi/Arco 三家官方主题机制共同给出「令牌 → 多主题 → 定制」的官方序,三主题只切映射文件、零组件改动。
whyNow.en: Above the vocabulary comes "one vocabulary, many mappings": the official theming mechanisms of M3/Semi/Arco share the order tokens → multi-theme → customization — three themes by swapping the mapping file alone, zero component changes.

whyNow.zh: 主题有了之后才有「切换」:View Transitions 承载换肤过渡,且必须挂 prefers-reduced-motion 闸门降级为直切。
whyNow.en: Switching exists only once themes do: View Transitions carries the crossfade, gated by prefers-reduced-motion downgrading to an instant swap.

whyNow.zh: 从「静态映射」升级到「响应式 token 值」:clamp 让字号随视口流动,M3 type-scale tokens 提供档位参照。
whyNow.en: Upgrade from static mappings to responsive token values: clamp lets type scale flow with the viewport, with M3 type-scale tokens as the tier reference.

whyNow.zh: 与上一步同一工具(clamp/calc)换到间距轴——刻意相邻形成迁移练习,间距随视口连续缩放、断点无跳变。
whyNow.en: The same tools (clamp/calc) move to the spacing axis — deliberately adjacent to transfer practice, with spacing scaling continuously and no breakpoint jumps.

whyNow.zh: 收束到完整产线:源色 → 调色板 → roles 自动派生是 M3 dynamic color 官方链路,换源色后全部 roles 同步再生、组件零改。
whyNow.en: Converge on the full pipeline: source color → palette → roles auto-derivation is M3's official dynamic color chain — swap the source and every role regenerates with zero component changes.

checklist.zh: 能定义 primitive/semantic/component 三层令牌清单
checklist.en: Can define a three-layer token inventory: primitive / semantic / component

checklist.zh: 三主题只切映射文件即可切换,组件零改动
checklist.en: Three themes switch by swapping the mapping file alone, zero component changes

checklist.zh: 主题切换动画在 prefers-reduced-motion 下降级为直切
checklist.en: The theme-switch animation downgrades to an instant swap under prefers-reduced-motion

checklist.zh: 320px 与 1440px 两端标题行长相近且不溢出,间距随视口连续缩放、断点无跳变
checklist.en: Headline measure stays similar and overflow-free at 320px and 1440px, with spacing scaling continuously and no breakpoint jumps

checklist.zh: 换 brand 源色后全部 roles 同步再生;换源色 + 切主题 + 缩窗口三者叠加页面无回归
checklist.en: Swapping the brand source regenerates every role in sync; source swap + theme switch + window resize stack with no page regression

audience.zh: 正在做 AI 产品的界面工程师:流式响应、思考态、建议 chips 到生成式 UI 的完整模式库。
audience.en: Interface engineers building AI products: the full pattern set from streaming responses and thinking states to suggestion chips and generative UI.

outcome.zh: 学完你能:搭通 SSE 流式管线(分片组装 + 中断续传);在首分片到达前给出思考指示;由 JSON Schema 流式渲染可交互卡与逐行流式表格;用建议 chips 引导下一轮;并以 loading/部分/错误/空/无来源/重试 六态状态机收官——把空态做成引导下一轮的邀请,一条对话流跑完全链演示。
outcome.en: When you finish you can: stand up an SSE streaming pipeline (chunk assembly + resume after interruption); show a thinking indicator before the first chunk lands; stream-render an interactive card from JSON Schema and a table row by row; steer the next turn with suggestion chips; and close with a six-state machine of loading/partial/error/empty/no-source/retry — turning the empty state into an invitation — with one conversation demonstrating the whole chain.

whyNow.zh: 流式管线是 AI UI 的地基设施,先通管道再做壳——NN/g 判定 AI 正引入第三种界面范式(意图式结果说明),管道是范式的第一块基石。
whyNow.en: The streaming pipeline is the infrastructure of AI UI — build the pipe before the shell; NN/g declares AI is introducing the third UI paradigm (intent-based outcome specification), and the pipe is its first stone.

whyNow.zh: 流式引入的第一个 UI 问题=「未完成态」:首分片到达前要有思考指示,官方载体是 progress indicators。
whyNow.en: Streaming's first UI problem is the "not-done-yet" state: a thinking indicator must appear before the first chunk arrives, and progress indicators are the official carrier.

whyNow.zh: 从「文本流」升维到「组件流」:由 JSON Schema 流式渲染可交互卡,是意图范式的官方实现路径(AI SDK 生成式 UI / Ant Design X)。
whyNow.en: Upgrade from text streams to component streams: rendering an interactive card from streamed JSON Schema is the official implementation path of the intent paradigm (AI SDK generative UI / Ant Design X).

whyNow.zh: 生成式 UI 之后攻最难形态:结构化数据的逐行流——本站自定义条目,无任何厂商专页(官方依据为 MDN Streams + M3 组件组合锚点,如实标注未证实)。
whyNow.en: After generative UI comes the hardest shape, row-by-row streaming of structured data — a site-original entry with no vendor page of its own (official basis is the combined MDN Streams + M3 components anchor, honestly marked unverified).

whyNow.zh: 答案完整后学「引导下一轮」:建议 chips 是官方建议组件,充当「回答」与「追问」两幕之间的桥。
whyNow.en: Once answers complete, learn to steer the next turn: suggestion chips are the official suggestion component, the bridge between the answer act and the follow-up act.

whyNow.zh: 收官永远是状态完备性:loading/部分/错误/空/无来源/重试 六态状态机全部可达,是 AI 界面的终验。
whyNow.en: The finale is always state completeness: a six-state machine of loading/partial/error/empty/no-source/retry, all reachable — the final acceptance of an AI interface.

whyNow.zh: 六态里「空」最常被敷衍:empty 条目把空态从「没有数据」升级为引导下一轮的邀请——状态机收官后的最后一块收口练习。
whyNow.en: Among the six states, empty is the one most often faked: the empty entry upgrades a blank from "no data" to an invitation steering the next turn — the final closing exercise after the state machine.

checklist.zh: SSE 分片能组装成完整流式渲染,且支持中断后续传
checklist.en: SSE chunks assemble into a complete streamed render, with resume after interruption

checklist.zh: 首分片到达前 ≤300ms 出现思考指示
checklist.en: A thinking indicator appears within 300ms before the first chunk lands

checklist.zh: 能由 JSON Schema 流式渲染一张可交互卡,表格逐行流式且骨架行稳定不抖
checklist.en: Can stream-render an interactive card from JSON Schema, and stream a table row by row with a stable skeleton that never jitters

checklist.zh: 建议 chips 点击即作为下一轮输入,对话旁保留传统导航(Hybrid UI)
checklist.en: Suggestion chips feed straight into the next turn on click, with traditional navigation kept beside the conversation (hybrid UI)

checklist.zh: 六态状态机(loading/部分/错误/空/无来源/重试)全部可达并截图存证,空态按 empty 条目做成引导
checklist.en: All six states (loading/partial/error/empty/no-source/retry) are reachable and screenshot-provable, with the empty state built as an invitation per the empty entry

audience.zh: 要把可访问性从「上线前检查表」变成「日常手艺」的团队:WCAG 清单、键盘导航、对比度公式逐条落地。
audience.en: Teams turning accessibility from a pre-launch checklist into daily craft: WCAG checklist, keyboard navigation and the contrast ratio formula, item by item.

outcome.zh: 学完你能:对任一页面跑完 WAI Easy Checks 全项;保证纯键盘可完成核心任务且焦点永远可见;在强制增强对比下保持文字/描边/焦点环可读;把两条偏好落到表单控件(标签/错误/描述);并给图表类复杂图像配文本替代与数据表,让色彩不单独承载含义。
outcome.en: When you finish you can: run every WAI Easy Checks item on any page; keep core tasks keyboard-only completable with focus always visible; keep text, strokes and focus rings readable under forced increased contrast; land both preferences on form controls (labels, errors, descriptions); and give chart-like complex images text alternatives and data tables, so color never carries meaning alone.

whyNow.zh: 先拿官方「全图 + 自检法」:WAI Easy Checks 本就是官方新手顺序,对任一条目页跑完全项再往下走。
whyNow.en: Take the official "whole map + self-check method" first: WAI Easy Checks is itself the official beginner order — run every check on any entry page before moving on.

whyNow.zh: 第一硬依赖:键盘先行是行为层无障碍的地基——纯键盘完成核心任务,焦点永远可见。
whyNow.en: The first hard dependency: keyboard first is the bedrock of behavioral accessibility — core tasks complete with keys alone and focus always visible.

whyNow.zh: 从行为偏好进入呈现偏好:强制增强对比是呈现层的考官,文字/描边/焦点环都要经得起它。
whyNow.en: From behavioral to presentational preferences: forced increased contrast is the presentational examiner — text, strokes and focus rings must all survive it.

whyNow.zh: 键盘与对比两条判据的最常交汇处是表单:M3 把每个组件页第四节固定为 accessibility——学完偏好立即在组件上收口。
whyNow.en: Forms are where the keyboard and contrast criteria most often meet: M3 fixes accessibility as the fourth section of every component page — close the loop on a real component right after the preferences.

whyNow.zh: 收官用最难的媒体类型(图表)综合运用前四步:复杂图像要有文本替代与数据表,色彩不单独承载含义。
whyNow.en: Close with the hardest medium, charts, to exercise all four previous steps: complex images need text alternatives and data tables, and color never carries meaning alone.

checklist.zh: 能对任一条目页跑完 WAI Easy Checks 全项
checklist.en: Can run every WAI Easy Checks item on any entry page

checklist.zh: 纯键盘能完成核心任务,焦点永远可见(键盘接口实践)
checklist.en: Core tasks complete with keys alone and focus is always visible (keyboard interface practices)

checklist.zh: 强制增强对比下文字、描边与焦点环仍可读
checklist.en: Text, strokes and focus rings stay readable under forced increased contrast

checklist.zh: 表单控件(以 input 为例)标签、错误与描述可达:键盘操作与对比两偏好同时通过
checklist.en: Form controls (input as the example) keep labels, errors and descriptions accessible: keyboard and contrast preferences pass together

checklist.zh: 图表类复杂图像有文本替代与数据表,色彩不单独承载含义
checklist.en: Chart-like complex images carry text alternatives and data tables, and color never carries meaning alone
